chapters.title: Chapter 1001: Taming Quest (12)
paragraphs: Clearly, the five monarchs with Kent didn’t expect Vey to easily accept his offer.
After all, they knew the Phoenix Queen was a prideful creature, a beast who wouldn’t casually accept becoming a subordinate of someone who isn’t a Phoenix.
It is just impossible.
However, while they saw a prideful beast, Kent saw a vulnerable and angry beast.

When Vey spoke about her mother, Kent could tell she wanted nothing more than to get her back. He could tell that, although a part of her thinks she is dead, another part thinks she is still out there.
So, learning that Kent has a Nirvana flame, she hopes and thinks that if her mom is out there, then perhaps one day she will get to come look for her.
The second reason is how angry she became hearing about the Planet King.
Sylvara told him they came to this world because of the Planet King.
According to her, they are all from different Immortal worlds; however, during an expedition to a recently discovered ruin, they sensed the presence of a forsaken elder of a long-forgotten race.
Naturally, as people who hate the forsaken race, they came together and planned to kill him.
Of course, they didn’t know each other. They came from different backgrounds and even hated each other, making them rivals.
However, on that sacred day, they came together to kill this person who, according to Sylvara, was a Root Immortal while all seven of them were merely at the Empyrean stage.
Of course, with their backgrounds and strength, killing an injured immortal would be hard but not impossible.
They came together, and so the battle began.
However, just when the battle was drawing to an end, the youngest prince of a rather powerful beast family, the Supreme Tiger Family, Prince Lowell, came, and everything changed.

The Celestial Tiger Family is a family of Tiger Beasts said to have supreme blood in their bloodlines. Although not Supreme Beasts, they have some form of supreme energy in them, so naturally, they are powerful.
With his arrival and cultivation at the Death stage, he quickly suppressed them.
He was just too powerful.
They were both outmatched and outclassed.
None could have done anything different.
They knew killing an immortal wouldn’t be easy; similarly, they knew killing someone who had comprehended the Law of Life (Life Dao) would also be a headache.
He suppressed them with both his cultivation, which is two stages above theirs, and his superior bloodline.

However, when they found out Prince Lowell was after the bloodline of the Forsaken race, they fought against their limitation to prevent him from getting the bloodline of a race that can escape the limitation of a world.
Initially, Prince Lowell wanted to give the bloodline to his father.
However, during that critical moment, the strongest among them, Ignarok, the dragon, used a bloodline ability to create a wormhole, and they all sacrificed themselves, pulling Prince Lowell in.
They thought it would kill them. However, none of them expected to end up in a High World and in a place suitable for their nature, too.
They each picked a domain that suited them and began to rule as Monarchs.
Later, they discovered that Prince Lowell had also made it, and because of the bloodline he had taken, he was confined to one of the strongest planets in this planetary system.
The bloodline absorption may have been incomplete, giving him partial benefits, which included the ability to cultivate an immortal aura, but it also limited him to Planet Seamus Prime.

He changed his name to Zorath Kaine, and since he couldn’t leave his world until he had completely absorbed the Forsaken bloodline, he decided to use his power to make the entire planetary system bow to him.
He started simple, and now, he is nearing the stage where he can go wild. If he were to take control of Plane Nictus, then he would gain the authority and power to dominate other worlds.
This means they are in danger...
Vey hates him and wants him dead.
So, hearing Kent was after the same person, she readily accepted his offer.
They knew once the Planet King is done absorbing the Forsaken bloodline, he would come for revenge, so killing him first is the right move.
"But I must tell you. When it comes to that bastard, don’t underestimate him," Vey said with a thoughtful expression.

"He is someone who, even without the Forsaken bloodline, was able to completely suppress us. His bloodline contains supreme energy, and while we seven are divine beasts, facing someone who can be likened to a supreme beast, we are but mere bugs.
I don’t know who you are, but I am going to take a wild guess and assume you were the presence we all felt days ago.

However, you must know that, while your presence is commanding, you still pale in comparison to that bastard. Perhaps after he was suppressed to the Heavenly Ascension stage, his strength would have also been reduced.
However, it has been over fifty thousand years, and now that he has cultivated a strand of immortal aura, I believe he has become much more powerful.

I will help you hold back his subordinates, but you must do the killing. If you succeed, I, Veyara, youngest daughter of the Divine Golden Phoenix, Queen Miradia, would serve you for as long as you want me."
’So that is who you are, huh?’ Zeraphine chuckled inwardly. ’No wonder you are very prideful. The young princess of the Golden Phoenix Clan surely deserves to be arrogant and prideful.’
The other monarchs, except Sylvara, seemed to have finally recognized who Vey was, causing them all to see her in a new light.
Kent smiled and tapped his taming bracelet, "I will kill him, that much is true. However, please note that handling his subordinates is your responsibility.
Also, I need seven more subordinates from your domain to join my campaign."
Vey nodded and called her subordinates. One of them left to check on what happened in Sylvara’s domain; however, using a spell, she summoned her back.
After two days, Kent added Vey and her subordinates to his beast legion.
They all received one innate ability, which, based on the change in their trust level from 10% to 30%, Kent knew meant they were slowly gaining trust in him.
He sent his new subordinates to search for some of the ingredients needed for the pills.
Then, with Vey joining him and the other monarchs, they headed to the next location, which would take them roughly ten days to reach.
Meanwhile, far on Seamus Prime, a handsome young man with dark tattoos on his neck sat in a lotus posture, his eyes closed in what seemed to be a deep meditation.
The aura around him was extremely dense, and judging by how the tattoos were glowing and moving, it suggested he was dealing with powers beyond one’s understanding.
Suddenly, a smile appeared on his face as his red eyes slowly opened.
A wave of energy washed out of his body, spreading far and wide. All who felt this energy turned pale, many collapsing in sheer terror.
"Hahahaha..." the man laughed. "Finally, after tens of thousands of years, I have finally absorbed the Forsaken bloodline. Now I can leave this place."
The look of anger appeared in his eyes. "The seven monarchs. Soon, your blood will become my sustenance as I rise to ascension and dominance, thanks to your foolishness.
Had it not been for you, I wouldn’t be in this filthy place surrounded by a bunch of low-lives."
He stood up and walked toward the window.
Looking at the majestic city spreading thousands of miles, a sigh escaped his lips, and he said, "In a couple of months, after getting used to my powers, I will come for your heads...monarchs."

chapters.title: Chapter 1002: Taming Quest (13) [Bonus]
paragraphs: ’Ahh, what a headache...’
Kent said inwardly, staring at rows of texts written in red hovering before him.
⟪Due to unforeseen circumstances, the difficulty level of your ’Contra aestus’ quest has been raised to from ’Calamity’ to ’Hell’⟫
⟪Because of the change, the rewards have also been updated⟫
⟪Updated Rewards⟫
↠ 600 Million Tower Points
↠ 2,000,000 Limit Breaker Points
↠ Destiny Map
↠ Taming Bracelet (Released)
↠ Blood Life Seal (x3) (1 released)
↠ Blood Death Seal (x3) (1 released)
↠ Rule Breaker Key (Tied to the Destiny Key)
’If I didn’t know better, I would say that damn Planet King might have finally succeeded in absorbing the Forsaken Bloodline, and so he had become a whole different level of crazy.’
Kent smiled, sitting in lotus posture as Kaelith sped them toward the domain of the Black Dragon.
’Still, this is my quest and regardless of the danger level, I would not abandon it, not when there is a lot riding on it.’
He sighed, seeing that he had received one Blood Life Seal and one Blood Death Seal.
’Although I doubt directly using the Blood Death Seal can kill that bastard, having it sure will give me an edge. However, with the Blood Life Seal, I would have to die twice before actually dying.
But, if I can refine it and make it a part of me before facing that bastard, then even demons will have a hard time coming to terms with my regenerative/healing abilities.’
Kent is happy, but he is also aware of the danger now looming over him. However, like he said, there is a lot riding on the quest, so regardless of the danger, he will see it to an end.
"Are you alright?" Sylvara asked, taking Kent’s hand and pressing it against her chest.
Kent opened his eyes and gave her hand a gentle squeeze with a smile on his face. "I am fine. You don’t have to worry about me."
"Okay," Sylvara nodded before resting her head on Kent’s shoulder.
Vey, who was seated behind them, watched all this with a calm expression on her face...
She is a Phoenix, a species that mostly prefers to mate with individuals of the same gender rather than the opposite.
They don’t need men to reproduce, since condensing their core flame was enough to form an egg and birth a phoenix.
Most Phoenix races are like this.
So she was indeed romantically interested in Sylvara. However, now seeing that she is chummy in Kent’s arms, she couldn’t help sighing in her heart.
’Mother said not all female beasts like to be with their fellow females, so this is normal. However, now, why am I looking at him like I want to devour him?’
Her gaze was entirely focused on Kent, making her wonder why. To her, men are nothing if not waste in her eyes.
She hates men and would rather die than be with one.
However, after meeting Kent, she couldn’t help but feel things she never thought possible toward him...
’I used to feel these kinds of feelings toward her, but now it’s like they have switched, and I can’t even feel a strand of it toward her; instead, they are all directed toward him.’
If her mom were to be here, she would laugh and lecture her on the act of love toward the opposite sex.
’Big sister is married to a Qilin male, perhaps one day, if I were to reunite with her, she will help me understand these feelings.’
Her gaze never left Kent as the days passed, still en route to the Ashfall Range.
Nine days later, Kaelith came to a stop just when they sensed a presence approaching them.
"That is Ignarok," Vey said, flying off Kaelith’s back. "Looks like he is angry."
The other monarchs nodded; however, Kent remained calm, looking toward the distance.
Fifteen minutes later, they saw a 600-meter-long black dragon speed toward them.
"He is not slowing down," Kaelith said, his body trembling at the sheer pressure coming from the dragon approaching them.
"This crazy lizard." Vey summoned her bow and was able to form an arrow when Kent tapped her on the shoulder to stop.
"I will handle him."
With one quick step, Kent appeared 600km away.
His bloodline surged, and his demi-dragon form appeared, causing the air around him to turn chaotic. The six monarchs standing in the distance felt their bloodlines suppressed instantly.
"This..." Kaelith muttered, feeling like he was but a bug under Kent’s aura.

"Don’t look surprised, Kaelith, he is not somebody any of us can measure up to, trust me," Sylvara said, hiding the fact that Kent is the Primordial Chaos Dragon that all beasts respect and look up to, to this very day.
Kent said he will tell them himself, so she could only get them thinking for now.
As expected, they all looked at Kent, wondering just what kind of existence he is.

’He is a dragon, that is for sure, but what kind of dragon is he to even make Ignarok that desperate?’ they said, looking in the distance where Ignarok, the strongest of the monarchs, slammed to the ground bearing the full weight of Kent’s bloodline suppression power.
Kent walks in the air, every step causing the pressure bearing down on Ignarok to increase.
"My sweetheart Sylvara asked me to beat the crap out of you for bullying her in the past, so no offense, but for this once let me simp and do what makes my lover happy."
Kent stepped into the air, and the pressure pressed down on Ignarok’s leg, breaking it.
"I will heal you after."
He took another step, and the second leg broke. With Kent’s pressure slamming down on him, Ignarok was back to his human form before he fell to the ground.
So breaking his bones has proven quite easy.
’So this is what using 35,000 Flame Veins and 9% of my bloodline can do.’
Kent thought, a rush of untamed energy rushing through his body.
’I wonder what will become of me after forming the Flame Core and the Blood Core Gate,’ Kent smiled, breaking Ignarok’s arm.

’Not forgetting, completely cultivating the first form of the Primal Body Tempering Art and even refining just one Blood Life Seal and Blood Death Seal, would undoubtedly cause my strength to explode.’
He took one more step, and the other arm broke.
Because of the pressure, Ignarok wasn’t healing. However, Kent had no pity in his eyes.

He is a dragon, and one would expect him to bond like brothers with Ignarok; however, the sly simp was currently fulfilling Sylvara’s wishes, so he could only relish the moment and make it up to him later.
"Next time, don’t bully others simply because you are stronger than they are." Kent crouches down beside Ignarok and, using his index finger, taps Ignarok’s wrist, breaking it.
This time, a painful roar escaped his mouth, but Kent merely smiled.
"There is always someone stronger than you out there. So don’t bully, instead protect if you can or run if it is beyond you."
With one more tap on the other wrist, Ignarok collapsed from sheer pain.
It was only after he collapsed that Kent deactivated his bloodline, taking away the suppression.
"Orvath, come carry him..."
Orvath nodded and carried Ignarok as they resumed their journey back to the Ashfall Range. A couple of hours later, they arrived and decided to wait for Ignarok to wake up.
Naturally, he woke up extremely angry, but when he saw Kent, he instantly calmed down.

chapters.title: Chapter 1003: Taming Quest (14) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So that is why I am here..." Kent said, looking at Ignarok, "What do you think? Do you want to join my campaign?"
Ignarok turns and looks at the six traitors who brought a calamity to his domain and asks, "Haven’t you losers... I mean, monarchs told him who he would be going against?"
Sylvara shrugs and turns away.
Phoenix Queen Vey smirked and chose not to answer simply because she only had insult in her mouth.
Zeraphine smiles and smirks.
Kaelith looked at Ignarok with brotherly eyes.
Orvath sighs and bends his head.
Balrion, however, smiled and said, "He is already aware, but you see what he can do, so perhaps he can kill him for good where we failed."
"What a blockhead." Ignarok chuckled, but Balrion said nothing despite being called a blockhead. He is used to Ignarok’s taunts and arrogance.
"Do you all think that bastard is simple? In case you are not aware, then let me tell you... He only allowed us to live because he needed our blood essence."
This time, the six monarchs became alert, some even suspecting that Ignarok’s words were true. They long thought about why the planet king let them live back there.
"Back when we faced him, he let us live because, as we all know, the forsaken race grows stronger by devouring the blood essence of others.
He wanted our blood essence, so he let us live. But that isn’t even what we should be concerned about.
Back then, while you losers were choking on your filthy blood, I had words with him, and from what he said, it appeared he only used 30% of his power to suppress us.
It turned out that the Supreme Energy in his bloodline is very dense. And as we all know, the Supreme Tiger Clan are renowned for their combat abilities and extremely dangerous bloodline powers
So tell me, do you really think this perhaps has what it takes to kill someone like that?"
"Yes."
Sylvara answered, a smile gracing her lips.
Kent blew her a kiss, which made Ignarok grit his teeth.
"You think this is funny?"
"Nobody said anything is funny. However, what makes you think that idiot has what it takes to measure up to me?" Kent chuckled and scanned the faces of the Monarchs staring at him.
"I think it is time you all know who I really am."
Hearing him, they all started to pay attention...
Kent smiled, knowing that telling them was the only way to win their trust and open more benefits for both their sake.
"All this talk about divine, supreme, and celestial beasts is just concepts used by people to show the hierarchy of power. They wish to use that hierarchy to suppress the weak.
In my eyes, it is but a useless scale," Kent smirked, causing the divine beasts around him to feel insulted. However, they said nothing...
Continue to listen to Kent...
"During the Primordial Era, beasts are known by how strong they are, not by their rank or their bloodline. I was but an ordinary boy with no parents or siblings.
As a young dragon, I was constantly at the mercy of those who claimed they were a great family with legacies stretching thousands of years.
Due to this, even a useless heir was able to look down on me. They had the power to ridicule and command me around. At first, I respected the hierarchy simply because it was a part of the culture.
However, one day, I said no, and so I decided to chase after strength, for I believe that with strength, nothing is impossible to achieve.
That was when the Primordial Chaos Dragon was born."
Everyone except Sylvara narrowed their eyes, looking at Kent.
Kent ignored their scrutiny and activated his bloodline. Then he lit his Chaos flame...
"In my eyes, strength is what matters, and as such, I believe I have what it takes to kill someone you all label as a Supreme Beast.
Or, do you Monarchs think a mere Tiger has what it takes to fight the Primordial Chaos Dragon?"

Perhaps hearing him say he is the primordial chaos dragon made them feel skeptical, but looking at the flame in his hand—a flame that legends speak of as the most dangerous in existence—lit before them, they knew deep in their bloodline that they were indeed in the presence of the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
This caused them to have immense respect for him. Kent could hear beeping sounds in his head, telling him their trust level was increasing at a rapid pace.
"I don’t understand," Zeraphine said and then asked, "I thought you died during the Great War."
The monarchs nodded, even Sylvara included.
Kent smiled and answered, "Death, as they say, is the beginning of a new life." He laughed.
"I died, that is true, but I wasn’t completely dead."
"I don’t understand," Vey asked, and Kent nodded.
"It is indeed complex; even I don’t completely understand why I am here today. However, I believe after recovering the memories of all my lives, I will get the answer."
"Wait, you have lived other lives?" Sylvara asked, her heartbeat increasing at a rapid pace. "Are you saying you have undergone a True Reincarnation multiple times?"
"I don’t know what that meant, but yes." Kent put on a smug smile, "I believe you all have heard of Lord Genesis."
"No way... Don’t tell me you were the father of swordsmen, the Divine Sword, the Genesis Swordsman, the Heir of the Sword Dao..." Orvath continued to list names, causing Kent to blush.
"I didn’t know I had that many names, but yes, that was me too. Also, I was the Faceless Assassin, too."
This time, all seven monarchs paled at the sound of him saying he was the infamous Faceless Assassin.
If Lord Genesis was the idol of many, then the Faceless Assassin was a danger nobody would see coming until it was too late.
To add to their shock, Kent put on the face of one of the people he had killed. This completely convinced them.
"Although I am not even a sliver of who I was back then yet, I believe when the time comes, this so-called Planet King wouldn’t know what hit him."
They all nodded.
Ignarok, on the other hand, went down on his knees and bowed, his forehead touching the ground,
"Forgive me, Lord Chaos. I was but a child who failed to recognize the ancestor’s greatness. Please give me a chance to atone for my sins... please, Lord Chaos."
It was already a known fact that every last dragon in existence claimed their ancestry came from the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
Perhaps it was because of that that many dragons, if not all, are so arrogant.
After all, during the Primordial Era, the Chaos Dragon was the supreme authority, and those who descended from him, as they claim, appeared powerful.
Kent watched Ignarok, and while he didn’t want to feel big, his bloodline made him smirk, but thankfully, his human side pulled him back...

"No need to ask for forgiveness, Ignarok, we are dragons, and it is in our blood not to lower our heads to anyone." Kent smiled, "I would have been disappointed if you lowered your head to me before learning who I was."
Ignarok smiled, hearing the compliment in Kent’s words.
"However, now that you know who I am, become my subordinate and aid me in conquering this so-called Planet King for good."
"I will do as you say, Lord Chaos."
"Very well." Kent smirked, "Let’s get right on it then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1004: Quest Complete [Bonus]
paragraphs: "And that is a wrap," Kent said, adding the last beast to his taming bracelet and activating all three benefits for them.
The moment the last beast was added, making 50, the quest was also complete, releasing all rewards to Kent’s soul Universe.
Kent saw all this, and all he could do was smile.
When he received the quest, he expected it to be extremely dangerous. However, aside from the initial battle with Sylvara and her subordinates, the rest were fairly easy.
Of course, he suffered some injuries from his duel with Balrion, but as more beasts were added to his taming bracelet, his strength also grew explosive.
Now that the quest was completed, all the beasts Kent had added to his taming bracelet felt their strength rise by 800%, while Kent received a 1,200% increase.
The feeling alone was enough to tell the 50 beasts they had made the right choice.
"Ignarok, I will need seven more female dragons. Each should be a Tier 19 beast."
"I will handle that, Lord Chaos."
Kent nodded, and Ignarok left.
If Kent is anything, then that will be Overprotective.
He knew he would soon be leaving the past behind and probably wouldn’t return for a while, so he wanted to ensure that those he planned to share his full name with would be protected.
He had already secured protection for Commander Agnes, but there are others, too, so he is planning to use the Supreme Beast Contracts to tame some beasts for them.
Only then would he be okay leaving them in the past.
Kent has things to do in the future, too, so he can only leave the past in safe hands. Who knows, one of these days, he might just need help, and one of these beasts will be nearby to help him.
"So what next?" Sylvara asked.
"Thanks to Kaelith, I still have 10 days to spend here. Since all ingredients for the Soul Strengthening Pill have been found, I will start working on those pills."
"Can I watch?" Sylvara asked again with puppy eyes. Clearly, her humanity has reached a new level, making her extremely cute.
"Of course."
"Can I also watch?" Vey asked, making sure Kent knew she was there as well.
Of course, Sylvara glared at her, but Kent allowed her to stay. In the end, Zeraphine also joined them, with the male Monarch joining Ignarok to look for the rest of the ingredients.
Kent didn’t mind this arrangement.
Having beauties by his side as he works on concocting pills isn’t too bad.
This time, he would be using his Tier 13 Soul Flame, so the process was bound to go smoothly.
In no time, Kent started working on making pills.
Meanwhile, back on Planet Nictus, Lady Kami and her daughter, Lady Azela, stood at the sect’s entrance, gazing at three figures who were glaring back at them.
"I don’t suppose we have any meetings with the likes of you," Lady Kami said, her tone cold and foul as she looked at a figure she would rather not want to interact with.
The person is not a human or an Elf but a Vampire. He is pale, with crimson eyes, flowing red-black robes, and silver fangs.
He is General Dravos, one of the six generals under the Planet King, a formidable figure by all standards.
"General Dravos, forgive my mother. She is in a rather bad mood after some men under General Veynor came and took away the soul puppet we wasted half our fortune on."
Lady Azela said, holding her mom back.
She knew, despite her acting, her mom was fed up with these people, so activating the ’Damned Eye of Fate’ formation is just a hand seal away.

She didn’t want that to happen because, although she might succeed in killing one general, there are five more and several million warriors out there that can bring her sect to its knees within minutes.
Sometimes, diplomacy is the most effective approach.
General Dravos smiled, "I understand, Lady Azela. However, I didn’t come here to take something from you but rather to extend an invitation to you and your mother."
General Dravos took out two envelopes made from leather and tossed them toward the mother and daughter.
They caught it, and in order to be done so, this hateful person could leave them alone; they opened the envelopes.
However, when they saw the contents, their faces paled, and anger bubbled up in their hearts.
Lightning surged in Lady Azela’s hand, reducing the contents in the envelope to nothing. Her mother also opened her palm, and flames surged, burning the letter.
However, General Dravos merely laughed.

"In three months, people will come to pick you up. Being selected as brides for the Planet King should be an honour." With a laughter so loud that most of the disciples who heard it felt their bodies tense, General Dravos’s bat wing opened, and he took to the sky.
"The wedding dress will be sent over in two weeks."
With that, he left with his two aides.
"Bastard... I will rather die than let myself become a wife to such filth of a man," Lady Kami cursed, her expression contorting to one that was rather unbecoming for such a beauty.
"Who is there?" A bolt of lightning shot from Lady Azela’s eyes as she turned in a certain direction. However, it was neutralised by an invisible person.
"Relax, Sect Leader, I come in peace." Commander Agnes stepped out of thin air, Yu Lan, her beast companion, following.
"Commander Agnes, sorry for attacking you... It was a lapse in judgment," Lady Azela apologised.
"Don’t worry about it, Sect Leader. I should be the one apologising for intruding on your private matter."
Lady Kami stepped before her daughter, shielding her. As a mother, it is her right to protect her daughter from someone she senses poses a danger to her.
This person, of course, is Yu Lan, who, because of the lightning attack, held a hostile look in her eyes.
"Relax, Yu Lan, they are friends."
It was only after Commander Agnes said that she relaxed.
"Please, how can we be of help to you today?" Lady Kami asked.
"Nothing too serious. I am just here to deliver a message."
"A message." The mother and daughter furrowed their brows. "From who?"
"His name is Kent."
"What. Is he alright? Did something happen to him?" The two ladies became happy upon hearing a familiar name, but they couldn’t help but worry.
Commander Agnes seemed surprised by their reaction, but she merely smiled and answered.
"Kent is fine... well, more than fine if you ask me. He is like a shark swimming in the Flame Sea." She chuckled.
Even now, she couldn’t wrap her mind around how someone who is only at the Core Formation stage could tame and get chummy with a Monarch.
"Please, what is the message?" Lady Azela asked.
"A rather shameless message, but because he saved me, I will say exactly what he said I should say." Commander Agnes’s cheeks turned red from sheer embarrassment.
"He said I should tell you, and I quote, ’Lady Azela, don’t miss me too much. I promise to come back to you soon and, like I promised, I will take you off your mom’s hands.
Of course, if you can put in a few words for me, I might just make it a mother-daughter affair. See you later, and you can trust Commander Agnes and her overly protective sister Yu Lan.’"
By the time she was done, the mother and daughter couldn’t find a place to hide their embarrassed expressions.
Yu Lan stood behind Commander Agnes, her expression calm, but she couldn’t help wondering why these ladies looked like their cheeks were about to explode.

chapters.title: Chapter 1005: Leaving The Flame Sea
paragraphs: Five days later, Kent had concocted over a hundred Soul Strengthening Pills and 57 Limit Breaker Pills.
"Is that the last of them?" Sylvara asked, cleaning the sweat off Kent’s forehead.
"Yes. The ingredients are used up, and since two major ingredients are still missing, I cannot concoct the Innate Talent Awakening Pill.
However, once we get back to the human world, I will purchase them and work on that."

All seven monarchs are around this time. They had worked hard to gather all the ingredients for the Innate Awakening Pill, after some of their subordinates reported that they had discovered other herbs.
However, there were still two ingredients short.
However, there are enough Soul Strengthening Pills and Limit Breaker Pills to help them become much stronger.
Kent waved his hand, and all 50 beasts he had tamed appeared. Kent wanted to brief them before they left, so he called them over.
"First of all, I would like to thank you all for helping with searching for the ingredients. I only wanted ingredients for two pills, but you all outdid yourselves.
Now, I have rewards for you all.

However, please note that we will be leaving this place soon. This means the chances of you all coming back here are virtually nonexistent. But fear not, where we are going is full of life and advantages that I am sure you all will enjoy greatly."
They all seemed happy hearing Kent speak.
"But before you all ask, know that in the coming weeks, we will be taking on a series of adventures. These adventures promise to make you all grow much stronger.
For now, take these pills and return to your living space. Use them to strengthen yourselves."
Kent waved his hand, and each of the 50 beasts received a Limit Breaker Pill and two Soul Strengthening Pills.
"Take the green pills first before the blue ones."
They nodded, and they all vanished into the Taming Bracelet, leaving only Kent and the seven monarchs.
"Use the time to work on your soul first, before breaking the 30th limit, which will be your limit for this world. Once the Planet King is dead, you will prepare to ascend to an Immortal World.
By then, I will have enough ingredients to make more Limit Breaker Pills for you." They nodded and vanished into the bracelet, leaving Kent alone.

"Though it won’t work on me, testing won’t harm me too." He tossed a Soul Strengthening Pill into his mouth, but as expected, when he swallowed it, he only felt a strand of soul energy wash into his body.
"Ahhh, what was I expecting?" Kent laughed and tossed the Limit Breaker Pill, which also did nothing to him.
However, instead of frowning, he only smiled, knowing there were millions of Limit Breaker Points waiting for him to use in the future.
"Since that is the case, then I might as well leave now."
Kent walked out and then retrieved the return talisman.
"It’s been a blast, Flame Sea. Maybe one day I will come back here, but until then, farewell and goodbye."
With that, he turned into a beam of light and shot toward the sky...
[Planet Cosima’s Moon]
Thousands of warriors, sellers, and buyers were going about their daily activities as if there was no tomorrow.
The moon is the safest place for those who dare venture into the Flame sea, so they are all protected.
Many were planning to head to the Flame Sea and try their luck, while many were buying loot from the adventurers who had returned.
Of course, none of them was aware that the big shots in the Flame Sea were no more.
Well... even if they knew, that didn’t mean there was a shortage of Tier 19 beasts there.

The Flame Sea was still dangerous, and now with the Monarchs gone, it was bound to turn even more chaotic. New leadership would need to be selected, and this process was likely to be chaotic in the months to come.
Kent, who nobody would have expected to last a second there, suddenly appeared, drawing attention from hungry buyers.
Whenever a person appeared from the Flame Sea, they scrambled around them to buy loot. However, when they saw Kent, many could only smirk, with some narrowing their eyes at him.
"Some people are born lucky. It seems this brat is one of them, having survived such a place," a man said.
"Indeed. Just look at how bony he looks. I am sure he suffered greatly, but his luck saved him."
"Lucky brat. But still, let’s see if we can get some loot from him."
Just when these hungry buyers were making their way toward Kent, a man appeared before Kent and took his hand, dragging him away.
When the buyers saw this, they resigned and walked away.
Inside the very store that Kent bought the talismans from when he was heading to the Flame Sea, he stood, gazing back at the seller.
"So you return," the man said.
Kent grinned.
"Told you I would return, old man."
The man smiled. "I guess you did. Luck seems to be on your side."
Kent shook his head and smiled. "I guess so."
The man could only shake his head and smile. He is happy to see Kent back and well. He never expected him to ever return, not with his weak cultivation.
Kent waved his hand, and Silver Flame Crystals, about 600kg, and five violet lotuses appeared.
"Like I said before leaving, here are your souvenirs." The man was left stunned, looking at these items. He waved his hand, and the shop door slammed shut.
"Kid, where did you get these items?"
Kent smiled. "Let’s just say I was lucky enough to meet a kind man down there. He claimed he was a monarch and that he liked the way I sang, so he invited me to his domain.
It turned out it was his birthday, and he wanted me to perform. After performing, he gave me this." Kent pointed at the Silver Flame Crystals he got from Orvath’s domain.
"Later, a guest at the birthday celebration who saw my talent in music also invited me to her domain. She only wanted me to sing a happy song for her pet butterfly.

After my sterling performance, she gave me these lotus flowers. Now, since you helped me, I can only repay you like I promised." Kent smiled, his expression that of a kid who had returned from somewhere many claimed was no man’s land.
The old man, who went by the name Rudolf, stared at Kent with widened eyes. The story Kent told was of no importance to him; it was the characters in the story that caught his interest.
’He met the Silver Flame Minotaur Monarch and the Violet Flame Lotus Monarch and lived to tell the tale.’
Kent’s image in his mind had been raised to a whole different level. To him, Kent was now someone who had done the impossible.
"Kid, do you know just one of these flowers or even a kilogram of these crystals is enough to cause a great battle to break out on this moon? Are you sure you want to give me all these?"
"I have no use for them, so take them. Of course, if you think it is still too much, then take it as a down payment for when we meet again in the future.
For now, I need to go back home before my sister starts freaking out," Kent said, beginning to walk toward the door.
"Kid, I never caught your name. At least let me know the name of my benefactor."
Kent grinned, a mischievous look appearing on his face. "You can call me Kent... Kent Madson."
After saying that, Kent opened the door and walked away.
"Kent Madson, huh... I will never forget this name."
A few hours later, Kent left the moon and headed back to Planet Nictus. From there, he would take a detour to Planet Drakthys, where he would rescue Yuna before heading back to Planet Pyris.
Pill Monarch Nefeli was waiting for him so they could head to the Pill Ascension Competition.

sentences.text: Five days later, Kent had concocted over a hundred Soul Strengthening Pills and 57 Limit Breaker Pills.
"Is that the last of them?" Sylvara asked, cleaning the sweat off Kent’s forehead.
"Yes.
The ingredients are used up, and since two major ingredients are still missing, I cannot concoct the Innate Talent Awakening Pill.
However, once we get back to the human world, I will purchase them and work on that."
All seven monarchs are around this time.
They had worked hard to gather all the ingredients for the Innate Awakening Pill, after some of their subordinates reported that they had discovered other herbs.
However, there were still two ingredients short.
However, there are enough Soul Strengthening Pills and Limit Breaker Pills to help them become much stronger.
Kent waved his hand, and all 50 beasts he had tamed appeared.
Kent wanted to brief them before they left, so he called them over.
"First of all, I would like to thank you all for helping with searching for the ingredients.
I only wanted ingredients for two pills, but you all outdid yourselves.
Now, I have rewards for you all.
However, please note that we will be leaving this place soon.
This means the chances of you all coming back here are virtually nonexistent.
But fear not, where we are going is full of life and advantages that I am sure you all will enjoy greatly."
They all seemed happy hearing Kent speak.
"But before you all ask, know that in the coming weeks, we will be taking on a series of adventures.
These adventures promise to make you all grow much stronger.
For now, take these pills and return to your living space.
Use them to strengthen yourselves."

"Use the time to work on your soul first, before breaking the 30th limit, which will be your limit for this world.
Once the Planet King is dead, you will prepare to ascend to an Immortal World.

However, instead of frowning, he only smiled, knowing there were millions of Limit Breaker Points waiting for him to use in the future.

Maybe one day I will come back here, but until then, farewell and goodbye."

It seems this brat is one of them, having survived such a place," a man said.
"Indeed.
Just look at how bony he looks.
I am sure he suffered greatly, but his luck saved him."

chapters.title: Chapter 1006: Back to Planet Nictus
paragraphs: "Kid, you actually returned alive."
Kent yet again stood under the appraising gaze of the man who sold him the ticket when he was leaving for Planet Cosima.
Back then, the man tried to persuade him not to go to such a place. However, Kent was keen on going, so in the end, he let him join the ship without paying a dime.
Now, after a month, Kent again stood before him, only that this time, he had returned from Planet Cosima alive and healthy.
"No need to look shocked, big man, I am not easily killed." Kent laughed. It is perfectly normal to assume someone like him will be food to the weakest beast in the flame sea.
After all, he is very weak, considering he is at the Core Formation stage.
However, Kent is no weakling, and the man can see that now.
"How did you survive there?" the man asked, and just as he had with Old Rudolf back on the Moon, he told the man a story that left him wondering just what kind of existence Kent is.
"You are one lucky bastard, kid."
"True. But I am happy I was able to make it back. I won’t be going back there for a while, at least."
"You really shouldn’t. Use this experience as a lesson to strive for greatness. You have had one hell of an adventure, kid."
Kent nodded and retrieved a space ring from his soul universe and handed it over to the man. "Take it as a token of your generosity and the care you have shown me." Kent handed the ring to him.
"You can call me Kent Madson, by the way."
After saying that, he left.
The man, who went by Charles, looked into the space ring and froze. He looked to call Kent back and ask him some questions, but he was nowhere in sight.
Charles looked in the space ring again, double-checking to see if he was seeing correctly.
"No way, right... He didn’t actually kill this many beasts."

Inside the space rings are the body parts of some of the beasts he had killed. Kent is already aware of how valuable these body parts are to blacksmiths, so he allowed the Monarchs and the rest of his tamed beasts to harvest these body parts.
Thankfully, Sylvara had many space rings from the many humans she had killed in the past.
He packed everything into one and gave it to Charles, who had helped him in the past without even knowing him.
Kent stood 2000 km away, looking at Charles through the Soul Map. "It is your good fortune to meet me, Charles. In the future, let’s meet again."
After saying that, he went to the nearest teleportation platform and quickly made his way back to the Heaven’s Eye Sect.
"Stop right there," a guard at the entrance stopped Kent just as he reached the entrance. He could have used the Soul Map to teleport, but he didn’t.
"Name and ID, please."
Kent smiled and said, "Kindly tell the sect leader Kent is here to visit."
The guard shuddered and quickly changed his expression when he heard Kent’s name...
"I am sorry, Mr. Kent. The sect leader is waiting for your arrival."
"Oh." Kent furrowed his brow. ’It seems she couldn’t wait to see me again.’

Kent smiled, feeling good about himself. He thought Lady Azela might be missing him too much that she couldn’t wait for him to return, so she made sure nobody blocked his path when getting back to the sect.
With a path opened for him, Kent entered the sect and, using the Soul Map, he vanished, appearing in Lady Kami’s residence.
The moment he appeared, the gate leading to the mansion opened, and four people rushed out, ready to battle. However, upon seeing who dared intrude, they calmed down...
"Kent, you are back." Lady Azela shouted, almost running to go hug him, but she held herself back.
Kent saw this and smiled. "I am indeed back. Did you miss me?"
None of them minded him.
"Commander Agnes, fancy seeing you here. You too, Yu Lan."
"Great to see you again, Kent," Commander Agnes said.
"Likewise."
After delivering Kent’s message to the mother and her daughter, she decided to stay and, using Yu Lan’s strength, protect them for as long as Kent was away...
She sent words to her superiors that she would be staying in the Heaven’s Eye Sect for a while.
Although they wondered why, having delivered a cure for their strongest general, they allowed her to do as she pleased.
Of course, her status as a princess also contributed to her getting this princess treatment. So she had been with the sect leader and her mother for the past few days.
They entered the mansion, where Kent was bombarded with many questions. After answering the ones he could, he asked how they were...

It was then that they informed him about the Planet King’s offer, which they knew they couldn’t reject, for the lives of the thousands of disciples in their sect would be in danger if they dared to refuse becoming his brides...
However, Kent merely smirked, hearing the worry in their tone...
"No need to worry about that bastard... I will handle him soon enough," Kent said, making them aware of his plans to kill the bastard...
"For now, go about your normal activities. In 3 months’ time, he will be dead, and you will be free to live your life to the fullest."
Kent waved his hand, and two Golden Keys appeared in the air. He channeled his energy into them, and a dragon and a phoenix appeared in their human form.
This startled the four ladies. Even Yu Lan was startled...
"Bring your hands," Kent said, asking for Lady Kami and her daughter’s hands. They obeyed and stretched their hands.
Kent took their blood and dropped it on the keys. Lady Kami’s blood landed on the key for the dragon, and her daughter got the phoenix...
Soon, the contract was formed, and they each received a supreme-grade technique.
"I will be leaving for a month. While I am away, your new best friends will protect you. Of course, if it is beyond them, these guys will handle it."
Kent waved his hand again, and 43 more beasts in their human form appeared.
On his way to Planet Nictus, he thought long and hard about whether he should send all 50 beasts to the Pill Ascension Realm.
However, after a few internal struggles, he decided against it and instead chose to leave them behind. The seven Monarchs were enough for whatever awaited him there.
Now, he knew where to leave them.
"Who are these people?" Lady Kami asked, feeling like a bug before the terrifying beasts standing behind Kent.
"They are my friends," Kent laughed, before adding, "In any case, they will protect you two until I return. For now, relax and live life like there is no tomorrow."
Kent turned toward Commander Agnes. "Bring the general you talked about here 40 days from now. I want to have a meeting with her."
"Okay."
"Where are you going next?" Lady Azela asked, feeling reluctant to part with Kent.
Seeing this, Kent walked toward her and hugged her, pulling her much closer to him, feeling her boobs pressed against his chest.
"My big sister is waiting for me so we can head to the Pill Ascension competition we talked about. Don’t worry, I have people who will protect me."
He planted a kiss on her forehead, causing her to blush.
Kent then moved toward Lady Kami and kissed her forehead, too.
He repeated the same thing with Commander Agnes.
"You ladies should wait for me. When I return, we will spend some quality time together."
They nodded, and after Kent handled some other things, he left.
His next stop was Planet Drakthys to rescue Yuna, someone who would play a big role in his future.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007: Rescuing Yuna
paragraphs: "Yuna, use your flame to keep heating the cauldron. Don’t stop until I tell you to," a bearded man with a face tattoo and stern expression said, staring at a pale young lady whose blue flame was heating a large cauldron at a rather high temperature.
From the look of this, the man, who was a Spirit King, was working on a Tier 11 pill, something someone at his level shouldn’t attempt.
Of course, as an ambitious man looking to become a Pill Emperor, he was working around the clock to concoct a Tier 11 pill using Yuna’s help.
In essence, he was merely cheating his way by creating a pill that would push him closer to his goal.
But it doesn’t matter how one sees it.
This level of alchemy was beyond a young girl who was merely a Pill Saint and was rather fragile.
Looking at how she was profusely sweating, one could tell she had reached her limit long ago, but because of the fear she had for her master, she couldn’t bring herself to stop.
Of course, on the surface, she was a disciple of a Pill King, but in reality, she was but a slave chained to her master. There was no escape for her.
"You are slowing down, Yuna. Increase your flame before I snap."
Yuna shuddered and then, against her own body and soul, screaming at her, she increased her flame.
As someone with the Soul Purifying Flame, she was like an asset that nobody would reject. Her flame was ideal for making pills.
Of course, nobody is aware that she has the legendary Divine Pill Body that any Alchemist will kill to possess.
Not even her master, which is probably a good thing.
In fact, not even Yuna was aware of how special she was.
If she had known, perhaps she wouldn’t have chased after a Pill King simply to become his disciple.
"YUNA..."
The Pill King shouted as Yuna was dozing off. It seemed she had reached the point where staying conscious was no longer possible.
However, under such a shout, she straightened up and kept going.
Suddenly, a voice entered their ears, causing both to turn toward the entrance leading to the Pill Room.
"You really should learn how to treat a lady well."
Kent stood, his arms crossed over his chest, a disdainful expression plastered on his face as his cold eyes stared into the Pill King’s eyes.
Naturally, the Pill King broke into a cold sweat under such a vicious gaze.
POOF
The momentary scariness caused his flame to fluctuate, which, at the critical junction he was at, caused the pill to explode, destroying his three hours of hard work.
This suddenly wiped the fear he felt for Kent, causing him to call out...
"Who the hell are you. Look what you have done?" He reached beyond Kent. "Somebody, get rid of this trash."
Kent didn’t say anything and stood there for a full minute. When nobody came, he smiled evilly and waved his hand, bringing out fifteen golden blood essences.
"Nobody is coming, scum. I killed them all, and here is their blood essence." Kent waved his hand, and the soul flag appeared. Then, with a shake, fifteen soul spirits appeared.
"What..."
The Pill King stepped back, feeling his resolve shatter and his mind go numb as he stared at 15 soul spirits of people he knew.
"Don’t despair yet. This is merely the appetizer, the main course hasn’t begun... scum."
Kent opened his arm and called out to Yuna, "Come here and stand behind me."
Perhaps, like the saying goes, ’sometimes, it is better to go to bed with evil to fight the devil.’ Yuna didn’t hesitate.
Seeing someone completely shatter the resolve of her master, Yuna knew it was time to jump ship, so she took Kent’s hand without any hesitation.
"Smart girl."
Kent smiled at her and then looked toward the Pill King...
"You are going to die a very painful death, and there is no one coming to your aid." Kent waved his hand again, and the soul spirits vanished alongside the blood essence.
Although forming the Blood Core Gate requires only blood essence from beasts, cultivating the Primal Body Tempering Art can use any blood essence.
Of course, he had yet to have his first blood bath to cleanse his body, but that could wait for now.
Kent snapped his finger, and the Umbral Flame of Oblivion appeared, burning with its dull black radiance.
The moment the Pill King saw the flame, his body tensed, and a fear he never knew he could feel overwhelmed his senses.
"Please have mercy on me... Please."
Tears started streaming down his face.
Kent merely scoffed and looked at Yuna...
"Should I show mercy?"
Yuna froze for a second before a look of disdain and anger was bottled up in her body. "Kill him. He showed no mercy when I asked for one, so please kill him."
It was only after Yuna answered the question that she realized the slave contract between her and the Pill King was broken.
This caused her to look at Kent, who had turned back to the Pill King. ’Just who is this person?’
"She wants you dead. I want you dead, and her hidden guardian also wants you dead, so you are going to die."
With a wave of his hand again, the flame flew and engulfed the Pill King.
His painful screams gushed out, causing Yuna to move closer and plant her face on Kent’s back. She didn’t have the heart to watch all this.
Kent understood that, so he snapped his finger and a vacuum closed in on the Pill King, masking his painful cries.
One hour later, his charred body was left in the pill room; no traces of the Umbral Flame of Oblivion remained on his body.
Meanwhile, Kent disguised Yuna using the Soul Universe, and they had already booked a VIP ticket back to Planet Pyris.
4 days later, they arrived in Pyris City and quickly made their way to the Pyris Pill Pagoda, where Pill Monarch Nefeli was waiting for him.

When they reached the Pagoda, Kent saw about 15 Pill Saints, Sages, and Kings around. He immediately recognized them as the people who had qualified from the Pyris Pill Alliance to participate in the Pill Ascension competition.

Since he wasn’t coming to them, he quickly made his way past the 5th floor. When they reached the 7th floor, they were stopped, but Kent flashed the badge his big sister gave him, and they were allowed entry.
In no time, they arrived on the 9th floor.
"Took you long enough." Pill Monarch had already been informed that Kent had arrived from the moment they arrived at the Transfer Channel.
"Big sister. Glad to see you are beautiful and healthy as ever," Kent said, but he was ignored completely.
"Who is this young lady?" Pill Monarch Nefeli asked. Kent smiled and removed Yuna’s disguise.
"Her name is Yuna, your new sister."
"Errrh."
Both Pill Monarch Nefeli and Yuna became startled. None of them was made aware of this arrangement; however, Kent had a fix.
"Long story short, the Grand Pill Tablet told me to rescue her from her scum master and deliver her to you, who, from what I sense from the Grand Pill Tablet, seems to hold you in high regard.
You can go talk to her later, but for now, be happy. Yuna will be staying with you from now onwards."
Pill Monarch Nefeli went through a range of emotions for a moment before calming down...
"You are late... we’d better get going..."
Pill Monarch Nefeli looked at Yuna. "Disguise her again. She is coming with us."

sentences.text: "Yuna, use your flame to keep heating the cauldron.
Don’t stop until I tell you to," a bearded man with a face tattoo and stern expression said, staring at a pale young lady whose blue flame was heating a large cauldron at a rather high temperature.
From the look of this, the man, who was a Spirit King, was working on a Tier 11 pill, something someone at his level shouldn’t attempt.
Of course, as an ambitious man looking to become a Pill Emperor, he was working around the clock to concoct a Tier 11 pill using Yuna’s help.
In essence, he was merely cheating his way by creating a pill that would push him closer to his goal.
But it doesn’t matter how one sees it.
This level of alchemy was beyond a young girl who was merely a Pill Saint and was rather fragile.
Looking at how she was profusely sweating, one could tell she had reached her limit long ago, but because of the fear she had for her master, she couldn’t bring herself to stop.
Of course, on the surface, she was a disciple of a Pill King, but in reality, she was but a slave chained to her master.
There was no escape for her.
"You are slowing down, Yuna.
Increase your flame before I snap."
Yuna shuddered and then, against her own body and soul, screaming at her, she increased her flame.
As someone with the Soul Purifying Flame, she was like an asset that nobody would reject.
Her flame was ideal for making pills.
Of course, nobody is aware that she has the legendary Divine Pill Body that any Alchemist will kill to possess.
Not even her master, which is probably a good thing.
In fact, not even Yuna was aware of how special she was.
If she had known, perhaps she wouldn’t have chased after a Pill King simply to become his disciple.
"YUNA..."
The Pill King shouted as Yuna was dozing off.
It seemed she had reached the point where staying conscious was no longer possible.
However, under such a shout, she straightened up and kept going.
Suddenly, a voice entered their ears, causing both to turn toward the entrance leading to the Pill Room.
"You really should learn how to treat a lady well."
Kent stood, his arms crossed over his chest, a disdainful expression plastered on his face as his cold eyes stared into the Pill King’s eyes.
Naturally, the Pill King broke into a cold sweat under such a vicious gaze.
POOF
The momentary scariness caused his flame to fluctuate, which, at the critical junction he was at, caused the pill to explode, destroying his three hours of hard work.
This suddenly wiped the fear he felt for Kent, causing him to call out...
"Who the hell are you.
Look what you have done?" He reached beyond Kent.
"Somebody, get rid of this trash."
Kent didn’t say anything and stood there for a full minute.
When nobody came, he smiled evilly and waved his hand, bringing out fifteen golden blood essences.
"Nobody is coming, scum.
I killed them all, and here is their blood essence." Kent waved his hand, and the soul flag appeared.
Then, with a shake, fifteen soul spirits appeared.
"What..."
The Pill King stepped back, feeling his resolve shatter and his mind go numb as he stared at 15 soul spirits of people he knew.
"Don’t despair yet.
This is merely the appetizer, the main course hasn’t begun... scum."
Kent opened his arm and called out to Yuna, "Come here and stand behind me."
Perhaps, like the saying goes, ’sometimes, it is better to go to bed with evil to fight the devil.’ Yuna didn’t hesitate.
Seeing someone completely shatter the resolve of her master, Yuna knew it was time to jump ship, so she took Kent’s hand without any hesitation.
"Smart girl."
Kent smiled at her and then looked toward the Pill King...
"You are going to die a very painful death, and there is no one coming to your aid." Kent waved his hand again, and the soul spirits vanished alongside the blood essence.
Although forming the Blood Core Gate requires only blood essence from beasts, cultivating the Primal Body Tempering Art can use any blood essence.
Of course, he had yet to have his first blood bath to cleanse his body, but that could wait for now.
Kent snapped his finger, and the Umbral Flame of Oblivion appeared, burning with its dull black radiance.
The moment the Pill King saw the flame, his body tensed, and a fear he never knew he could feel overwhelmed his senses.
"Please have mercy on me...
Please."
Tears started streaming down his face.
Kent merely scoffed and looked at Yuna...
"Should I show mercy?"
Yuna froze for a second before a look of disdain and anger was bottled up in her body.
"Kill him.
He showed no mercy when I asked for one, so please kill him."
It was only after Yuna answered the question that she realized the slave contract between her and the Pill King was broken.
This caused her to look at Kent, who had turned back to the Pill King. ’Just who is this person?’
"She wants you dead.
I want you dead, and her hidden guardian also wants you dead, so you are going to die."
With a wave of his hand again, the flame flew and engulfed the Pill King.
His painful screams gushed out, causing Yuna to move closer and plant her face on Kent’s back.
She didn’t have the heart to watch all this.
Kent understood that, so he snapped his finger and a vacuum closed in on the Pill King, masking his painful cries.
One hour later, his charred body was left in the pill room; no traces of the Umbral Flame of Oblivion remained on his body.
Meanwhile, Kent disguised Yuna using the Soul Universe, and they had already booked a VIP ticket back to Planet Pyris.
4 days later, they arrived in Pyris City and quickly made their way to the Pyris Pill Pagoda, where Pill Monarch Nefeli was waiting for him.
When they reached the Pagoda, Kent saw about 15 Pill Saints, Sages, and Kings around.
He immediately recognized them as the people who had qualified from the Pyris Pill Alliance to participate in the Pill Ascension competition.
Since he wasn’t coming to them, he quickly made his way past the 5th floor.
When they reached the 7th floor, they were stopped, but Kent flashed the badge his big sister gave him, and they were allowed entry.
In no time, they arrived on the 9th floor.
"Took you long enough." Pill Monarch had already been informed that Kent had arrived from the moment they arrived at the Transfer Channel.
"Big sister.
Glad to see you are beautiful and healthy as ever," Kent said, but he was ignored completely.
"Who is this young lady?" Pill Monarch Nefeli asked.
Kent smiled and removed Yuna’s disguise.
"Her name is Yuna, your new sister."
"Errrh."
Both Pill Monarch Nefeli and Yuna became startled.
None of them was made aware of this arrangement; however, Kent had a fix.
"Long story short, the Grand Pill Tablet told me to rescue her from her scum master and deliver her to you, who, from what I sense from the Grand Pill Tablet, seems to hold you in high regard.
You can go talk to her later, but for now, be happy.
Yuna will be staying with you from now onwards."
Pill Monarch Nefeli went through a range of emotions for a moment before calming down...
"You are late... we’d better get going..."
Pill Monarch Nefeli looked at Yuna.
"Disguise her again.
She is coming with us."

chapters.title: Chapter 1008: Going to the Pill Ascension Competition [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Have you heard? According to news running around, there is a high chance a High Grade Primordial Flame will appear this time," a Pill King said, standing beside three other Pill Kings.
"I also heard the same news. Makes me wonder just what has changed this year," the second Pill King, a female, said.
"I think it will have something to do with the battle that happened there 15 years ago," the third Pill King also joined in.
"Are you talking about the one between those brats from the Solaryn Pill Alliance and Lunareth Pill Alliance?" the fourth Pill King asked, and the third Pill King nodded.
The Solaryn Pill Alliance is the top-ranked Pill Alliance in the ten Pill Worlds system. They have three Pill Legends, which give them immense power.

However, the Lunareth Pill Alliance, being the second-ranked Pill Alliance, is no pushover either. They have two Pill Legends and a foundation so solid that it doesn’t pale in comparison to the Solaryn Pill Alliance.
Fifteen years ago, when the Pill Ascension Realm opened, a devastating battle broke out between these two factions, resulting in numerous deaths.
This battle was triggered by a Medium-Grade Primordial Flame and the Heavens Jinsing Flower, a Tier 16 pill ingredient that is said to have given birth to a herb spirit, making it sentient.
Because of this battle, many places in the Pill Ascension Realm were damaged, bringing the danger level there to a new height.
"I wonder how many Pill Emperors will qualify again to enter. The last time, only three qualified from our faction, leading to us getting only one Primordial Flame and seven Tier 14 herbs.
This time, I pray we get more than that."
"Me too. However, with the top two factions at war, who knows what will become of us?"
"Maybe we should focus on actually qualifying to enter before thinking about all this."
Although none of them dares to say it, they are scared. But of course they should be. They are heading to a place where even a herb can kill them. If that is not scary enough, then what is?
"Look, it is Pill Monarch Nefeli." Suddenly, someone shouted, pointing at the green-haired beauty walking out toward them.
"Who is that kid beside him?"
Naturally, that kid is Kent, who wore a smug smile walking shoulder to shoulder with Pill Monarch Nefeli. Yuna was hidden behind the two, so nobody saw her.
"I think that is the kid who won the duel against that arrogant Pill Saint."
"But that kid was a Pill Grandmaster. Look at his badge, he is a Pill Saint."
"No way," suddenly, a Pill King said, narrowing his eyes.
"Look at his badge, it is Platinum."
"No way."
"Does that mean he was promoted to the Pill Saint stage and even holds the authority of a Platinum Pill Saint?"
"Damn. Who is this kid, and why haven’t I seen him before?"

"I know him. He was the one who identified the Tier 12 pill from Tier 9 ingredients back when Pill King Han Lu and Pill King Yota had their duel. I believe his name is Pill Grandmaster... I mean Pill Saint Kent."
"It was he who defeated Pill Saint Flura."
"I think so. And it seems he was promoted to the Pill Saint stage."
"I think so too. But I believe he deserves it. I mean, someone who was able to concoct a Tier 9 pill with a low-grade grey pill ring deserves his current rank."
Obviously, many were happy, but a few who think they are better than everyone silently seethe in their hearts.
Kent and Pill Monarch Nefeli arrived at the gathering. It was then that many saw Yuna.
Kent smiled and made a mental note to buy Yuna a dagger. ’She will make a fine Assassin.’
The 15 alchemists around bowed when Pill Monarch Nefeli arrived. However, she just waved them to stand up.
"The Pill Emperors had taken the lead to secure slots for us, so we should get moving." With a wave of her hand, a beautiful ship appeared and hovered 2 meters off the ground.
She then turned toward Kent and spoke to everyone, "This is Pill Saint Kent. He will be joining us, and if he manages to pass the trial, he will enter the Pill Ascension Realm with you.
Treat him as your little brother and protect him if you can."
"Yes, Pill Monarch."
Kent smiled and waved at his new big brother and sisters, "I will be under your care, seniors."
Kent walked away from Pill Monarch Nefeli and stood with the alchemists he knew wanted to know him better before stabbing him in the back.
"Let’s go."
They jumped on the ship, and soon, it was away from Planet Pyris, heading toward Planet Solaryn, which is just 6 hours away.
[Planet Aerithyne - Yanki Great Pill House - Pill Sage Flura’s POV]

"Father, you know you don’t have to come with me, right? I will be travelling with 24 powerful and capable alchemists. I don’t need my Pill Monarch father drawing attention to me," Pill Sage Flura said, smiling at her father, who decided to accompany his daughter to Planet Solaryn.
She was recently promoted to Pill Sage, but it is only a matter of time before she becomes a Pill King.
"I know you will be safe with them, but I will still come," her father said, wearing a small smile.
"Does this have something to do with Pill Grandmaster Kent?" she asked. Of course, she is not aware Kent has reached the Pill Saint stage.
"Partly yes. I want to see the face of the person who defeated my daughter."
"Suit yourself. But don’t intimidate him... I want to maintain a good relationship with him for my future’s sake," Pill Sage Flura said with an expectant smile.
"Does this have something to do with what the Celestial Cloud Feather told you?"
"Yes, Father. She told me that if I were to form a good connection with him, then my future in the path of alchemy would be limitless.
So, although we left off on a bad note, I believe there is still time to salvage the situation and make amends. Hopefully, that will get me in his good books."
"Don’t worry, I wouldn’t mess up your plans. I just want to quench my curiosity and see what he looks like. Maybe if he is eye candy, I might just take him as my son-in-law."
"Twh, my big sisters already have suitors, and my big brothers don’t swing that way, so don’t even think about that," Pill Sage Flura laughed.
"I know, but I still have one daughter who isn’t married, and every male is too scared to approach her."
"Who? Aside from big sister Jane, who is yet to marry but will soon because she has a fiancé, the only person left is me, and I—"
It was at this moment that Pill Sage Flura realised what her father meant. This caused her to glare at her hateful father, but a blush appeared on her cheek.
Her father laughed out loud, causing the maids around to bend their heads to hide their smiles.
Pill Monarch Yanki IV is one of the brilliant and relatable alchemists at his rank. However, what many like about him is his easygoing attitude.
He wasn’t some hard-to-approach Pill Monarch who thinks he is better than everyone. In contrast to his daughter, it was because he had pampered her too much that she turned out to be so arrogant.
He is very respectful, even for someone of his status.
Thanks to Kent, his daughter seems to have been brought down a notch, so he wants to thank Kent in person for helping to correct his daughter’s bad character.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009: Arriving on Planet Solaryn [Bonus]
paragraphs: [Kent’s POV - En Route To Planet Solaryn]
"So you are not from around here," a Pill King said, sitting not far from Kent.
Kent nodded.
Around him, about a dozen Alchemists sat, learning more about Kent.
Everyone had their agenda, but they all wanted to learn more about Kent, the kid who concocted a Tier 9 Pill with a grey Pill ring around while he was only at the Pill Grandmaster rank.
"When I accidentally fell into that wormhole, I thought I would die, but here I am now, unsure when I will be going back."
"But you will be going back," a different Pill King asked.
"Eventually. In my world, many people used to vanish strangely all the time, only to return after a couple of days, weeks, months, or even years.
I believe I will be whisked back one of these days. However, while here, I might as well live my life to the fullest."
The Alchemists nodded to Kent’s words, not knowing he was telling them a big fat lie. Of course, the part about going back to his world is true, so he only told a half-fat lie.
Then again, he neglected to mention he will be going back to the future, so in a way, that even makes it worse.

"I guess if you are looking to live your life here to some standards, then the Pill Ascension Realm is the right place to explore. Of course, it has its dangers, but as Alchemists, it is a haven for us.
Risking our necks to make a breakthrough is something I personally wouldn’t mind even if I were to lose my life."
Kent stared at a beautiful Pill Sage, who had made her resolve known.
He could only smile and nod to her words. Though he had no plans on dying, making it big in a place meant for Alchemists is worth risking one’s life for.
"So what is the Pill Ascension Realm like?" Kent asked with a small smile on his lips. "I know virtually nothing about it."
"It is only normal that you know nothing about such a place. After all, you are not from around here," a Pill King that goes by Sark said.
"But I will do my best to summarize it for you."
"That will be great," Kent nodded, allowing a focused expression to appear on his face...
"Nobody knows where it came from; however, suddenly, an entrance that only accepts entry from Pill Saints to Pill Emperors appeared on Planet Solaryn.

Upon the first exploration, it was discovered to be a realm for Alchemists. They discovered that it offers so much, ranging from Pill Recipes, Pills, Herbs, Pill Techniques, Pill Flames, and the most shocking of them all: primordial flames.
I’m not sure if you are aware, but Primordial Flames are the true flames in the universe. They came directly from the Universe, so to some extent, people call them Cosmic Flames.

Many speculated that this realm came from the Primordial Era; some say it is from other eras. But one thing is certain: every 15 years, when the gate opens, every Alchemist that qualifies to enter returns a different person.

If you are lucky to pass the trial and enter, do your best to at least grab an opportunity by force because, trust me, all powerful Alchemists we have now became who they are because of the Pill Ascension Realm."
"I see."
Kent had to say his interest was now piqued.
Of course, learning that there are Primordial Flames there made him giddy.
However, finding out the realm might be from the Primordial Era, he couldn’t help but hope that was the case.
He had lived in the Primordial Era, so he is banking on that to maybe trigger some memories.
Of course, his main focus was forming his core with a Primordial Flame, but he also wanted to learn more about his past.
"So does it mean merely having the access token doesn’t guarantee entry?" Kent asked, and the Pill King named Sark nodded.
"Indeed. Every time the gate opens, it introduces a trial that is different from the previous openings.
Unless you pass, you wouldn’t be allowed entry," Pill King Sark said and then added, "It is also because of this that many people say the Pill Ascension Realm was once a Pill Sect."
"That makes sense." Kent couldn’t deny the logic behind this reasoning. After all, before one gets to become a disciple in a sect, they must first pass a trial, so it makes perfect sense.
Kent continues to ask more questions.
Meanwhile, on the side, Pill Monarch Nefeli and Yuna sat a few inches apart, stealing a glance at each other.
To Pill Monarch Nefeli, taking a stranger in out of the blue was something she never saw coming. However, she couldn’t deny that the young lady beside her needed her.
Yuna told her about her life up to the point before Kent rescued her.
From what she learned, if Yuna were left to live somewhere else, the chances of her developing trauma from her past would be extremely high.
So she knew, as someone who naturally had no use for her, she was the best person to handle her and ensure she had some form of normalcy in her life.
However, she herself was not at peace.
She is on the run from some powerful people.
Pill Monarch Nefeli was just a persona to her. Nobody would suspect the harmless Earth Elemental Human Alchemist to be the infamous Triple Sword Samurai.
In fact, she was a whole galaxy away from home, but every passing second, she was always looking out for the first sign of danger so she could make a run for it.
Taking in Yuna was like adding a load to her already complex life.
"You don’t have to worry about me, big sister. Big brother Kent said he will bring me a Primordial Flame so that I will grow stronger and be able to defend myself from bullies and evil men."
Yuna smiled.
Although she was 24 years old, her personality and body were still not developed to match her age.
However, looking at her cute, innocent eyes, Pill Monarch Nefeli could only sigh. She looked at Kent, who was laughing with the Alchemists from the Pyris Pill Alliance.
’What a troublemaker. If you want to play hero, why not see it through to the end? Why drag me into it?’
In the end, she could only sigh again and plan to make a decision when Kent returned from the Pill Ascension Realm.
Six hours later, they arrived on Planet Solaryn.
Planet Solaryn isn’t that big. Of course, it is big enough to house 4 countries. However, the overall diameter of the planet is 1.2 million km compared to Planet Pyris, which is 4.8 million km.
However, it is beautiful.
From space, it is a brown planet with three moons. Naturally, all three moons are occupied by three Pill Clans, which make up the powerhouse of the Solaryn Pill Alliance.
Almost all buildings are made using a rare stone found only on the three moons. The majority of the buildings are story buildings.
Right when they arrived, Kent sensed the presence of many powerful beings arriving. He opened the soul map at full capacity and began to observe everything.
’These people are no mere Alchemists. If I didn’t know better, I would say they are hardcore warriors forged in the flames of battle.’
Kent smiled.
According to what he learned, the Pill Ascension Realm only accepts Alchemists. This means if a veteran warrior were to become a Pill saint, they would be allowed entry if they passed the trial.
Naturally, this means only a few people would be true Alchemists.
’Ahhh, at the end of the day, they are all Golden Blood Essence in my eyes.’
"Let’s go." Pill Monarch Nefeli led them to the location where the gate would open.
