I’m not sure if you are aware, but Primordial Flames are the true flames in the universe.
They came directly from the Universe, so to some extent, people call them Cosmic Flames.
Many speculated that this realm came from the Primordial Era; some say it is from other eras.
But one thing is certain: every 15 years, when the gate opens, every Alchemist that qualifies to enter returns a different person.

If you are lucky to pass the trial and enter, do your best to at least grab an opportunity by force because, trust me, all powerful Alchemists we have now became who they are because of the Pill Ascension Realm."
"I see."
Kent had to say his interest was now piqued.
Of course, learning that there are Primordial Flames there made him giddy.
However, finding out the realm might be from the Primordial Era, he couldn’t help but hope that was the case.
He had lived in the Primordial Era, so he is banking on that to maybe trigger some memories.
Of course, his main focus was forming his core with a Primordial Flame, but he also wanted to learn more about his past.
"So does it mean merely having the access token doesn’t guarantee entry?" Kent asked, and the Pill King named Sark nodded.
"Indeed.
Every time the gate opens, it introduces a trial that is different from the previous openings.
Unless you pass, you wouldn’t be allowed entry," Pill King Sark said and then added, "It is also because of this that many people say the Pill Ascension Realm was once a Pill Sect."
"That makes sense." Kent couldn’t deny the logic behind this reasoning.
After all, before one gets to become a disciple in a sect, they must first pass a trial, so it makes perfect sense.
Kent continues to ask more questions.
Meanwhile, on the side, Pill Monarch Nefeli and Yuna sat a few inches apart, stealing a glance at each other.
To Pill Monarch Nefeli, taking a stranger in out of the blue was something she never saw coming.
However, she couldn’t deny that the young lady beside her needed her.
Yuna told her about her life up to the point before Kent rescued her.
From what she learned, if Yuna were left to live somewhere else, the chances of her developing trauma from her past would be extremely high.
So she knew, as someone who naturally had no use for her, she was the best person to handle her and ensure she had some form of normalcy in her life.
However, she herself was not at peace.
She is on the run from some powerful people.
Pill Monarch Nefeli was just a persona to her.
Nobody would suspect the harmless Earth Elemental Human Alchemist to be the infamous Triple Sword Samurai.
In fact, she was a whole galaxy away from home, but every passing second, she was always looking out for the first sign of danger so she could make a run for it.
Taking in Yuna was like adding a load to her already complex life.
"You don’t have to worry about me, big sister.
Big brother Kent said he will bring me a Primordial Flame so that I will grow stronger and be able to defend myself from bullies and evil men."
Yuna smiled.
Although she was 24 years old, her personality and body were still not developed to match her age.
However, looking at her cute, innocent eyes, Pill Monarch Nefeli could only sigh.
She looked at Kent, who was laughing with the Alchemists from the Pyris Pill Alliance.
’What a troublemaker.
If you want to play hero, why not see it through to the end?
Why drag me into it?’
In the end, she could only sigh again and plan to make a decision when Kent returned from the Pill Ascension Realm.
Six hours later, they arrived on Planet Solaryn.
Planet Solaryn isn’t that big.
Of course, it is big enough to house 4 countries.
However, the overall diameter of the planet is 1.2 million km compared to Planet Pyris, which is 4.8 million km.
However, it is beautiful.
From space, it is a brown planet with three moons.
Naturally, all three moons are occupied by three Pill Clans, which make up the powerhouse of the Solaryn Pill Alliance.
Almost all buildings are made using a rare stone found only on the three moons.
The majority of the buildings are story buildings.
Right when they arrived, Kent sensed the presence of many powerful beings arriving.
He opened the soul map at full capacity and began to observe everything.
’These people are no mere Alchemists.
If I didn’t know better, I would say they are hardcore warriors forged in the flames of battle.’
Kent smiled.
According to what he learned, the Pill Ascension Realm only accepts Alchemists.
This means if a veteran warrior were to become a Pill saint, they would be allowed entry if they passed the trial.
Naturally, this means only a few people would be true Alchemists.
’Ahhh, at the end of the day, they are all Golden Blood Essence in my eyes.’
"Let’s go." Pill Monarch Nefeli led them to the location where the gate would open.

chapters.title: Chapter 1010: Alliance Conflicts [Bonus]
paragraphs: ’Is it just me, or does it appear like there are more warriors than Alchemists?’ Kent used the Soul Map to send a telepathic message to Pill Monarch Nefeli.
She turned and looked at Kent, who gave her a smile.
’Every faction wants Primordial flames, so they groomed warriors into Alchemists and sent them to the Pill Ascension Realm specifically to fight for Primordial flames.
Be sure to avoid such battles and focus on techniques and herbs. Trust me, I have been there before and can testify that what makes that place extra dangerous is your fellow Alchemists.’

Pill Monarch Nefeli smiled to herself, knowing she suffered because she chose not to unleash her dark past. If she had exposed her true self that early back then, she would have been discovered by now.
’I see,’ Kent said, a smirk forming on his lips, ’They should avoid me then. If not, then only a handful will be returning with their heads attached to their bodies.’
Pill Monarch Nefeli shook her head but said nothing.
While Kent was a mere Core Formation cultivator, she had killed enough to recognize a killer when she saw one.
She can tell Kent is a killer...a Bloodthirsty predator.

But even if that didn’t confirm her suspicions that Kent was dangerous, the fact that he was able to make someone like her, who back home was feared by millions, shudder by merely locking a gaze with him was enough to tell her what she had to know.
’Ahh, maybe I should warn the disciples eyeing him to back off before they throw their lives away.’ She sighed and then focused on leading everyone to the Pill Platform, a sacred place in Solaryn.
After an hour, they came to a clearing where hundreds of people could be seen heading toward a tall platform.
From afar, using the Soul Map, Kent saw that the platform was approximately 700 meters in diameter, forming a circular shape.
It had ten sections reserved for the ten Pill Worlds. Kent scanned the ten sections and saw that most of the people present were Pill Emperors, with a few Pill Monarchs also in attendance.
However, the section reserved for the top Pill Alliance, specifically the Solaryn Pill Alliance, was packed with Pill Saints, Sages, Kings, and even five Pill Monarchs.
As he continued to look, he saw more people arriving, each taking their assigned stand within their respective factions.
Naturally, it would take them another hour to get there, but with his Soul Map, he was observing everything.
’Oh, it is going to be a bloodbath for sure. Just look at them, they can’t wait to gut one another.’
From a mere glance, Kent could tell what was running through their minds.
Their expressions said it all. They hated each other, and so they wanted to kill one another as early as possible, so they could feel good about themselves.
One hour later, they arrived and took their place in the section of the platform reserved for the Pyris Pill Alliance.
Kent finally used his own eyes to observe the settings of the platform.
’Looks like the gate opens at the center, and those nodes are probably reserved for pill duels.’ Kent identified a few more things.
’This place serves many purposes than merely housing the gate to the pill realm.’
In no time, the last person came.
Looking around, Kent spotted some high-profile Alchemists from the top three sects.
’Pill Legends, the pinnacle of Pill Making in a High World and beings capable of making pills that invoke both the judgment and blessing of the Pill Dao.’
Kent’s Alchemist heart compelled him to give these people the respect they deserved. To be able to make a pill worthy of the recognition of the Pill Dao was no easy feat.
To him, true Alchemy began at the point where pills concocted invoke heavenly tribulations. Those pills are True Pills recognised by the Heavenly Pill Dao.

So, looking at the three Pill Legends, standing with the Solaryn Pill Alliance, two with the Lunareth Pill Alliance, and one with the Thaloryn Pill Alliance, he could only give them the respect they deserved.
As for the Pill Sovereigns, even one was standing with the Pyris Pill Alliance alongside the seven Pill Monarchs.
Suddenly, a Pill Monarch from the 4th-ranked Pill Alliance looked in the direction of the Pyris Pill Alliance, specifically at Pill Monarch Nefeli, and smiled...
"Glad to see you are still as beautiful as ever, Pill Monarch Nefeli. Hope you’ve been well," Pill Monarch Jackson asked, his smile anything but good intentions.
However, Pill Monarch Nefeli merely glanced at him and scoffed, "I don’t have time for your nonsense, Jackson. If you have something to say, man up and say it."
The expression on Pill Monarch Jackson’s face faltered, but he recovered it to save face... though his tone when he spoke again contrasted with the cheerful one he opened with.
"Still cold as ice, I see. Makes me wonder how cold you will be if you were an Ice Elemental Human." He smiled, and a few others with nefarious intentions smiled with him...
"Words going around are that you have taken in a disciple who, at the Grandmaster stage, could concoct Tier 9 pills with a grey pill ring.
Care to introduce this talent to us and perhaps see if he can give us some pointers?"
The expression on Pill Monarch Nefeli’s face changed.
When Pill Monarch Jackson saw this, he smiled, knowing he had touched a nerve.
Of course he did.
After all, 75 years ago, Pill Monarch Nefeli, then a Pill Emperor, found a young, promising Alchemist, someone she recognized as a true genius in the art of pill making.
She was brilliant and had so many years ahead of her. However, when the Pill Ascension Realm opened and she entered, only her space ring came out.
This space ring was in the hands of a disciple of Pill Monarch Jackson.
Naturally, that said everything she needed to know.
It touched her heart, and for a moment, she nearly committed a massacre.
However, recalling all she had to sacrifice before finally finding some semblance of peace and normalcy, she held back.
However, up until today, she had never forgotten about Nancy, the young girl she had picked up from the street and planned to make her disciple when she reached the Pill King stage.
Of course, she planned to kill this bastard, his disciple, and everyone in their inner circle before leaving. But for now, she held back.
However, hearing him mention Kent brought back these suppressed memories.
Kent, who was standing beside Pill Monarch Nefeli, felt a rather dense killing intent that even he couldn’t exude come off her body.
However, she suppressed it the next second.
This made Kent realize she was angry and very emotional, so naturally, he had to do something.
He looked at Pill Monarch Jackson, and for a moment, he saw a killing intent flash in his eyes. However, what surprised him was the look in the eyes of the Pill Legends.
’They are behind this... all of them.’ Kent felt like vomiting when he saw their hidden expressions.
’To think I gave them the respect they deserve just a moment ago.’ His anger bubbled.
’Relax, big sister, I will handle it.’ He said to her, using the soul map.
Before she could stop him, Kent stepped forward and, using his left hand, pointed at Pill Monarch Jackson.
"You know, I have been around for only 21 years, but this is the first time seeing someone who doesn’t know they won’t be celebrating their next birthday."
Kent’s body vanished, and when he appeared, Pill Monarch Jackson’s head was off his body...

chapters.title: Chapter 1011: Karma’s Debt
paragraphs: The entire space became completely quiet...
Everybody, regardless of the faction they were from, was quiet.
Not even a peep came from them.
Their gazes were locked on Kent, who stood holding Pill Monarch Jackson’s severed head by the hair.
Nobody, not even Pill Monarch Nefeli, saw that coming.
In fact, nobody saw what happened. It was after Pill Monarch Jackson’s headless body fell to the ground that they realised Kent had moved and was now holding the severed head and a bloody dagger.
"What have you done?" Suddenly, a Pill Sovereign standing with the 4th Pill Alliance, the Zephyros Pill Alliance, shouted, his hand reaching to grab Kent.
However, with a swing of his dagger, the man’s wrist came off cleanly. His painful cry filled the space... further sending chills down everyone’s spine.
"Your hands are too dirty to touch me."
Kent took a step and was now standing several meters away from the Zephyros Pill Alliance stand. However, even so, eyes were still on him.
"Kent, what did you just do?" Pill Monarch Nefeli asked.

Kent looked at her and sighed, "Stay out of this, Pill Monarch Nefeli. This is between me and the Zephyros Pill Alliance. They dare to kill my sister, thinking they can get away with it. Too bad they picked the wrong target.
So stay out of it and let me deal with them."

Pill Monarch Nefeli didn’t know what Kent was talking about, but she could sense he was serious, so in order not to drag the Pyris Pill Alliance any further into the mess Kent had just created, she took a step back.
Of course, Kent used the Soul Map to tell her to play along... so she had double reasons to hold herself back.
"Kid, do you know what you have just done?" another Pill Sovereign asked, exuding his Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivation.
However, Kent merely smirked, feeling the aura blow past him like wind. "I know what I did. I killed scum. What are you going to do about it?"

Everybody felt their backs break into a cold sweat upon hearing Kent’s words. They could tell he wasn’t affected in any way despite being under the suppression of a Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator’s aura.
In fact, Kent seemed unfazed, almost as if he wasn’t even feeling anything aside from the wind blowing.
Kent looked at the faces of the six Pill Legends in attendance and spat disdainfully, showing how disgusted he felt at the moment.
"You know, I came here with so much respect for you six; however, seeing your expression when this scum taunted Pill Monarch Nefeli, my respect for you has dropped to a different kind of low."
Gasps spread out, causing many people to shudder, despite not being the ones who spoke. However, Kent wasn’t done.
"Kid, do you have a death wish?" A pill Emperor standing with the Solaryn Pill Alliance lung at Kent. However, he merely raised his dagger and muttered a word.
"Kneel"
Despite having a Heavenly Ascension stage cultivation base, he crashed to his knees, his entire body pressed by an invisible force.
"Weak"
Kent turns back to the Pill Legends.
"So what, you’ve heard a youngster who isn’t even at the Pill Saint stage was able to form a Pill ring, so you felt threatened.

But, to maintain your image, you picked someone who had a past with my Pyris Pill Alliance to taunt and hide your faces behind him, waiting to strike and take me down before I grow up to surpass you."
Kent sneered, "The truth is, I am better and will always be better than all of you, so get used to it. However, today I don’t have time for six more scum. Today, I came because of him and him."
Kent pointed his dagger toward a Pill Emperor whose expression was a mix of fear and anger.
His name is Pill Emperor Jonas, the disciple of the now-dead Pill Monarch Jackson.
"75 years ago, you murdered a harmless girl named Nancy." Pill Monarch Nefeli’s expression changed upon hearing a familiar name.
It wasn’t an act.
Hearing the name touched her. However, she said nothing.

"She was just 37 years old. She was full of life and ambition to one day become a Pill Legend, even to transcend beyond that. However, you murdered her, thinking you would get away with it." Kent laughed, his expression turning dark.
"Or what, you thought she was an orphan, that nobody would miss her? I guess you are wrong... You touched the wrong person, and today you will pay with your life."
It was shocking how many people immediately recalled what happened. It seemed that many knew what had happened, yet they all remained quiet.
After all, a Pill Sage is insignificant in the grand scheme of things, so they brushed it aside.
However, Karma never forgets, and today, it came to collect what was owed him.
"You know, for such a powerful Pill organization, you bunch are sure a big disappointment. The Pill Rules clearly stated that all life, regardless of how insignificant, is important.

However, because she was nothing, because she was a mere Pill Sage, you all saw her as nothing. If it were up to me, I would have killed every last one of you and cleansed the filth that had wormed its way into this grand establishment.
However, as I said, I am here for two people. Their time of reckoning is today, and so they will pay with their blood.
However, I will keep a very close eye on all of you. Just because you are a Pill Legend doesn’t give you the right to do as you please.
Today, I will honour my sister’s memories and spare your useless lives. But there won’t be a next time."
Kent stomps on the ground, and obsidian shards burst out, stabbing Pill Emperor Jonax through his legs, arms, heart, and head.
After killing him, Kent drops the head.
"If any of you want to say something, now will be the best time. After all, you all want some pointers on how to form pill rings, right?"
The smile that Kent is known for returned to his face, causing many to take a few steps back.
The fear they were in now said it all; Kent is a danger that no one wants to mess with. Even his cute smile felt dark
After five minutes, no one steps forward. Kent sighed and looked toward the direction of the Aerithyne Pill Alliance, his gaze meeting that of Pill Sage Flura’s.
"Good to see you again, Pill Sage Flura, and congratulations on your promotion to Pill Sage stage."
"Likewise, Pill Saint Kent."
Kent smiled, "Let’s have fun in the Pill Ascension realm when it opens."
After saying that, I flew back toward the section where the Pyris Pill Alliance was standing. The disciples around him scattered when he landed on the platform.
Kent didn’t mind; he instead walked toward Pill Monarch Nefeli and muttered, "Sorry..."
"You don’t have to apologise, Kent. You did nothing wrong... You merely avenged your sister."
Kent nodded and sat in a lotus posture.
When he closed his eyes, his consciousness appeared at the shore of a blue river where a certain man was sunbathing.
"Nicely done, Chaos Dragon. That will be five years bought until I come seeking what you owe me."
"Thanks for your generosity, Lord Karma."
The man nodded and waved his hand, and Kent was sent away, back into his body.
"That is sweet of you, Karma. I never knew you had a soft spot for him, too."
"Mind your own business, Fate. Some things are not gossip-worthy for you to pry into." The man closed his eyes, but a small smile appeared on his lips.
"Prepare well, Kiddo; carrying the Karma of a goddess is not something that can be paid easily... Your bad days are coming, so be prepared."

Just because you are a Pill Legend doesn’t give you the right to do as you please.
Today, I will honour my sister’s memories and spare your useless lives.
But there won’t be a next time."
Kent stomps on the ground, and obsidian shards burst out, stabbing Pill Emperor Jonax through his legs, arms, heart, and head.
After killing him, Kent drops the head.
"If any of you want to say something, now will be the best time.
After all, you all want some pointers on how to form pill rings, right?"
The smile that Kent is known for returned to his face, causing many to take a few steps back.
The fear they were in now said it all; Kent is a danger that no one wants to mess with.
Even his cute smile felt dark
After five minutes, no one steps forward.
Kent sighed and looked toward the direction of the Aerithyne Pill Alliance, his gaze meeting that of Pill Sage Flura’s.
"Good to see you again, Pill Sage Flura, and congratulations on your promotion to Pill Sage stage."
"Likewise, Pill Saint Kent."
Kent smiled, "Let’s have fun in the Pill Ascension realm when it opens."
After saying that, I flew back toward the section where the Pyris Pill Alliance was standing.
The disciples around him scattered when he landed on the platform.
Kent didn’t mind; he instead walked toward Pill Monarch Nefeli and muttered, "Sorry..."
"You don’t have to apologise, Kent.
You did nothing wrong...
You merely avenged your sister."
Kent nodded and sat in a lotus posture.
When he closed his eyes, his consciousness appeared at the shore of a blue river where a certain man was sunbathing.
"Nicely done, Chaos Dragon.
That will be five years bought until I come seeking what you owe me."
"Thanks for your generosity, Lord Karma."
The man nodded and waved his hand, and Kent was sent away, back into his body.
"That is sweet of you, Karma.
I never knew you had a soft spot for him, too."
"Mind your own business, Fate.
Some things are not gossip-worthy for you to pry into." The man closed his eyes, but a small smile appeared on his lips.
"Prepare well, Kiddo; carrying the Karma of a goddess is not something that can be paid easily...
Your bad days are coming, so be prepared."

chapters.title: Chapter 1012: Portal Opening
paragraphs: Back when Vexthra pried too deeply into Kent’s past, she triggered a Karmic Backlash that was meant to kill her. But Kent took it upon himself to give her his good karma in exchange for her good life.
However, while it worked and Vexthra was spared, the rule of Karma deemed Kent too precious to die in her stead, so they compromised.
The rules allowed him to maintain his good Karma but also Vexthra’s bad Karma, which he would have to pay for in the future.
From that day onward, Kent had been waiting for Lord Karma to call.
However, the call never came until a few minutes ago.
When they arrived on the platform, Kent lost consciousness for a second. However, within that second, he spent 10 minutes with someone who called himself Lord Karma.
According to him, every Karma in life is a result of his actions. He is in charge of determining who deserves good Karma and who deserves Karma in return.
Kent saw it as weird, but he said nothing.
However, Lord Karma informed him that the time for him to pay for Vexthra’s Karma had come. Naturally, Kent wasn’t ready, so he bargained.
Perhaps due to coincidence, the lady who was killed by Pill Monarch Jackson’s disciple 75 years ago had good Karma to her name.

So to repay what was owed to him, he asked Kent to exact revenge in his stead, and, depending on how satisfied he was, he would grant Kent an extension on when he would have to pay for Vexthra’s Karma.

Kent accepted the offer, meaning that, regardless of what happened, Kent was prepared to kill two people. Thankfully, Pill Monarch Jackson created an environment that allowed him to look cool while killing him.
He managed to buy himself five years in the end.
Now, he can focus on growing stronger because in five years, Lord Karma will come knocking again, and there will be no extension next time.
’Change of plans: after I go back and take part in the Interplanetary Sect competition, I will ascend to a High World. Time for me to move past the Core formation stage.’
He scared many people... That much is true. However, he had to do that to win some brownie points from Lord Karma.
According to him, the more dramatic the kill, the more time he got.
Naturally, Kent was born for drama, so he went for it, and he managed to secure himself some more time.
Initially, he was planning on giving his ladies and the legion the time until they couldn’t climb the floors of the dungeon anymore before ascending. However, now, he knew he had to forgo that plan.
’I will use Alchemy to help them. After all, with the kind of pill recipes I have, it is only a matter of time before I start making heavenly pills.’
Three hours later, a fluctuation appeared at the center of the platform, drawing everyone’s attention.
Kent opened his eyes and stood up.
He looked toward the center of the platform and saw the space there warping.
’The gate is opening.’
Like everyone else, he also thought that. His focus was rooted in the shifts in the air. He didn’t even notice the thousands of eyes looking at him.

Five minutes later, the space shifted, and two large pillars came from the ground. They stood tall, and within them, a green portal formed, exuding a distinct aura that, when Kent felt it, caused his expression to shift.

’This is not the Aura of the Primordial Era; however, it is of the Divine Era.’ Instinctively, he knew which era the aura came from. In fact, his very being was filled with excitement as he gazed at the green portal.
’I have lived during the Divine Era, that much is true. But I don’t yet know which kind of existence I was in back then.’
Kent sighed, then asked Pill Monarch Nefeli a question using the soul map.
’Big sister, what can you tell me about the Divine Era?’
The beautiful Nefeli blinked a few times, not expecting Kent to ask such a question. However, she seemed to connect the dots quickly...
’Do you think the Pill Ascension Realm came from that Era?’ she asked...
’It is a working theory. But yes. I believe it is from that Era, and hopefully, I might learn something from your answer.’
’I don’t know much. However, from what I know, the Divine Era followed immediately after the Chaos Era.
Of course, many people are unaware of this, but the Chaos Era was largely a response to the aftermath of the Great War during the Primordial Era.
Immediately after the Chaos Era, a more peaceful and relaxing Era emerged, where gods rose and ascended, bringing order to the Universe.
It was a peaceful Era to some degree; however, it also had its dangers.’
’I see. Then, can you tell me some notable people who rose through that Era and what they were known for?’
Kent wasn’t looking to learn more about himself; he just wanted to learn more about the Era he felt some form of familiarity with.
’Now that you mention it, I believe your theory about the Pill Ascension Realm being from the Divine Era might just be correct.’
’How so?’ Kent felt happy hearing this.
’Because the first ever to ascend to the ranks of a Pill Celestial was from that Era. It was through him that Alchemy developed to the stage it is now.’
’Do you know his name?’ Kent held his breath as he waited for an answer...
’From the records I read, he was called many names, and he had many titles. However, the most common name I saw was Pill Celestial Kevin Sage.’
Kent’s body shuddered at the sound of a familiar name.
When Vexthra sent him to Sonox, the pill records he received were from a person called Pill Celestial Kevin Sage.

Initially, Kent didn’t put much thought into the name. However, when he began receiving memories of his life as Jest (Lord Genesis), he couldn’t help but wonder if he was, in fact, the Pill Celestial who was the first to reach the Pinnacle of Alchemy.
’I mean, it is no coincidence I have the Pill Records from him. And while Nana intentionally said nothing about the name of her master in the past, I believe my theory might just be true...
’In that case, Kevin Sage, or whoever your name is, please have some relationship with this Pill Ascension Realm. It would be nice to learn more about my peaceful past.’
’Thank you, Big sister,’ Kent transmitted, and Pill Monarch Nefeli nodded.
’Just be careful when you go in there. There are a lot of people who want you dead, so watch your back.’
Kent smiled, ’I will do as you say, Big sister.’
A couple of minutes later, the portal completely formed, and a pillar marked with two colors appeared through the portal.
The bottom part was silver, and the upper had a golden hue.
A voice then came from within the portal. "Channel your soul energy into the Soul Pillar. All who reached the Golden Soul barrier will be allowed entry."
The words were simple and easily understood.
Right when it faded, a Pill Legend from the Solaryn Pill Alliance appeared above the soul pillar.
"As we all know, the order in which we take the trial will be based on the rank of our respective Pill Alliances. Now, the first-rank Pill Alliance should start."
The Solaryn Pill Alliance qualified disciples stepped forward, and soon, the trial to enter the Pill Ascension Realm began.

chapters.title: Chapter 1013: Pill Ascension Trial [Bonus]
paragraphs: Many people would have loved to show off and be arrogant in this very moment.
However, after the cold opening Kent gave them, they all straightened up.
It was no exaggeration to say Kent had dampened the mood.
However, he was fighting for Karma, and as someone with extremely good Karma, he knew some people were just better off dead.
Pill Monarch Jackson was a scum. From a quick scan with his Enchanted Eyes, Kent saw a list of crimes he had committed. So his death was warranted.
Now, everyone is just hoping the Grim Reaper they all would have looked down on wouldn’t come for their heads next.
As more people started taking the trial, Kent could see a trend.
"Looks like those warriors groomed to become Alchemists aren’t having a good time." A smirk formed on his lips.
The majority of the warriors that the various Pill factions wanted to use to farm Primordial Flames were failing to hit the Golden Soul Barrier.
It wasn’t that they had weak soul strengths. Some even took Soul Boosting Pills before taking the trial, but they still failed to pass.
"This year’s trial is strange," Pill Monarch Nefeli said. She held a curious look in her eyes as she observed the Soul Pillar.

"It is like the trial is specifically singling out the true Alchemist. So far, all who have qualified are true Alchemists. They have love for Alchemy, unlike the others, who only came because they have the power to fight for Primordial Flames."

"Isn’t that obvious? I mean, the Pill Ascension Realm was meant to be a haven for true Alchemists, right?" Kent scoffs. "Maybe it is finally tired of warriors desecrating it, so it changed its selection method, allowing only True Alchemists to enter.
"After all, wouldn’t it be cheating those who can’t fight but actually have a love for Alchemy?"
Pill Monarch Nefeli nodded. "I guess you are right. However, with this change, the chances of things changing this time around are very high.
I mean, look at even the top-ranking Pill Alliance. After 30 people took the trial, only five qualified."
Kent smiled, watching the painful look in the Pill Legend’s eyes.
"It is their loss for being greedy. Now, they will have to face me in there, and trust me, with me in there with them, without my permission, none of them will be getting anything out."
The Pill Monarch could only smile at how petty Kent is. She can tell he really hated the Pill Legends, and because of the hatred for them, he wants to make sure their factions lose heavily.
"Don’t overestimate yourself, Kent. The Pill Ascension Realm is even bigger than this planet, so unless you can be at every place at once, then maybe you should relax a little."
Kent smiled, but he knew what she said was indeed true. However, his pettiness will ultimately be the downfall of many.
[Section of the Aerithyne Pill Alliance - Pill Sage Flura and her father]
After seeing how dangerous Kent really is, Pill Sage Flura began having second thoughts about whether she wants to form a relationship with him.
She saw Kent as gentle, arrogant, but extremely brilliant when they dueled.
However, now, she saw a side of him that made her very being shudder when she thought about it.
In short, she is afraid of Kent, and that alone is what is making her get cold feet...
However, her father seems to be having a completely different thought.
"Having cold feet?" he asked, smiling at his daughter.
"Dad, don’t joke about something like this," Pill Sage Flura said, her body trembling slightly.

"You really are a baby," he laughed, causing the guards beside them to shake their heads. They are aware of how arrogant Pill Sage Flura can be. Of course, they put up with her; however, they also know she is fragile.
Seeing her weak and docile, in a way, made them feel sorry for her.
"Do you really not see what I saw, huh?" her father asked...
"I don’t." Pill Sage Flura didn’t lie. She really didn’t see anything aside from being scared.
"Well... I can see someone that even Pill Legends don’t dare offend. Under their watchful gaze, he killed a Pill Monarch and a Pill Emperor.
Of course, they could argue and say the deceased aren’t from their faction. However, the truth is they are scared of him, and that spoke volumes.
Now, while you are seeing too far into the future, why don’t you bring your imagination down to the immediately present? You think your future will be secured if you form a relationship with him.
However, what will happen if you were to move with him in the Pill Ascension Realm? I mean, who would dare touch you if you were to be seen with him, even if for a second?"
"I-I..." Pill Sage Flura couldn’t say her words.
"I know. You are afraid, however, after his display, he even made sure you know he isn’t your enemy by speaking with you. That should be your cue to know he is indeed not your enemy."
Her father smiled...
"I am going to have a few words with him. You can come if you want." After saying that, he began walking toward the direction of the Pyris Pill Alliance.
Pill Sage Flura hesitated for a moment before moving to follow her father.
[Zephyros Pill Alliance stand]
It was no secret now that the Zephyros Pill Alliance had lost face following the plain disrespect from Kent.
This made them extremely furious
So they want him dead, and for that, they decided to make a sacrifice to ensure that.
A Pill Sovereign stood behind their line with three Pill Emperors.
"This is the Mind Expansion Pill. It will temporarily raise your mental limit to Tier 19. There is a side effect, but that can be fixed.
Use it to disrupt his mind and then, using the Soul Extinguishing Pill, go for the kill." He handed a box housing four pills to one of the Pill Emperors.
"There are three potions of the Mind Expansion Pill. Use it well, and when you return, the Alliance will reward you."
"Fear not, Pill Sovereign, we will get it done. That brat will not be coming back from the Pill Ascension Realm."
"Good. It is almost our turn; use this time to rally with your peers. They might help somehow."
"Okay, Pill Sovereign."
Kent, who was talking to Pill Monarch Nefeli, felt a familiar scent that nobody else sensed come from the Zephyros Pill Alliance stand.
His Enchanted Eyes picked up on this, and so he opened the soul map only to catch a glimpse of a pill box housing three pills.
He then activated the audio function of the soul map and caught on to what the Pill Sovereign was plotting...
’How sinister. To think you will give Mind Explosion Pills to your own people just to kill me.’ Kent smirked.

’Looks like it is not only Pill Monarch Jackson who was in bed with the Evil Pill Cult. All of them are guilty. However, luck is on their side, because today, I am occupied, but in the future, I will have the time to address all this.’
A sigh escaped his lips.
The next second, however, Pill Sage Flura and her father arrived, causing him to shift his attention to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1014: Strange Voice [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Nice to finally meet you, Kent. I am Pill Monarch Yanki IV, this little one’s father," Pill Sage Flura’s father said, taking Kent’s hand in a firm shake.
"Nice to meet you, too, Lord Yanki. I have to say, having finally met you, I can see where little Flura gets her good looks from."
"Hahaha," Pill Monarch Yanki IV laughed, "I knew I would like you from the moment I heard you defeated my daughter in a fair duel."
Kent also laughed, causing Pill Sage Flura and Pill Monarch Nefeli to stare at the two shameless brats who, despite just meeting, one would think they’d known each other for years.
"I just came to thank you in person for helping my daughter back then. Because of you, she had learned a lot."
"No need to thank me, Lord Yanki, I am but a humble human who couldn’t let a fairy waste her potential."
"Spoken like a true man," Pill Monarch Yanki IV laughed, "When you return from the Pill Ascension Realm, be sure to pass by Planet Aerithyne; my family will welcome you with open arms."
"I will surely take up that offer."
Kent smiled and looked to Pill Sage Flura, "Are you prepared for the Pill Ascension Realm? I was told it is a dangerous place."
She hesitated, but then she nodded.
Kent smiled, "Don’t worry, with me around, nobody will dare touch you."
Kent is no idiot. He knew the reason why Pill Monarch Yanki came to him was to ask him to look after his daughter when they entered the Pill Ascension Realm.

He saw what he could do, and as a father who loved his daughter, he knew that if he could get her to be seen with Kent, her future achievements would be endless, just as the Celestial Cloud Feather had told her.
Of course, as to how Kent does that, it would depend on him.
So he decided to make things simple for her.
"Pill Monarch Nefeli, can she stay with us?" Kent turned to his big sister and asked.
"She can stand anywhere she wants. After all, everybody will be transported to a random place once you enter."
"I see," Kent thought for a moment, and then he walked toward Pill Sage Flura and drew a symbol on her forehead.
"That handles it."
"What does it do?" she asked.
"It is my special tracking spell. With that, I can sense you from anywhere. It will last for 48 hours, so don’t worry, I will look for you before then."
"Okay."
"Thanks for your generosity, Kent," Pill Monarch Yanki thanked him, and after a few talks, they left. When they were gone, Pill Monarch Nefeli walked toward Kent...
"You know you don’t have to do that, right? She is from a different Alliance."
"I know. However, she is special, so I plan to protect her... for my future and the future of the Pyris Pill Alliance."
Pill Monarch Nefeli smirked.
She had no idea how Kent had found out about Nancy. However, he did manage to do so, and even went out of his way to avenge her. So in her eyes, perhaps listening to the brat wouldn’t be too bad.
Kent smiled and turned to Yuna... "Listen to your big sister while I am away. When I return, you will have a whole Primordial Flame to your name."
"Okay, big brother. I will listen to big sister and wait for you to return."
Kent nodded to her words. Yuna is a big softy who needed to be treated like a delicate flower, so he knew she would indeed listen to Pill Monarch Nefeli.

After four hours, it reached the Pyris Pill Alliance turn. Pill Monarch Nefeli gave them one last warning, "Remember, your mission is to gather as many pill ingredients, Pill Recipes, and Pill Techniques, and, if possible, normal pills you can.
If you can’t fight over a Primordial Flame, don’t. Do I make myself clear?"
They all nodded to her words.
"Then good luck, and may you return enlightened."
They started leaving one by one to take the trial. So far, ninety percent of the warriors groomed as alchemists had failed to pass the trial, leaving many alliances dejected.
However, for the Pyris Pill Alliance, all of them were alchemists personally selected by Pill Monarch Nefeli, so as they started taking the trial, the results started to show.
Only twenty-five of them qualified to take the trial. However, even after the first fifteen took the trial, all of them passed.
These results finally cemented Kent’s suspicion that this year, the Pill Ascension Realm was personally hand-picking true alchemists to enter.
As to why, he could only wait and find out after he entered. With thirty minutes, the twenty-fourth person from the Pyris Pill Alliance passed the trial, leaving only Kent.
"Keep an eye on them," Pill Monarch Nefeli said, and Kent nodded.
"Good luck, Big Brother," Yuna said, and Kent nodded.
Kent flew and landed beside the Soul Pillar.
He sighed and then pressed his hand against the pillar.
In an instant, the pillar lit up and hummed, causing the surroundings to shake. The Pill Legends narrowed their eyes, sensing a potent soul energy emanating from Kent.
In fact, everyone around could sense it, causing many to wonder just what kind of existence he was.
Meanwhile, in Kent’s mind, a voice spoke...

"Even after death, you never cease to amaze me, Sage. However, since you are now weak and can’t beat me, why don’t you hurry and come to me so we can continue from where we left off the last time? I doubt you have your memories, so don’t mind me if I bully you a little."
Laughter followed the words, causing Kent to feel like he had fallen into a trap.
’I can never catch a break,’ a smirk tugged on his lips as he walked and stood with the disciples from the Pyris Pill Alliance.
[Pill Ascension Realm - The Last Floor of the Pill Ascension Tower]
A man with a long, white beard and white hair sat behind a Wéiqí (an ancient Chinese board game that uses black and white stones or beads, also known as GO).
He was seated on the black side of the board, with only one black bead placed on the board.
"Kevin Sage, so you are back again." He smiled, feeling a mix of annoyance and happiness.
"I don’t know if this is a good thing or a bad thing. However, I know I will be getting my revenge this time," he smiled and brushed his beard with his fingers.
"Though petty, you are just too annoying to the point that if I don’t try today, you will come to haunt me later, so fear not, I will provide you opportunities, but I will also make you suffer."
He placed another black bead, and somewhere in the Pill Ascension Realm, a tower rose from the ground. When it was fully out, the name "Primordial Hell" was hung before the gate.
A few minutes after the tower appeared, a figure walked out and stretched his arms. He was a pale-looking old man.
His dark hair is dirty, and many facial tattoos glow as he breathes. He looked toward the tall tower in the distance.
"This old fucker is up to his games again," the man said, feeling annoyed.
The next second, he vanished and appeared atop the last floor of the Pill Ascension Tower, coming face-to-face with the white-bearded man.
"Old bastard, what do you want from me... Know that I am the Lord of the Seven Hell Primordial Flames. If you fuck with me, your death will be swift."
"Shut up, Gaap... Don’t you want to be free?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1015: Conversation With A Petty God
paragraphs: It took another hour for the last two factions to complete their trial.
In the end, many were left dejected simply because they failed to secure an entry into the Pill Ascension realm.

Not that they were to be pitied. After all, they chose to cheat, and that backfired on them. Next time, they will learn not to get greedy by trying to cheat something that is beyond their understanding.
"Remember, in 30 days, you will be pulled out of the Pill Ascension realm if you are still alive. So handle all you have to quickly before the time is up," the Pill Legend said.
Everyone nodded.
"Then get moving; the earlier you enter, the faster you may locate treasures."
Right when he said that, all qualified alchemists started flying into the portal. They couldn’t wait to get their hands on some treasures.
Kent stood back and let more people enter.
He was pondering the strange voice he heard in his head. There was no malice in the voice; however, he could tell the playfulness in it.
’He sounded like he couldn’t wait to toy with me. Personally, I prefer to be targeted with killing intent instead of being toyed with. At least with the former, I will know who to kill.’
Kent could only sigh.
’I guess we will meet soon, and hopefully, I will have the last laugh’
Eventually, the number had thinned down, so he decided to enter.
He turned and waved at Yuna and Pill Monarch Nefeli first before walking forward.

The moment he stepped into the portal, he felt his surroundings twist, and then he appeared in a large room, face-to-face with a white-haired, long-bearded man whose face was painted with an amused smile.
"Finally, you are here," the man said, gesturing for Kent to sit down.
However, he refused because he sensed another presence in the room that made his skin crawl.
He turned to his left only to see a pale-looking man with glowing face tattoos smiling at him. Kent instinctively took a step back, raising his guard.
"Behave, Gaap. He is an old friend."
Gaap turned to the white-bearded man and smirked, "Boring..."
Gaap vanished, leaving Kent and the white-haired man.
"Sit down, Kevin Sage. We have a lot to talk about."
"Is this an Immortal World?" Kent asked instead of sitting down. Something told him sitting down would be bad for him, so he first wanted to clear the air.
"Persistent, I see," the white-bearded man smiled, "But why do you ask?"
"That man is at the peak of the True Immortal stage," Kent didn’t want to admit, but the man gave him the heebie-jeebies.
Perhaps if he were at the Immortal stage, looking at someone at the Root, Spirit, and Core Immortal stages wouldn’t have scared him. But he was too low in cultivation base.
In fact, Kent seemed to glimpse something that made him start to wonder if he would be ready to face an Immortal when he reached the Heavenly Ascension stage.
’What the hell is this?’
The white-bearded man smiled, "Always smart and perceptive, Sage. Not many would have seen through his cultivation base, but you did. That is admirable.
However, to answer your question, you must first sit."
"Do I have a choice?"
"No."
"Can I leave if I sit?"
"That will depend."
"Would my friends be safe?"
"That will also depend on you. So what do you say, do you want to indulge this old man in a game of GO?"
Kent sighs. "For a God to bully a mortal, I can’t help but wonder just what shamelessness is."
Kent shook his head and sat down. The smile on the white-bearded man’s face bloomed. "Very perceptive, Sage. You even saw through me."
"The answer to your question is yes and no. Yes, this place is an Immortal World, but no, it is also not an Immortal World."
"I don’t understand."

"It is very simple. This place is a domain. I created it when I became a god, and as such, I made the rules here. However, this is not the real me. Maybe I am even dead, or worse, still alive somewhere waiting for you to surface again.
So this place can be regarded as an Immortal World or a High World. However, a more fitting name should be a Unique World."
"If that is the case, then wouldn’t the people from High Worlds face dangers here?" Kent asked, thinking about the disciples currently inside the Pill Ascension Realm.

Unique Worlds are worlds that have no restrictions on them, meaning even Celestials can exist in them. So if this place is a Unique World, then doesn’t that make it an extremely dangerous place to be for beings merely from High Worlds?
"True. However, I make the rules, and as such, I made it so all beings from the High World face dangers limited to their level.
Meaning the strongest danger they will ever face would be at the Heavenly Ascension stage."
"I see. That makes me calm a bit," Kent sighed. He doesn’t care about the other Pill factions aside from Pill Sage Flura and the 24 disciples from Pyris Pill Alliance.
So hearing they aren’t in danger of a Unique World makes him calm down a bit.
However, the white-bearded man smiled, "That said, things can become very difficult for them unless you play a game with me." The man picked another black bead and placed it on the board.
"First, I will ask a question, and using your intellect that I know you have, to answer. If your answer suits me, I will grant a wish for someone you choose.
However, if your answer is lacking, then there are 25 people I can select from to feel some necessary pain."
The white-bearded man laughed, and Kent narrowed his eyes at him.
"What do you want?" he asked, his gaze turning cold...
"Very simple. The you I knew was regarded as very brilliant. Of course, you had your flaws, but among the many scholars I met, you were the most knowledgeable of them all.
So, show me if you’ve always been brilliant or if it was something you became along the way.
The questions will be out of this world, perhaps even out of this Universe. But you must give me a satisfactory answer, one that will calm me down and give me a reason to think."
"You sound like someone who is bored. Makes me wonder if you are the God of Boring and Useless," Kent snapped, seeing no reason for him to know something beyond him.

"You know, I met a god once, and from what I observe, she is much better and wiser than you. So if you think you can play mind games with me, then you have another thing coming." Kent chuckled, wearing a disdainful expression, but the white-bearded man merely smiled.
"Listen to my question first and then judge me after," he smiled, "If the heavens reject you and the entire Universe despises you, what then can be done, and what do you think was the cause?
Is it the heavens that rebel? Are they afraid of someone or something? Or are they no longer in control?
If that is the case, can you tell me what will happen if the heavens are no longer in control?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1016: Deep Thinking
paragraphs: The question asked is indeed out of this world or the Universe.
There was no easy answer, and Kent, who had heard this, was left with a blank expression, staring at the white-bearded man, who wore a smile on his face, clearly enjoying Kent’s state of mind.
The question is illogical.
The heavens make up the universe.
These are the Rules (Daos).
They are destiny.
They are fate.
They are life and death.
They are everything.
As such, they can never rebel.

That is just impossible. The heavens are everything, and so why would they rebel? Who are they rebelling against? That logic is not sound, and so Kent dismissed it. However, he held it at the back of his mind.
After all, there is a second reason, which suggests that perhaps they are afraid of something or someone. This logic is, in a way, sound.
The heavens are the Universe...

So, in a way, they are an entity. Meaning the whole universe can be considered one powerful being. So, if that is the case, then it can also mean this powerful entity might just have someone they fear, just like how even gods have fear.
This logic is sound, but it also leads to the last scenario, which involves someone taking over the universe.
If that is the case, then it means the universe can be controlled, the rules can be rewritten, and everyone’s fate and destiny will now be in the hands of the one who controls it.
If that is the case, then perhaps everything can change.
Kent suddenly felt like he had been enlightened...

He looked at the white-bearded man and smirked, "Your logic is sound but flawed. You seek to learn about what happens if the Universe is being controlled by someone, when you should instead ask about who or what can confidently face the universe without a strand of fear.
That person is not me, and it is not you.
We don’t qualify to do that.
However, since you want to know what happens if the universe is no longer in control, then I will indulge you.
First, since the Universe is governed by laws, I can see those laws being rewritten. Things like who gets to live and die now depend on who is in control.
I can see an entire cultivation base wiped out just because they contradict the new laws.
I can see an entire bloodline suppressed because they go against the natural flow of the laws.
There are so many things that could happen, but the most serious of them all is who is in charge.
Can they be stopped?
Do they have the means to completely destroy the entire Universe, or is something holding them back, preventing them from getting what they want?"
Kent smirked, seeing the expression on the white-bearded man’s face change.
He picked a white bead and placed it on the board.
"Talking logic demands deep thinking, not philosophy. You tried to play mind games with me, thinking I was limited to my age. However, you failed to realize one thing."
"And what is that?"
"I don’t need to think to know the answer to your question." Kent smiled, the image of a certain white-haired handsome man appearing in his mind.

"You see, I met someone before who I believe is an existence that is fighting against the heavens." This time, the white-bearded man’s expression was that of a pleading child begging to be enlightened.
Kent laughed, feeling a huge disgust for the man. However, with many lives on the line, he suppressed his anger and spoke.
"I believe he was from a place where the heavens are no longer in control. They had been rewritten and, as such, his nature was constantly fighting against them...
That is also why I believe the logic about whether the heavens can rebel is, in a way, illogical.
The heavens are emotionless; however, they are all-seeing, all-knowing, and self-sustaining.
If they feel threatened, they will look for a way to sustain themselves, even if it means summoning something or someone they even fear.

Now, consider the following scenario. If you were to have the power to take over the heavens, then what would happen to you if somebody else, outside of time and space... someone whom the heavens are afraid of were to appear?"
"I will be afraid and try to annihilate them."
"Good. However, what then happens if you can’t? What then will you do?"
This time, the white-bearded man didn’t know what to say. This caused Kent to smile.
"Cause and Effect, ever heard of it?"
"Yes." Now, the white-bearded man had become a student being lectured by the Chaos Dragon.
"Everything done has its cause and effect. If you try to take over the Universe, the cause is you; you will become invincible; however, the effect will be the self-correction.
This correction can be a force that prevents you from directly killing what is blocking your path to ascension.
If that is the case, it means you will use any means necessary to kill. But because the rules don’t affect this thing or that person, all your efforts will be in vain.
In the end, you can only watch and see how this person rises and one day surpasses you, thereby doing what he had to do, which was to eradicate you."
"Then what kind of existence can be so powerful that even the laws of the Universe can’t affect him?" the white-bearded man asked, but Kent merely smiled.
"I will leave that to your imagination."

"Satiate my curiosity, Sage, and I will grant you more than a wish. You have to know that I am the god of this world; in a way, I write the rules here. So, if you want to have a happy time here, then tell me what I need to know."
Kent smiled, "I am no paragon, old man, but I am the Primordial Chaos Dragon. I don’t take threats lightly, so I will advise you to tread carefully. You may be a god, but who cares?"
"Hahahahahaha..." The white-bearded man laughed, feeling satisfied with Kent’s reply.
Suddenly, the man’s appearance changed, mirroring the face of the person who gave him the Soul Universe technique.
"Paragon..." Kent said, feeling a different feeling coming from the man.
"We meet again, Chaos Dragon." Paragon smiled, "I have to say, you have come a long way since we last met. However, you still have a long way to go."
"I know. However, I am getting there."

"Indeed." Paragon smiled, "Though I have to say, your knowledge is sound and bright. However, you are wrong about one thing. The heavens can indeed rebel, but they can do that by following someone else’s command."
"Meaning they can be controlled."
"In a way, yes. But for a universe to be controlled, it must willingly allow it."
"So you are saying that for a universe to rebel, it will depend on its master. This means every Universe has a master."
Paragon nodded with a smile, "You are smart, even for someone with only one mind. But yes, every universe has a master, and these masters decide how the laws work."
"Then, in your case, the heavens don’t have a good master."
"No. They do... They, in fact, have a good master. A very beautiful and intelligent one... However..."
Paragon smiled and ended his words there...
"We need to talk about you, Kent... I saw your death... five years from now, so why don’t we attempt changing your fate?"

sentences.text: The question asked is indeed out of this world or the Universe.
There was no easy answer, and Kent, who had heard this, was left with a blank expression, staring at the white-bearded man, who wore a smile on his face, clearly enjoying Kent’s state of mind.
The question is illogical.
The heavens make up the universe.
These are the Rules (Daos).
They are destiny.
They are fate.
They are life and death.
They are everything.
As such, they can never rebel.
That is just impossible.
The heavens are everything, and so why would they rebel?
Who are they rebelling against?
That logic is not sound, and so Kent dismissed it.
However, he held it at the back of his mind.
After all, there is a second reason, which suggests that perhaps they are afraid of something or someone.
This logic is, in a way, sound.
The heavens are the Universe...
So, in a way, they are an entity.
Meaning the whole universe can be considered one powerful being.
So, if that is the case, then it can also mean this powerful entity might just have someone they fear, just like how even gods have fear.
This logic is sound, but it also leads to the last scenario, which involves someone taking over the universe.
If that is the case, then it means the universe can be controlled, the rules can be rewritten, and everyone’s fate and destiny will now be in the hands of the one who controls it.
If that is the case, then perhaps everything can change.
Kent suddenly felt like he had been enlightened...
He looked at the white-bearded man and smirked, "Your logic is sound but flawed.
You seek to learn about what happens if the Universe is being controlled by someone, when you should instead ask about who or what can confidently face the universe without a strand of fear.
That person is not me, and it is not you.
We don’t qualify to do that.
However, since you want to know what happens if the universe is no longer in control, then I will indulge you.
First, since the Universe is governed by laws, I can see those laws being rewritten.
Things like who gets to live and die now depend on who is in control.
I can see an entire cultivation base wiped out just because they contradict the new laws.
I can see an entire bloodline suppressed because they go against the natural flow of the laws.
There are so many things that could happen, but the most serious of them all is who is in charge.
Can they be stopped?
Do they have the means to completely destroy the entire Universe, or is something holding them back, preventing them from getting what they want?"
Kent smirked, seeing the expression on the white-bearded man’s face change.
He picked a white bead and placed it on the board.
"Talking logic demands deep thinking, not philosophy.
You tried to play mind games with me, thinking I was limited to my age.
However, you failed to realize one thing."
"And what is that?"
"I don’t need to think to know the answer to your question." Kent smiled, the image of a certain white-haired handsome man appearing in his mind.

"You see, I met someone before who I believe is an existence that is fighting against the heavens." This time, the white-bearded man’s expression was that of a pleading child begging to be enlightened.
Kent laughed, feeling a huge disgust for the man.
However, with many lives on the line, he suppressed his anger and spoke.
"I believe he was from a place where the heavens are no longer in control.
They had been rewritten and, as such, his nature was constantly fighting against them...
That is also why I believe the logic about whether the heavens can rebel is, in a way, illogical.
The heavens are emotionless; however, they are all-seeing, all-knowing, and self-sustaining.
If they feel threatened, they will look for a way to sustain themselves, even if it means summoning something or someone they even fear.
Now, consider the following scenario.
If you were to have the power to take over the heavens, then what would happen to you if somebody else, outside of time and space... someone whom the heavens are afraid of were to appear?"
"I will be afraid and try to annihilate them."
"Good.
However, what then happens if you can’t?
What then will you do?"
This time, the white-bearded man didn’t know what to say.
This caused Kent to smile.
"Cause and Effect, ever heard of it?"
"Yes." Now, the white-bearded man had become a student being lectured by the Chaos Dragon.

If you try to take over the Universe, the cause is you; you will become invincible; however, the effect will be the self-correction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1017: To Change One’s Fate [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Please tell me I didn’t die screaming," Kent asked, a smile playing on his face. For someone who just heard he will die in 5 years’ time, he was surprisingly composed.
Paragon smiled, "You were surprisingly quiet despite having your eyes dug out using a hot iron, limbs severed, flesh peeled off, and burned inside out."
Kent laughed, and so did Paragon, "I have to say, you are surprisingly tougher than you look. I am impressed."
"Well, thank you, kind sir. However, if you can tell me how to save my skin, that will be great. I have no plans on dying just yet, so let’s get on it."
"That is why I am here, Kent, to help you change your fate. However, it won’t be easy."

"As long as it saves me from dying, I don’t mind." Kent sighed. Dying is not a worry to him. However, thinking about the beauties he will leave behind, heartbroken and in tears, is what worries him. So, changing his fate is something he wouldn’t joke about.
"To change one’s fate is to defy the heavens, Kent. Are you ready to defy the heavens?"
"Could be fun," Kent smiled...
"It is indeed fun. However, you are still too weak to do that. Maybe in your universe, you can do that, but in mine, you are still too weak."
Kent nodded, already sensing something from Paragon that keeps making him feel inferior. "Then how does one become worthy of challenging the heavens?"
"That will depend on you, Kent. I cannot tell you because when the day comes, you will know, and you will have to make a decision on your own.
But what I can help you with is a way to overcome your limitations. As you already know, I am a Paragon, someone who doesn’t give a fuck what the heavens think.
So when it comes to breaking limits, I am the most qualified. So do you want to hear what I have to say?"
"Flow, Paragon... I am all ears."

"I don’t have much time, so listen carefully. This vessel I am wearing is a resourceful man. He has gathered an array of Primordial Flames for billions of years, grooming them for when he will meet you again.
In his eyes, he is waiting to play games with you. However, for your luck, you have met me. But for his misfortune, he met me.
Now, he will be sending you to a place where you will have to fight seven deadly foes. Naturally, you must win all seven battles.
However, after the battles, two doors will open for you. The left door will promise you the riches you are after... My advice is to ignore that and enter the right door.
It is called Hell Road, a dangerous path filled with terror and pain. However, that is the road you should walk.
If you manage to walk it completely, then know this: after living here, your journey to changing your fate will begin."
Kent nodded...

"You also cannot depend on your companions," Paragon said, looking at the Taming bracelet. "Since your plan is to farm Primordial Flames, allow them to do that. Your journey is a solo one, and you must walk it alone."
"Okay."
Kent noticed that Paragon’s appearance was starting to revert to that of the white-bearded man.
"At least tell me your real name since you know mine."

Paragon smiled and said, "When the Destiny Key calls, answer, and when the time comes, you will have a 2-minute window of defiance. My advice, relish it, for being a Paragon is dope as fuck, even if it lasts for just 2 minutes."
With a mocking smile, the white-bearded man appeared, causing Kent to smirk.
"Woooo, feels like I have eaten a mushroom," the white-bearded man said.
"You have no idea," Kent laughed and asked, "You owe me three wishes, Old Man. When can I redeem them?"
"Go ahead, wish away."
"Then I won’t be polite. Since I can’t use the wishes on myself," he paused and tapped the Taming Bracelet, and at once, Sylavara, Orvath, Kaelith, Zeraphine, Vey, Balrion, and Ignarok appeared.
"I wish for you to send my companions to a place where they can farm Primordial Flames." Kent smiled as he said that.
"Fine," the white-bearded man smirked.
Kent then turned to the seven monarchs, "Sorry, guys, but I will be parting with you for now. But fear not, nothing will happen to me.

However, you now have a golden opportunity. Use it well, and please, don’t be polite. If you can take all the Primordial Flames, do so. This old man picked the wrong dragon to play with." Kent gave the white-bearded man a look and a laugh.
He then retrieved the bracelet and handed it to Sylavara, "You can store the flames in there."
"Okay, Lord Chaos," Ignarok said, asserting dominance. "Fear not, you will have more than enough Primordial Flames when you return."
"Okay," he kissed Sylavara, and then he turned to the white-bearded man, "You can send them away."
With a wave of his hand, all seven monarchs vanished. "Some interesting beasts you have, Sage. Now, your second wish."
Kent smiled and said, "For my second wish, I wish for my companion, named Flura, to be sent to a place that will change her life for the better."
"Oh, come on. Isn’t that a bit vague?"
Kent smirked, "You are a god who governs this place. I am sure you have the best place to send her."
"I brought this on myself," the white-bearded man sighed and snapped his finger.
Somewhere in the Pill Ascension Realm, Pill Sage Flura was suddenly teleported away, appearing in front of a tall castle. In front of the castle, a name was boldly plastered:
"Pill Ascension Trial Tower."
The name said it all, so she didn’t hesitate to enter. After all, if she wants Pill Making Knowledge and Primordial Flames, she has arrived at the best place.
"It is done. Now, your last wish."
Kent laughed, "Simple, actually. I wish for the disciples of the Pyris Pill Alliance to enter the Disciple Trial of the Pill Ascension Sect."
"You—" the white-bearded man became angry, "How did you know such a place exists? You haven’t yet recovered your memory. I would know. So then how did you know?"
Kent chuckled, "Now, I know it exists thanks to you, so please send them there and make sure, within 30 days, they will come out wealthy and knowledgeable."
The white-bearded man stared at Kent for a few minutes before a sigh escaped his lips. "You know, I seem to have forgotten how annoying you are, Sage.
However, I will play your game. I just hope you don’t regret your actions."
"I wouldn’t be me if I had regrets, Old Man."
"Very well." The Old Man snapped his finger again, and this time, 24 people were sent into a trial where they would be groomed in the path of Alchemy.
By the time the 30 days are over, 24 knowledgeable Alchemists will emerge with knowledge about Alchemy that hadn’t appeared before in this current era.
After doing that, he turned to Kent, "Now, it is time for you to pay the price for your insolence."
"Bring it on, Old Man."
He snapped his finger, and Gaap appeared in the room with a twisted smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1018: Primordial Hell [Bonus]
paragraphs: "This is Gaap, lord of the Primordial Hell Tower," the white bearded man said, introducing the tattooed-faced man to Kent.
"Pleasure meeting you, Gaap."
"Pleasure is all mine, human," Gaap grinned, looking at Kent like how a predator looks at their prey.

"Gaap here will be taking you to the only place you will step in this place," the white-bearded man grinned, and then waved his hand, manifesting a tower. His tower has seven levels, and it seems to be connected by some invisible force.
"This is the Primordial Hell Tower. It has seven levels, each housing a High Grade Primordial flame known as the Seven Primordial Hell flames.
Since you are here for Primordial Flames, I saw it best to point you in the right direction. Or what do you think...Am I doing too much?" A mocking smile on his face.

However, instead of frowning, Kent smirked, "I think you have done just right." He gave the white bearded man the ’I will not give you the satisfaction you seek’ look, causing Gaap to burst out laughing.
"Nicely done, kid. I think you might just have some hell in you. Maybe you are the right person for this trial."
Kent smiled, and the white bearded man chuckled. "It is always like this, arrogance before you meet what awaits you."

"Old Man, stop scaring the kid. After all, they are all Tier 19 level warrior flames. With his abilities, I am sure he wouldn’t die until he meets Zariel, the Tormentor. I am sure he and the Primordial Agony Flame will have a nice chat."
Gaap said, accompanied by a laughter that caused Kent to frown.
’These two are colluding; however, it seems they are hiding something.’ Kent thought, then he asked.
"What do I get after defeating them?"
Both the white-bearded man and Gaap looked at him strangely, then burst out laughing resoundingly...
After laughing for a couple of minutes, they calmed down, and Gaap spoke.
"If, and this is a rather big if, but if you somehow manage to miraculously worm your way to the seventh floor and defeat Drazhul, then you will have two choices in the form of doors.

The left door leads to the Primordial Flame farm, where you get to pick as many dormant Primordial flames as you want. However, if you were to take the right, you would be taken to Hell road, where you must walk its treacherous path to damnation.
Nobody has ever returned from there...Point of correction: Nobody who used my Hell Road gate has ever returned.
However, to paint you a picture, so you don’t at least throw your life away, listen attentively because I won’t repeat myself."
Kent looked at the white-bearded man, who seemed to be relishing the conversation he was having with Gap.

"The hell road is a literal road in hell where every step of the way requires bloodshed. If you were to enter through my gate, it would take you to the 6th road, where you will have to walk through the realm of the fallen Angel Bliz.
Of course, because you entered from a high world, his strength will be at the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage, but he will fight with the experience of a demi-god.

Naturally, you shouldn’t even think that far ahead. After all, right after entering the hell road, you must first traverse the Sixth Primordial Hell flames sea, known famously as the six flames of hell...
I wouldn’t count on you traversing that sinister flame sea. So to make matters easy for you, take the path to your left, after all, you are here for primordial flames, right?"
"I will think of that when I get there," Kent smiled, "But I have a question."
"Ask"
"Do I only have 30 days to kill the seven hell flames and walk the hell road?"
Both Gaap and the white-bearded man looked at Kent, stunned. The way he sounded, it was like he had already made his choice, which baffled them.
Nobody in their right mind would dare challenge the seven hell flames. But since they are forcing it on him, they could sigh at that.
However, hearing him make the decision to walk the hell road, even asking about the duration, they couldn’t help but wonder if he had gone insane.
"Don’t look at me like that, Old man. I am here for a reason, and you know it, so answer my question. How long do I have since the pill Ascension realm closes in 30 days?"
"A day here is 10 years there. So if you were to enter now, you will have 300 years to kill Bliz." Gaap answered, his usual smile missing from his face.
Kent smiled, "Then what are we waiting for? Send me to the Primordial Hell Tower pronto."
Kent stood up and stretched, "I need a challenge, and since one has presented itself to me, I can only thank you two."

"Sage, you must be careful," the white bearded man said, sounding more concerned, "Like Gaap said, no one had ever returned from hell using the gate to the sixth level of hell. Do you really want to go there?"
Kent turns to the white-bearded man and smiles. "A wise man once said, You never know until you try it." He laughed and then added,

"I was born crazy, Old man. The me you knew was just a part of me that I never had the chance to express, but now I am back to my complete self, and even after many reincarnation cycles, I can tell I am still the same crazy person.
So let me be crazy. Who knows, I might just become the sixth lord of hell in 30 days’ time."

’There are many fairies waiting for me, hoping to spend eternity with me. If I were to die suddenly, that would break them. So I must change my fate, and if going to hell and back is the way, then that is what I will do.’
Kent sighs and looks at Gaap, "Take me to my destiny, buddy."
Gaap nodded and waved his hand, sending both himself and Kent to the entrance of Primordial Hell Tower.
"This is where I stop. Good luck, kid," Gaap said, and Kent nodded.
"Thank you, Gaap. See you later," Kent said with a smile as he stepped into the tower.
Meanwhile, back in the Pill Ascension Tower, the white-bearded man looked at Kent as he stepped into the tower with a complex expression.
"The person I knew was calculative and super intelligent for his own good, but never this crazy." He sighs and then waves his hand, manifesting a screen which shows Kent step into the tower.
"It is as if he had already anticipated this and came to a conclusion before I even made my plans known. However, if he manages to defeat all seven hell flames, I will be grateful.
After all, in 300 years, if they aren’t defeated, they will break free from my hold, and by then, this place will be reduced to ashes.
So this is a bet that must be won at all costs."

He smiled and gently tapped the screen showing Kent..."If you can defeat all seven hell flames, then I will give you the foundation of that legendary Flame technique...as to how fate wills it, the true technique will find you"
