Or what do you think...Am I doing too much?" A mocking smile on his face.

However, instead of frowning, Kent smirked, "I think you have done just right." He gave the white bearded man the ’I will not give you the satisfaction you seek’ look, causing Gaap to burst out laughing.
"Nicely done, kid.
I think you might just have some hell in you.
Maybe you are the right person for this trial."
Kent smiled, and the white bearded man chuckled.
"It is always like this, arrogance before you meet what awaits you."
"Old Man, stop scaring the kid.
After all, they are all Tier 19 level warrior flames.
With his abilities, I am sure he wouldn’t die until he meets Zariel, the Tormentor.
I am sure he and the Primordial Agony Flame will have a nice chat."
Gaap said, accompanied by a laughter that caused Kent to frown.
’These two are colluding; however, it seems they are hiding something.’ Kent thought, then he asked.
"What do I get after defeating them?"
Both the white-bearded man and Gaap looked at him strangely, then burst out laughing resoundingly...
After laughing for a couple of minutes, they calmed down, and Gaap spoke.
"If, and this is a rather big if, but if you somehow manage to miraculously worm your way to the seventh floor and defeat Drazhul, then you will have two choices in the form of doors.
The left door leads to the Primordial Flame farm, where you get to pick as many dormant Primordial flames as you want.
However, if you were to take the right, you would be taken to Hell road, where you must walk its treacherous path to damnation.
Nobody has ever returned from there...Point of correction: Nobody who used my Hell Road gate has ever returned.
However, to paint you a picture, so you don’t at least throw your life away, listen attentively because I won’t repeat myself."
Kent looked at the white-bearded man, who seemed to be relishing the conversation he was having with Gap.
"The hell road is a literal road in hell where every step of the way requires bloodshed.
If you were to enter through my gate, it would take you to the 6th road, where you will have to walk through the realm of the fallen Angel Bliz.
Of course, because you entered from a high world, his strength will be at the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage, but he will fight with the experience of a demi-god.
Naturally, you shouldn’t even think that far ahead.
After all, right after entering the hell road, you must first traverse the Sixth Primordial Hell flames sea, known famously as the six flames of hell...
I wouldn’t count on you traversing that sinister flame sea.
So to make matters easy for you, take the path to your left, after all, you are here for primordial flames, right?"
"I will think of that when I get there," Kent smiled, "But I have a question."
"Ask"
"Do I only have 30 days to kill the seven hell flames and walk the hell road?"
Both Gaap and the white-bearded man looked at Kent, stunned.
The way he sounded, it was like he had already made his choice, which baffled them.
Nobody in their right mind would dare challenge the seven hell flames.
But since they are forcing it on him, they could sigh at that.
However, hearing him make the decision to walk the hell road, even asking about the duration, they couldn’t help but wonder if he had gone insane.
"Don’t look at me like that, Old man.
I am here for a reason, and you know it, so answer my question.
How long do I have since the pill Ascension realm closes in 30 days?"
"A day here is 10 years there.
So if you were to enter now, you will have 300 years to kill Bliz." Gaap answered, his usual smile missing from his face.
Kent smiled, "Then what are we waiting for?
Send me to the Primordial Hell Tower pronto."
Kent stood up and stretched, "I need a challenge, and since one has presented itself to me, I can only thank you two."
"Sage, you must be careful," the white bearded man said, sounding more concerned, "Like Gaap said, no one had ever returned from hell using the gate to the sixth level of hell.
Do you really want to go there?"
Kent turns to the white-bearded man and smiles.
"A wise man once said, You never know until you try it." He laughed and then added,
"I was born crazy, Old man.

The me you knew was just a part of me that I never had the chance to express, but now I am back to my complete self, and even after many reincarnation cycles, I can tell I am still the same crazy person.
So let me be crazy.
Who knows, I might just become the sixth lord of hell in 30 days’ time."
’There are many fairies waiting for me, hoping to spend eternity with me.
If I were to die suddenly, that would break them.
So I must change my fate, and if going to hell and back is the way, then that is what I will do.’
Kent sighs and looks at Gaap, "Take me to my destiny, buddy."
Gaap nodded and waved his hand, sending both himself and Kent to the entrance of Primordial Hell Tower.
"This is where I stop.
Good luck, kid," Gaap said, and Kent nodded.
"Thank you, Gaap.
See you later," Kent said with a smile as he stepped into the tower.
Meanwhile, back in the Pill Ascension Tower, the white-bearded man looked at Kent as he stepped into the tower with a complex expression.
"The person I knew was calculative and super intelligent for his own good, but never this crazy." He sighs and then waves his hand, manifesting a screen which shows Kent step into the tower.
"It is as if he had already anticipated this and came to a conclusion before I even made my plans known.
However, if he manages to defeat all seven hell flames, I will be grateful.
After all, in 300 years, if they aren’t defeated, they will break free from my hold, and by then, this place will be reduced to ashes.
So this is a bet that must be won at all costs."

He smiled and gently tapped the screen showing Kent..."If you can defeat all seven hell flames, then I will give you the foundation of that legendary Flame technique...as to how fate wills it, the true technique will find you"

chapters.title: Chapter 1019: Kent Vs The Hell Flames (1)
paragraphs: [First Opponent - Primordial Abyssal Flame of Despair - Hell Lord: Morveth, the Despair Sovereign]

Right when Kent entered the Primordial Tower, the feeling of despair overwhelmed his senses. His surroundings changed, and then he found himself standing on a vast plain of black ash beneath an eternal twilight sky.
There were broken black pillars littered everywhere.
There were also broken weapons and bones everywhere. Most of these bones appeared to be buried in the ground, with only a few protruding partially through the dirt.
"Creepy," Kent said, looking around him.
However, just when he was about to look for the Hell Flame, his sixth sense kicked in, allowing him to narrowly evade the chain that came for him.
But that wasn’t all.
Just when the chain struck the ground, an explosion with devastating might occurred, pushing Kent back. His body was consumed in a mushroom of despair, dust, and heat.
But before he could relax and examine what was happening, he sensed a powerful chain coming at him again.
’Annoying’
15,000 flame veins kicked in, and this time, he not only dodged but also saw where it was coming from.
So with a wave of his hand, a sword came from his Soul Universe and flashed at deadly speed toward the location from which the chain came.
CLANG
He heard a clang sound, and then the sword flew back. Kent caught it in a firm grip, watching as a figure slowly appeared from thin air.
He was a tall person, with a skeletal frame, violet eyes, and long black hair. His height was approximately 3 meters, indicating that he wasn’t an ordinary person.
This discovery didn’t change Kent’s expression.
However, upon seeing what the person was wearing, he could only smile. It was a robe woven from what appeared to be screaming shadows, a sigh that he was indeed the flame of Despair.
"So they managed to send someone to their death again," Morveth, the human form of the Primordial Abyssal Flame of Despair, said with a chuckle.
"I don’t have much time, Mr., so if you have something to say, just say it before I kill you," Kent said with a sigh.
The pressure coming from Morveth was even higher than the Monarchs he tamed in the Flame Sea. However, even with that discovery, he wasn’t at all feeling despair.
In fact, his expression was still the same, showing he wasn’t being pressured by a mere flame.
Morveth looked at Kent and laughed, "I believe this is what they call arrogance. But I like it, makes killing you fun."
"So are those your last words?"
Morveth waved his hand, and thousands of chains manifested in the air and shot at Kent.
However, with a sigh, his body vanished, and then he appeared behind Morveth, his sword buried in his head.
"H-how?" Morveth asked, his expression bony and dark.
"I have flame veins, bitch." With a twist, Morveth’s body died, and a flame seed appeared in the air. Kent grabbed it and tossed it into his Soul Universe.
On the outside, Gaap gasped, seeing what had just happened.
"That didn’t just happen, right?... Right?"
He wasn’t the only one taken aback. The white-bearded man was the same. He saw Kent move, but then, as if he teleported, the next time he appeared, he was standing behind Morveth.
"I guess he really has what it takes to handle them." He smiled and then waved his hand, and a scroll appeared. The name, "Hell Flame Foundation Mantra," was written on the back.
He held it firm in his grip, deciding if he should give it to Kent or not.
Meanwhile, inside the Primordial Hell Tower, a door appeared leading to the second floor. Kent walked in and appeared in the next Hell Flame domain.
[Second Opponent - Primordial Flame of Wrath - Hell Lord: Kaelzor, the Wrath Tyrant]
This time, Kent appeared in an endless battlefield with rivers of lava everywhere.
If he were an ordinary flame user, it would be a no man’s land for him; however, as he stood, gazing at his opponent, all Kent could feel was the intent to kill.
"So you killed Morveth," Kaelzor, the humanoid form of the Primordial Flame of Wrath, said, a smug look on his lips.
He had a hulking body, with crimson skin marred by molten cracks across his arms and chest, and a fiery mane of hair.
"He was rather weak for a Primordial Flame," Kent said, holding a sword in his firm grip.
"I guess you are right, but here is where you die."
Kaelzor crossed his twin war axes, and then he slashed down, manifesting a flaming meteor in the air. The ground shook, and the air grew dense.
Kent narrowed his eyes when he saw the flaming meteor and felt the pressure bore down on him.
However, the next second, a smile appeared on his lips.
"Fake meteor. Why don’t I show you what a real meteor looks like?" He also slashed his sword, and a meteor, about half the size of the one Kaelzor manifested using his flame, appeared.
It fell with devastating force and blasted through the meteor that Kaelzor had manifested. Then still intact, he moved toward Kaelzor.
However, Kaelzor was an experienced warrior by the standard of a flame, so he launched an attack at the meteor.
"What an idiot." Kent, however, allowed him to attack his meteor because, to him, the main attack was in the event that his meteor was destroyed by his opponent.
BOOM
A powerful soul attack was unleashed when Kaelzor’s attack blasted through the meteor. Kent stood with a smile on his face as the soul shockwave blasted past him.
Kaelzor coughed; however, no blood came simply because he had no blood. However, for a crimson-gold flame, he had become rather pale.
He became very weak, so Kent merely walked toward him and held his sword to his neck.
"No hard feelings."
With a simple swing, the head came off. He stored the flame seed in his Soul Universe and entered the door leading to the third floor.
[Third Opponent - Primordial Flame of Agony - Hell Lord: Zariel, the Tormentor]
WHIP
Just when Kent appeared on the third floor, a whip came from behind him, sending a wave of power, one that caused Kent’s body to tremble.
Thankfully, he was using 15,000 flame veins, so he jumped into the air to evade.
However, while in the air, a figure appeared overhead, stabbing a spear toward his chest.
’Well played.’
Although he was in trouble, he couldn’t help but acknowledge the smartness deployed by Zariel, the Primordial Flame of Agony.
The attack was well-timed and executed.
’Too bad you met me.’ The soul map opened, and Kent vanished. In his place, a Tier 14 soul spirit appeared, and then BOOM, it exploded.
Zariel was blasted back, half his body gone.
"Sneak attacks don’t work on me, kid. I am the Faceless Assassin. I do the sneak attacks, not the other way round."
His sword went through Zariel’s chest, and then the Primordial Flame of Agony seed appeared. He grabbed it, and then with a mere look, he tossed it into his Soul Universe.
"Looks like as I climb higher, their strength increases," Kent noticed the change after nearly falling to Zariel’s sneak attack. Thankfully, he was prepared for anything, so he was able to survive.
The next door opened, and Kent walked in, appearing in the domain of Corruption. As soon as he stepped in, he began to sense his health depleting rapidly.
"This is where your luck ends, kid," Gaap said, a smug smile on his face. The Primordial Flame of Corruption was one of the most dangerous Hell Flames in existence...
So, being exposed to it, it was only a matter of time before his health ran out.
However, the next second, his expression changed from smugness to shock...

chapters.title: Chapter 1020: Kent Vs The Hell Flames (2) [End of Volume V]
paragraphs: [Fourth Opponent - Primordial Flame of Corruption - Hell Lord: Belphor, the Corruptor]
"Welcome to my domain, human," Belphor said, his expression smug.
Kent didn’t say anything, though his expression said he wasn’t having a good time. He could sense his health rapidly depleting from the moment he entered the domain of corruption.
"This is my domain, the domain of the Primordial Flame of Corruption. In here, all your healing abilities are sealed, so you can only do your best to kill me before you run out of health.
However, your dying isn’t too bad. With your strength, good looks, and even killing three hell flames, I will be sure to corrupt your body and make you my hell general of corruption.
You will play a big role in my conquest when I break free from this place."
Kent could tell the bastard had no plans on fighting him, so he stood 400 meters away, ready to make a run for it.
’A wise move if you want to wait for your opponent to die.’ Kent had to give it to the Primordial Flame of Corruption; he was a good schemer.
’Too bad you met me.’ Yet again, Kent had the best medicine for this disease.

"I have to say, your planning and plotting are spot on. You really have a higher chance of killing me. However, that was if you had met me before I attained the Nirvana body...." A smirk appeared on Kent’s lips.
He extended his hand, and a black flame appeared.
"Or before I got the Umbral Flame of Oblivion."
The moment the Nirvana flame appeared, the domain of corruption trembled. In an instant, all corruption in the domain started to be devoured by the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
"Is-is that a Nirvana flame?" Belphor’s body was trembling to the point that if he could sweat, he would be bathed in it by now.
Kent smiled. "Yes. The Umbral Flame of Oblivion. Are you scared?"
Belphor looked at the black flame that was rapidly devouring the domain and could only shudder in sheer terror.
"Please stop, I surrender," Belphor said, dropping to his knees. "If you don’t stop, I will cease to exist."
"Oh... Aren’t you a Primordial Flame? Aren’t you from the Universe, just like a Nirvana flame?"

"Yes. I am a Primordial Flame. However, I am only a High-grade Primordial Flame, not a True Primordial." Belphor was almost in tears, seeing that Kent had no plans of putting away the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
"What is the difference? This is also just a spark of the true Nirvana flame. So aren’t you all the same? I mean, you even have a seed unlike this one."

"Yes. But a Nirvana Flame is a True Flame regardless of the nature they are in. As for me, I am not even close to becoming a True Primordial Flame yet. Please, let me live, and I swear to serve you with everything I have."
Kent smiled, and then he put away the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
"There you go."
Belphor sighed.
"Thank you." He had come this close to dying, so he could only thank his savior.
If only he knew that things could have been much easier if Kent had used the Verdant Flame of Renewal to merely heal himself or the Radiant Flame of Purity to cleanse the corruption affecting him.
However, he didn’t want to do that simply because of something he wanted Belphor to do for him.
It was never in his plans to kill poor Belphor. Kent was not that wicked. The Primordial Flame of Corruption was powerful, and as someone going to hell, he needed something that powerful to aid him.
So he never planned on killing him in the first place.
Though he knew with a flame that had gained sentience, fear was the only way to make them submit to him.
So he unleashed the Umbral Flame of Oblivion, which, at the moment, looking at the expression on Belphor’s face, he knew he had made his stance clear.
"Can you contact the other Hell Flames?" Kent asked, and Belphor nodded.
"Good. Tell them what happened and advise them not to resist."
Belphor nodded and closed his eyes.
In the next five minutes, Kent subdued the other three flames named the Primordial Flame of Oblivion, the Primordial Soulflame of Damnation, and the Primordial Flame of Tyranny.
They surrendered, knowing true death awaited them if they resisted. Not even a sliver of their flame seeds would have remained.
Gaap held a shocked expression.
"He-he has a Nirvana flame. Just what kind of monster did I allow into my tower?" His expression showed both shock and fear.
Nirvana Flames, like Belphor said, are True Flames regardless of which form they are in. Therefore, it means Nirvana Flames don’t undergo a growth phase like Primordial Flames.
So naturally, Belphor, who was a mere High-Grade Primordial Flame, was no match for the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
However, Gaap’s shock and fear were from the fact that Kent was able to handle the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
Not even gods could handle a Nirvana flame like that. So for a mere mortal to have a handle on it that intimately, he was both in shock, and the fear was also evident.
"Is this even real?" he said, but looking at the expression on the White-bearded Man’s face, he could tell he wasn’t the only one in shock.
"I’ve underestimated you, Sage. You are much more dangerous than I gave you credit for," he said, his hand brushing through his beard.
"However, walking the hell road is different from defeating a Hell Flame. After all, the laws won’t allow you to use a Nirvana flame there...
It will be a trip of pure dedication and no interference from any Cosmic being."
He smiles.
Pill King Sark was mistaken about one thing... Primordial Flames are not Cosmic Flames; it’s rather Nirvana Flames that can be regarded as Cosmic Flames.
A Primordial Flame becomes a Cosmic Flame once it becomes a True Primordial Flame. Kent would be able to use his other flames aside from the Nirvana Flames in hell.
Then again, hell had no idea the kind of monster coming through.
(A/N: End of Volume V. It was a wild ride that I have to say, was a little over the top. Of course, we swerved off a bit, not ending as it was intended to go. However, it was a wild ride.
Now, we can only wait for what is coming.
Kent now has two major things he wanted to accomplish before going back.
One is to form a Flame Core. The second is to form the Blood Core Gate.
Of course, we have the minor ones, such as cultivating the Primal Body Tempering Art to unlock more of his bloodline powers and forming the Blood Life and Death Seals.
But hey, he is going to hell, so I believe anything can happen.
Of course, some of you are worried he wouldn’t have anything to do when he finally ascends to a high world.
Trust me, there is plenty waiting for him. After all, this is the Universe where there is a lot to do. So fear not, the Primordial Chaos Dragon hasn’t begun his conquest yet.
Volume VI: To Hell and Back)

Please, let me live, and I swear to serve you with everything I have."
Kent smiled, and then he put away the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
"There you go."
Belphor sighed.
"Thank you." He had come this close to dying, so he could only thank his savior.
If only he knew that things could have been much easier if Kent had used the Verdant Flame of Renewal to merely heal himself or the Radiant Flame of Purity to cleanse the corruption affecting him.
However, he didn’t want to do that simply because of something he wanted Belphor to do for him.
It was never in his plans to kill poor Belphor.
Kent was not that wicked.
The Primordial Flame of Corruption was powerful, and as someone going to hell, he needed something that powerful to aid him.
So he never planned on killing him in the first place.
Though he knew with a flame that had gained sentience, fear was the only way to make them submit to him.
So he unleashed the Umbral Flame of Oblivion, which, at the moment, looking at the expression on Belphor’s face, he knew he had made his stance clear.
"Can you contact the other Hell Flames?" Kent asked, and Belphor nodded.
"Good.
Tell them what happened and advise them not to resist."
Belphor nodded and closed his eyes.
In the next five minutes, Kent subdued the other three flames named the Primordial Flame of Oblivion, the Primordial Soulflame of Damnation, and the Primordial Flame of Tyranny.
They surrendered, knowing true death awaited them if they resisted.
Not even a sliver of their flame seeds would have remained.
Gaap held a shocked expression.
"He-he has a Nirvana flame.
Just what kind of monster did I allow into my tower?" His expression showed both shock and fear.
Nirvana Flames, like Belphor said, are True Flames regardless of which form they are in.
Therefore, it means Nirvana Flames don’t undergo a growth phase like Primordial Flames.
So naturally, Belphor, who was a mere High-Grade Primordial Flame, was no match for the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
However, Gaap’s shock and fear were from the fact that Kent was able to handle the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
Not even gods could handle a Nirvana flame like that.
So for a mere mortal to have a handle on it that intimately, he was both in shock, and the fear was also evident.
"Is this even real?" he said, but looking at the expression on the White-bearded Man’s face, he could tell he wasn’t the only one in shock.
"I’ve underestimated you, Sage.
You are much more dangerous than I gave you credit for," he said, his hand brushing through his beard.
"However, walking the hell road is different from defeating a Hell Flame.
After all, the laws won’t allow you to use a Nirvana flame there...
It will be a trip of pure dedication and no interference from any Cosmic being."
He smiles.
Pill King Sark was mistaken about one thing...
Primordial Flames are not Cosmic Flames; it’s rather Nirvana Flames that can be regarded as Cosmic Flames.
A Primordial Flame becomes a Cosmic Flame once it becomes a True Primordial Flame.
Kent would be able to use his other flames aside from the Nirvana Flames in hell.
Then again, hell had no idea the kind of monster coming through.
(A/N: End of Volume V.
It was a wild ride that I have to say, was a little over the top.
Of course, we swerved off a bit, not ending as it was intended to go.
However, it was a wild ride.
Now, we can only wait for what is coming.
Kent now has two major things he wanted to accomplish before going back.
One is to form a Flame Core.
The second is to form the Blood Core Gate.
Of course, we have the minor ones, such as cultivating the Primal Body Tempering Art to unlock more of his bloodline powers and forming the Blood Life and Death Seals.
But hey, he is going to hell, so I believe anything can happen.
Of course, some of you are worried he wouldn’t have anything to do when he finally ascends to a high world.
Trust me, there is plenty waiting for him.
After all, this is the Universe where there is a lot to do.
So fear not, the Primordial Chaos Dragon hasn’t begun his conquest yet.
Volume VI: To Hell and Back)

chapters.title: Chapter 1021: Going to Hell
paragraphs: Kent stood, staring at two doors.
The one on his left has a white portal showing that it leads to a domain of wealth. Naturally, that was where Kent would have gone if these were normal times.
However, looking at the red portal leading to hell, he knew that was where his destiny led, so he wouldn’t back down now.
Suddenly, the white-bearded man appeared alongside Gaap.
"So you’ve made your decision, huh?" he asked, and Kent nodded.
"Time for me to go to Hell, Old Man." Kent smiled, knowing the words he said weren’t something a normal person would have said so casually.
The white-bearded man could only shake his head and said, "I have been to hell before, but not through the Hell Road. However, I have knowledge of how Hell Road works, so listen."
Kent nodded, knowing every little piece of information would be great at this moment.
"Hell Road is a mechanism created by the universe to determine who gets to preside over a level of hell. It is said there are 13 levels of hell, each governed by a Hell Lord.
And yes, the flames you have are also Hell Lords, but in the realm of primordial flames.
However, the Hell Road is a way for you to challenge the current Lord of Hell to a duel to the death. Of course, the duel is just a fancy way of making it sound formal.
In truth, walking the Hell Road has to deal with literally walking through the various domains in hell until you arrive in the domain where you will face the true Hell Lord.

You will face Hell Kings and Queens, Hell Generals, Hell Warriors, Hell Demons, and so many more. After all, you will have the mark of a Hell Challenger, and that will act as a beacon telling everyone you are walking the Hell Road.
The only silver lining is that everyone will be suppressed to the level of a High World for you, since you are entering from a High World, thanks to my laws.
However, I’m not sure if they will feel suppressed. But from what I know, you will only face Heavenly Ascension Stage warriors and below.
It is going to be very dangerous, so be prepared."
The white-bearded man sighed, "One other thing, Nirvana Flames don’t work there, so don’t count on it."
"Thank you for telling me this."
"Don’t worry about it. If you make it out, perhaps we will meet again in the future... After all, you are far from home."
Kent smiled as the white-bearded man vanished, leaving only Gaap.
"Well, do you have anything to say?" Kent asked, and Gaap stood there for 5 good minutes before a sigh escaped his lips.
"I am coming with you."
"Sorry, but this is a solo mission, meaning I will be doing it alone," Kent smiled.
"I know. However, you need me to guide you, and since I am from the 6th level of hell, I wouldn’t be considered a third party.
Also, you don’t have a good sword, so I might as well become the sword you never had." Gaap smiled, and then he transformed into a sword, causing Kent to widen his eyes.
"It has been billions of years since I took my true form. I even seem to have forgotten my own nature. However, many years ago, I was known as the Bloodforge Sovereign.
I don’t know where I came from; however, I once woke up in hell and lived there for several thousand years.

The name I gave myself was Sanguis Nihil, a name that invokes terror and ultimately gave me my title, which, to this day, when mentioned in both hell and the underworld, evokes the eternal scent of blood."
Kent felt something within him stir when he heard Gaap’s true name. It was like a part of him, a part he had long forgotten, was now standing right before him.
He paid close attention to the sword, noticing every key detail. The more he looked, the more impressed he became.

The blade is a dark crimson steel, veined with glowing molten cracks, as if blood itself is sealed within. The guard is shaped like jagged horns, bleeding ember-red, and the handle is wrapped in scorched black leather as a blood-misty aura rises from it.
"I don’t know how or why, but watching you fight, I feel like we share a destiny. This is why I decided to reappear in the Universe again as your sword.
For now, you don’t have the power to wield me, but I will suppress myself to the level of a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior so as to match your power.
One day, when you reach the stage worthy to wield me, I will unseal myself."
Kent smiled, "A living sword, huh... I never expected to find one here."
"Be grateful," Gaap said. "So what do you say... am I worthy to be your sword?"
Kent smiled and walked toward the sword. He used his finger to cut his palm, then, without hesitation, he wrapped his fingers around the handle, forming a bloody bond with it.
However, right when the contract was formed, Gaap trembled... "You—you walk the path of blood." His voice was filled with shock...
"Indeed. My path is that of blood, so I believe we are going to have so much fun together."
If Gaap had been hesitant to form a contract with Kent, then now, learning he walks the path of blood, he couldn’t be happier.
"True. I believe we will have so much fun."

And just like that, two evil people who shouldn’t have met did, and it was all thanks to a certain Paragon who failed to tell Kent that to change his fate, he must only form a contract with the Bloodforge Sovereign...
But I guess this Paragon loves to see people suffer, so he left out the most dangerous part, which has to do with entering hell, where the rules aren’t exactly managed by the heavens...
Kent was never meant to go to hell, but Paragon sent him there. As to why he did that, only the future can disclose that.
Kent turned in a certain direction and nodded, "Until next time, Old friend."
With that, Kent stepped into the red door...
[Sixth Level of Hell - 14 Hell Towers & Bliz, the Fallen Angel]
One would expect hell to be a burning inferno where the painful cries of the damned would be heard.
However, it is nowhere near that.
Of course, it is a place of great suffering, a place where the damned are sent to live the rest of their life in eternal damnation.
At the very moment, every head in the sixth level of hell was looking up at the sky, staring at 14 beams of light painting the sky red.
"The Hell Road has been opened."
These words came to everyone’s mind, causing them all to cheer and shout, "Let the hunting begin."
Somewhere in the sixth level of hell, inside a castle made from the skull of a god, sat a man with red horns, black angel wings, and skin littered with scars, some even dripping with red molten lava.
His entire face had tattoos, and his eyes were so red that just a mere gaze would be enough to end the existence of an immortal.
"Another one has arrived," he muttered, looking into the distance.
He then tapped the skull acting as the knob of his throne handle and spoke, "Hell demons, the time has come to hunt. Have fun, and may one of the next Hell lords rise from your bunch."
With a laughter that caused the very heavens to tremble, his voice was sent to everyone, starting the eternal hunt for the one who dared challenge the Hell Lord, the Fallen Angel Bliz.

chapters.title: Chapter 1022: Damned Hell Sea
paragraphs: Clear skies.
Open green flame sea.
Deadly waters.

"This is going to be a wild ride," Kent said, standing on top of a mountain, gazing at the vast open sea, burning green with flames so lethal he knew things wouldn’t end well for anyone who dared enter this sea.

[This is the Sea of hell. It can be found on every level in hell...However, this one is known as the Damned Hell Sea. It contains the souls of the damned, those who never qualified to live in any of the 14 cities in this level of hell.]
"I need more context, Gaap." Kent gazed at Gaap, who had transformed back into his human form and was seated beside him on a mountain overlooking a vast green sea.
He had just arrived in hell, but found himself outside the true 6th level of hell. He discovered that the sixth level of hell is called Nex Morbus and is ruled by a fallen angel named Bliz.
He also learned there are 14 cities in hell, with each ruled by either a hell king or queen. Also, there is the sea that surrounds the entire sixth level.
Right now, he is staring at this sea, and what he is looking at doesn’t inspire confidence. As his guide, Kent wants Gaap to tell him everything he needs to know before taking his next step.

[The 14 cities in Nex Morbus are like societies that have specific people (hell demons) they house. These beings work every day to sustain themselves because in hell, there is no family. Of course, there are teams that are mostly led by either a hell commander or general.
However, if you don’t meet any of these requirements, then you are cast into the Damned Hell Sea. Those who also lose their statues simply because they lack hell coins are also cast into it.
Basically, the Damned Hell Sea contains the souls of people who are in pain, extremely dangerous, and are eager to feed.
From time to time, unfortunate people find themselves transported to hell. These people are cast into the sea because they are still alive, and the souls of the damned feed on them.
You are still alive, so you are like a hot meal to them.]
"But I believe there is a way to survive...right?"
Gaap turns and looks at Kent and says, "If you had your Nirvana Flames, then perhaps. However, without it, you can only fight your way through and hope that is enough."
"I see," Kent didn’t rush to jump into the sea. He first examined his options...
However, Gaap didn’t allow him to sink into his thoughts...

[Though I have to say, the Damned Hell Sea is a primordial flame...A divine Primordial Flame, to be exact. Additionally, I was told that the deeper you sink, the hotter it gets, and the hotter it becomes, the more potent the flame essence.
Some even say that if you manage to sink to the bottom, the potency of the flame essence is akin to a Supreme Primordial Flame.]
"Now, that is something I can work with." Kent smiles.
When he subdued the 7th Hell flame, he strangely received a scroll that contained the Foundation technique called Hell Flame Art.
Essentially, this technique enables one to cultivate seven Primordial flames and form seven distinct entities from them.
He can form a Human, a demon, an Angel, a Beast, and many more. Of course, the foundation is merely for him to form these entities.
Now he has seven Primordial flames, each a deadly one; he could only thank his lucky stars he managed to get when he didn’t even know he needed them.
So Kent wasn’t about to use them to form his core. They are for the Hell Flame Art.
However, now, hearing what Gaap said, he knew he would be able to form his core using an even potent form of a Primordial flame.
’Agni told me the more potent the flame essence, the higher my chances of success in forming a flame core, ’ Kent said, knowing this is indeed the most ideal way to form his core.
[What are you thinking?] Gaap asked, looking at the smile on Kent’s face.
Kent turns to him and asks, "How deep is the Damned Hell Sea, and how dangerous does it get as I head deeper?"
Gaap looked at Kent with widened eyes; however, he answered.

[It will take approximately 1 year to reach the button if you were to have your Nirvana flame, but without them, if you somehow manage to handle all obstacles, then you will need between 3 and 5 years to reach the button.
As to the danger level, let’s just say you will wish you never ventured there.]
"I see," Kent thought for a moment, then he decided to make his final plans.
’I will use this flame to form my core. It is potent and perfect for what I am after. However, to get to the bottom of the damned hell sea, I need to be prepared.
This means I need to refine the Blood Life and Death Seal I have and absorb the blood essences I have before doing anything.’
He sighed, ’Then I will form my core and, if possible, form the next set of flame veins before coming out. I can tell this time, the journey will be tough, so I might as well be prepared.’
Kent turned to Gaap and said, "I will be spending the next 6 months working on something very important. Use this time to explore some part of the sea and gather as much intel as you can find.
Once I am done, we will head to the bottom of the Damned Hell Sea. I need to be prepared, and the only way to do that is to go to the bottom."
[Okay.]
Gaap transformed into a sword and dived into the sea.
"This is going to be bloody," Kent smiled, already anticipating when he would also dive into the sea.
He retrieved two tokens, one white and one red, and made them hover in front of him.
Refining them will take at least 2 months each. Thankfully, he has the soul Universe to aid in refining them.
So he formed a hand seal and started to refine them. If he manages to refine both, then his health will be on a new level, while his killing strikes will also become deadly.
[Somewhere in the Underworld]
Just like how there are 13 levels of hell, there are also 13 levels of the underworld, each a place with its own laws and culture.
At the moment, inside an Inn in the 9th level of the Underworld, a dark-haired beauty held a freshly brewed Underworld ginger wine in a tall glass, looking out the window.
Looking in the direction she was staring, one could see a tall, dark castle in the distance, its walls impenetrable.

Suddenly, a young man wearing a black hat entered the Inn and walked toward this dark-haired lady. However, before he could sit down, the young lady glared at him, causing him to smile and hesitate before sitting down.
"You never change, Nyx," The man said.
"What do you want, Bilad. As you can see, I am sightseeing and I want my peace of mind."
Bilad looked out the window and saw where she was looking at causing him to laugh.
"Stop dreaming, Nyx. People like you and me don’t get to rule over the underworld."
"Maybe people like you. Not me." Nyx smirked, "One day, I will become a queen of the Underworld."

"Whatever makes you sleep at night, I guess." Bilad smirked, "However, before your suicide mission, know that someone had activated a Hell Road, meaning there will be entertainment. Do you want to pop down to hell and have a look?"
Nyx glares again at Bilad and knocks him, "Why didn’t you lead with that, stupid?"

Suddenly, a young man wearing a black hat entered the Inn and walked toward this dark-haired lady.
However, before he could sit down, the young lady glared at him, causing him to smile and hesitate before sitting down.
"You never change, Nyx," The man said.
"What do you want, Bilad.
As you can see, I am sightseeing and I want my peace of mind."
Bilad looked out the window and saw where she was looking at causing him to laugh.
"Stop dreaming, Nyx.
People like you and me don’t get to rule over the underworld."
"Maybe people like you.
Not me." Nyx smirked, "One day, I will become a queen of the Underworld."
"Whatever makes you sleep at night, I guess." Bilad smirked, "However, before your suicide mission, know that someone had activated a Hell Road, meaning there will be entertainment.
Do you want to pop down to hell and have a look?"
Nyx glares again at Bilad and knocks him, "Why didn’t you lead with that, stupid?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1023: Report & Decision
paragraphs: [Five Months Later - Shore of the Damned Hell Sea]
Kent sat with his expression focused as he stared at two runes, one black, the other white, hovering in front of him.
From the white rune, he could sense dense life energy. In fact, all around him, despite the place being a rocky mountain, weeds started to grow...
Well, weeds started to grow on one side, while on the other side, every life that appears dies the next instant.

He had refined the Blood Life and Death Seal, finally getting the runes he would implant into his soul. Once successfully implanted, then, per what Kent knows, his health will be boosted by 10,000%, making him a literal immortal.
However, that isn’t all. Once he implants the Life Seal, his Eternal Draconic regeneration ability will also experience a boost.
This will allow him to regenerate his arms and legs in under a minute, should they be severed. Although he can’t regenerate his entire body from only his heart or head, this is already enough.
As for the Death Seal, if at first he needed to stab a dragon 10 times to kill it, now he needs only five, and as more Death Seals are added, so would his killing intent increase.
Basically, if he keeps creating and refining more blood death seals, it will get to a point where his mere gaze will be enough to kill a god.

"Now, the best part," Kent gestured with his hand, and the Blood Life Seal moved and entered his forehead. A few seconds later, a nourishing feeling washed through his body, filling him with life energy.
He could feel his core filled with so much life energy that he couldn’t help feeling like an immortal.
Then he gestured, and the Blood Death Seal also entered his forehead. This time, he sensed a bloodthirsty energy coursing through his body, filling him with a potent killing intent...
’I don’t know how deep Pill Monarch Nefeli’s killing intent went, but from what I sense, I am sure I am not too far from what I sense from her.’
Kent smiled, already feeling he was finally becoming someone worthy of walking the Blood Path.
"It is going to take so much bloodshed to create another Blood Seal. However, if I have the time, I will do everything I can to create another one.
Hopefully, once I complete the quest and kill the Planet King, I will receive two more seals. By then, nobody in any High World would be able to compare themselves to me... I think."
Kent sighed and then spread out his soul map, but couldn’t find Gaap.
"Looks like he is not back yet," he sighed, and then he waved his hand, bringing out the seed of the seven hell flames he had subdued.
He first wanted to study them and then, after he figured out what to make of them, he would use the Hell Flame Art to create his foundation.
"Hopefully, one day, I will be able to confidently beat my chest and say I have done all I could and now, I have nothing to fear."
A month later, a sword shot out from the Damned Hell Sea and stopped before Kent. It transformed into a face-tattooed man who walked forward and sat beside Kent.
Three days later, Kent opened his eyes.
"You are back," he said, noticing Gaap beside him. "How was your trip?"
[I managed to gather some intel, but I couldn’t go much deeper. However, since I am from this world, I was able to roam freely in the outer region of the sea.
However, that all changed when I went about 50,000km deep into the sea. Even with my nature, I was attacked by damned souls all over.
I managed to reach a depth of 75,000km. But that was all I could get to before I had to come back. Of course, if I were to unseal myself, I would have gone much deeper.
But that would have created unnecessary trouble for you, so I limited myself to the Heavenly Ascension stage and managed to reach the deeper depths of the Outer Layer.]
Kent nodded.
Gaap is a living sword.
Although he can be considered a soul weapon, his nature is no different from that of a living person. This means his strength is considered equivalent to that of a living cultivator.
Instead of grading him as a divine, supreme, or Celestial grade sword, he is now a Heavenly Ascension stage living sword whose true cultivation is True Immortal.
But because he is now linked to Kent, who can’t wield his true strength, he has to limit himself.
"So with the 75,000km you reached, how far would I have to go to reach the bottom?" Kent asked, and Gaap smiled.
[The Damned Hell Sea has three layers. There is the Outer Layer, which goes as deep as 100,000km. I am not sure about this number, but it is roughly within that range, and it is fraught with peril.
Then there is the Inner Layer, which, if I were to guess, is even deeper than the Outer Layer. So let’s approximate that to be 150,000km deep.
Then, if you somehow manage to reach the Core Layer, which I am unsure how deep or dangerous it is, we can estimate its depth to be approximately 200,000km.
So, putting all this together, we are tracking between 450,000km and 500,000km deep.
So my 75,000km reconnaissance is not that important if you ask me. However, there is a silver lining, and that is if we manage to make it to the Inner Layer, leaving a trail of bodies behind us.]
Kent furrowed his brow, "How would that help us?" he asked.
[Since you are walking the blood path, then I only assume you need blood essence to cultivate your techniques.]
Kent nodded.
[Since that is the case, you should know I have an ability that allows me to take the blood essence of any being killed by me or my wielder.
Of course, I don’t need the True Blood Essence. What I absorb is the Resentful Blood Essence, which all beings have.
So the more we kill, the stronger we become. Meaning if we were to brave the danger and face the beings hidden in the sea, we would have the means to face the Inner Layer and perhaps the Core Layer.
However, it will be extremely dangerous and time-consuming... though the rewards are just too good to pass up on.]
Kent smiled and waved his hand, manifesting 604 blood essence. Then he formed a hand seal, causing the blood essence to start flying into his forehead.
As they were absorbed, Kent could feel his Primal Body Tempering Art stir and begin to absorb all the blood essence.
In no time, he absorbed all 604 blood essences, and his Primal Body Tempering Art reached 17% completion.

Aside from that, he could now use 12% of his bloodline. Of course, his Bloodline Awakening was still at 19% and no new Bloodline Aspect had awakened. But he can channel 12% of his bloodline, so that is something.
’This is better than none.’
Kent channeled the soul universe into his index finger and drew a rune in the air. When it formed, he pressed it against Gaap’s forehead.

"This will allow you to reap the blood of every kill we make and store it in a pool I created in my soul universe. Kindly extract only high-quality blood, for I will need it for my first blood-cleaning bath."
[Okay.]
Kent smiled and stood up...
"I am here to get stronger, Gaap. This means I am here to train, and if bloodshed is the way, then let’s paint the sea red."
[I like your style of thinking.]
Gaap turned back into a sword, and Kent jumped on it. Then, with one shift dash, the Primordial Chaos Dragon entered the sea to begin his journey down to Purgatory.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024: Into The Damned Hell Sea
paragraphs: The moment Kent entered the sea, he started to hear wailing sounds.
It felt like the very flames burning around him were screaming. Of course, the feeling of water was also around him, but Kent felt the heat even more than the water.
This made him smile.
After all, he could tell his movement would not be hindered in any way.
However, there was a downside, and that was the heat.

He could tell from the heat that his flame resistance would have to step in. However, learning that he would be traveling perhaps 450,000km deep made him see the flaw in the advantage he had received.
If his flame resistance could not handle it anymore, then it meant he wouldn’t be able to reach the depth of the Damned Hell Sea.
In that case, his chances of using perhaps a Supreme Primordial Flame - if the rumors were true - to form his Flame Core would be boycotted.

However, forming 35,000 flame veins and a Perfect Flame Resistance counted for something. Additionally, since Kent’s body naturally adapted to the heat in its surroundings, he saw this as an opportunity to kill two birds with one stone.
If he were able to cultivate his Resistance in this Hell Sea, then perhaps reaching Transcendent or even Flame Immunity wouldn’t be impossible.
Kent stood on his sword as he moved deep into the Damned Hell Sea.
[You will start getting attacked from 12,000km, so be prepared]
Gaap’s voice reached Kent’s ears as they moved deeper into the sea.
"I am prepared, Gaap. This is my only chance to become super strong, so I won’t mess up." Kent’s Soul Map was open, and he could already see thousands of Damned hell beasts coming toward him.
He could tell there was no dodging them, so the best thing was to fight. Naturally, he was already prepared for that, as he had no plans of hiding or avoiding them.
’They are all sea beasts. Sharks, dolphins, seahorses, and many more,’ Kent said inwardly, looking at the Damned souls coming at him.
’Looks like I will consider this an appetizer, though the weakest is only level 1 Heavenly Ascension,’ Kent smiled.
’If I manage to reach the bottom, no Heavenly Ascension stage warrior should dare be arrogant before me,’ Kent bragged, and then he brought his flying to a halt and picked up the sword.
Behind him, 10 flying swords appeared and created a halo, spinning slowly as Kent started using his own speed to move.
’The soul spirits will come in handy this time around.’ Kent smiled evilly, and then he summoned a Tier 18 soul spirit of one of the beasts he had killed during his stay in the Flame Sea.
Using the teleport skill, he teleported the soul spirit to the middle of the beasts coming 7,000km away and snapped his finger, triggering the explosion.
The explosion was very loud, powerful, and deadly.
Thousands of Damned souls died, and many more were injured. In an instant, the green sea turned red, and Kent, who had seen this, smiled before he teleported away.
He appeared at the center of this devastation, and using the disorientation these beasts were in, he started to kill them.
[Smart play]
Gaap said as he slid through the body of a dolphin.

Kent smiled and then moved like the wind, appearing between ten seahorses. Because they were still not recovered from the soul shockwave that struck them, Kent merely used his mind to move the ten swords, killing them.
But that didn’t end there. Since he had a couple of minutes to himself, he could only kill more.
Within a minute, thousands of Damned soul beasts died, but that was merely a drop in the hundreds of thousands of beasts still coming.
Eventually, Kent started to sense the Damned soul beasts that were still active, simply because they were too far away, and they started closing in on him.
"Flame Rings"
Kent activated one of the Divine Grade Flame Techniques he had learned in the Flame Tower back in Sonox, creating a ring of flames, 100 meters wide.
This ring was like a power dampener. The moment a third party entered, their agility, strength, and health would be lowered by 30%.

Since Kent was now surrounded on all sides, he knew this was the only way forward. So he activated it, and with his movement now boosted thanks to the 500 flame veins he was using, he started to kill.
Kent wanted to adapt to the battle, so he started with only 500 flame veins, and as the pressure mounted, he would use more of them.
A Sea Bull lunged at Kent with its mouth open, green flames forming, and its body expanding. Clearly, it wanted to use its own weight to suppress Kent and blast him with green flames.

However, Kent had seen this coming long before it made a move. So right when it lunged forward, the ten spirit swords moved, and with one quick strike, which saw the ten swords flash through the air, the Sea Bull was slaughtered.
Its limbs were cut off, and its stomach was cut open, causing its intestines and other digestive organs to pour out.
Kent didn’t even turn to look since more of such sights started appearing all around him.
Soul Map was his eyes and ears, so he didn’t have to look at what happened with his own eyes to know.
WHOSH
Suddenly, an arrow moved past Kent’s ear. Well, it was more like he dodged an arrow that came from a Bone Fish. This Damned hell beast was a rare type of sea creature made of exoskeleton.
It is dangerous, and its bones are coated in potent poison. Naturally, with just one graze of its arrows, Kent would have been poisoned, and what was even worse, he would have been cocooned.
From where he was now, just a moment of recklessness would have cost him his life.
Thankfully, he saw the arrow coming.
’A level 2 Tier 19 beast, huh... Your core will be perfect to train my poison resistance,’ Kent said, and the next moment, he appeared beside the beast and severed its head.
Then, without even waiting for the core to come out of its head, he moved, and the head also vanished.
Just like how many flame cores were vanishing from the battlefield, this one also vanished. Naturally, this was all thanks to the Soul Map.
All Kent had to do was create a condition in his Soul Universe that if any type of flame core or any core he found a liking for appeared, the Soul Map should transport it into the Soul Universe.
As his soul strength continued to rise, he started to unlock more uses of the Soul Universe. Universal soul storage is the new ability...
[This is surprisingly going better than I expected]
One hour later, Gaap said, seeing Kent was surprisingly calm and composed as thousands of beasts continued to die every minute.
Kent smiled, hearing Gaap’s voice in his head. They both were swimming in Blood Essence and Resentful Blood Essence, so their enthusiasm was on another level.
Of course, they had already moved past 30,000km, so there was a reason for their enthusiasm.
’Gaap, you have to know that I have Jade beauties waiting for me back home. So when it comes to my safety, I don’t joke with it.’
Gaap, despite being in a sword, could only hum, telling Kent he was not buying his bullshit.
No sane person would willingly walk to Hell and dive headfirst into the Damned Hell Sea if they valued their life...

chapters.title: Chapter 1025: Damned Bone Fish (Sea Terror) [Bonus]
paragraphs: [A month later - 45,000km deep in the Damned Hell Sea]
BOOM
A flame exploded in Kent’s face, sending him flying 1,000km away.

"Damn, these bastards are shameless," Kent cursed as he used the Soul Map to teleport 30,000km away, only to deal with an abyssal cannon shark, a rather unusual breed of sharks that are known for firing long-range ballistic flame missiles.
Of course, if it were merely firing it, then Kent wouldn’t have been struck. However, these Damned Hell beasts have a special ability that teleports their missiles to their target.
So, despite having the Soul Map, Kent was still struck. However, looking at his skin, one could tell either that his skin is very thick or that his healing speed is monstrous.
Naturally, he has both, showing the kind of monster he is.
Kent teleports again, and another abyssal cannon shark was dealt with.
It had already been a month since Kent entered the Damned Hell Sea, and for the past month, he had never had a moment to rest.

In fact, he had been fighting for a month now, and from the look of things, he will be fighting for another month now that these annoying Damned Hell beasts are evading his surveillance with their attacks.
However, he had gone 45,000km deep into the Damned Hell, so that counted for something.

However, thinking about the 55,000km still left for him to go before entering the Inner Layer, Kent could only smile and teleport to another abyssal cannon shark while his soul swords worked in sync to kill the thousand Damned Hell beasts coming at him.
[Let me handle the abyssal cannon sharks. You can handle the others. When we reach 70,000km deep, the tide will lessen, though the strength of the Damned Hell beasts will also rise.
But at least we will have a breather.
I have absorbed so much resentful blood essence that I need to fully absorb and refine it before another major battle, and I know you also have a lot of blood essence to absorb and refine.]
Kent couldn’t question Gaap’s plan. He indeed needed to absorb the blood essence he had gathered so he could increase his strength.
That will give him an urge to do more.
"Good plan, Gaap. Go handle them."
The sword moved on its own and started teleporting from one abyssal cannon shark to the next. Meanwhile, Kent retrieved two daggers from his space ring.
"I am still far from being pressed to a corner for me to use my bloodline." With a smile on his face, he activated the flame wheels, and thousands of Damned Hell beasts began to be slaughtered.
Slowly, the number of abyssal cannon sharks started to drop. This showed Gaap was doing his work diligently.
But Kent wasn’t playing around either.

"I am surprisingly agile when using daggers," Kent said, slicing the throat of a sea horse, and then, with a turn, he stabbed his second dagger into the head of one more beast before teleporting away.

"I guess it is because I am a swordsman, that’s why I can fight in close combat using daggers." Yet again, he used his combo, slicing through the necks of three beasts. With a twist, he stabbed the other two.

However, before he could teleport away, a Shadow Fin Tiger fish appeared and stabbed him with its pointed mouth. Kent saw the attack and twisted his body to evade, but he underestimated the speed at which the beast came.

The razor-sharp fins on its head and back grazed his arm, cutting a deep wound. Instead of moving away, Kent endured the pain, which was nothing to him, and stabbed the beast in the eye before carving a deep cut into its side, ending its pitiful life.
However, before he was even done killing the beast, the wound on his hand had begun healing at a rather fast pace.
But by the time he picked his next target, it had healed and the flesh regenerated, sealing every evidence of ever being hurt.
"Ouch"
Kent was pierced in the chest and was pushed back a couple of meters by another Shadow Fin Tiger fish.
"These long-mouthed fish are dangerous," Kent had to acknowledge the danger this beast posed. They are agile, even faster than him, despite using 15,000 flame veins with the Flame Wheels active.
A smile appeared on his lips as he threw one of his daggers, which circled around and stabbed the eyes of the Shadow Fin Tiger fish.
"Big Sister Enzi was right, unless I go out and dominate everyone, I shouldn’t say I’m the strongest." Kent moved, and with a speed that was blinding, more blood started to spray like a fountain.

"However, I am no weakling, so until I am at my limit, I wouldn’t use more flame veins." One of his daggers moved through the hordes of beasts, killing them at a rate no Core Formation cultivator would even be able to pull off with Tier 8 targets.
"When I next meet Paragon, I want to feel like his equal. So I must challenge myself."
Many Heavenly Ascension stage warriors would run with their tails burning behind them if they were to face this horde of Damned Hell beasts.
However, a mere Core Formation stage warrior had the audacity to hold himself back and even use them as training dummies.
One would ask where the logic is, for there is no logic in what Kent is doing.
He is still seven realms below these beasts. However, he is killing them as if they were mere bugs.
[Two months after entering the Damned Hell Sea - 70,000km deep into the Outer Layer]
"Gaap, you are right. The number of Damned Hell beasts here is much lower. Though their strength is no joke," Kent said, standing on his sword as they sped deeper into the Damned Hell Sea.
[Yes. However, we should be careful... There was a rumour that there are terrors guarding the boundary between the Outer Layer and the Inner Layer. From what I know, they are rather terr—]
Before Gaap could end his sentence, a sonic wave boomed below them, and the shockwave threw them back, sending them hurling several km away.
[I believe the rumours are true]
Gaap said, and Kent, who was looking through the Soul Map, frowned.
’I clearly had the Soul Map opened, covering the 80,000km. However, I didn’t sense this beast until after it had reached 40,000km.’
Kent saw a 500-meter-long bone fish appear, with a red aura emitting from its bony body.
"We are in danger, Gaap," Kent said...
[Could be fun.]
"Indeed."
[So run or fight]
"There is nowhere to run, so we fight," Kent said, and Gaap couldn’t agree more. It hummed and released a resentful blood aura, which caused the air around them to tremble.
Kent grabbed it and then looked as the Damned Bone Fish appeared within 500 meters of them.
’It moves 40,000km in less than ten seconds. Now, that is a worthy opponent.’
The Blood Sword Aura coated the sword, causing Gaap to tremble excitedly...
[Now, that is something I could work with]
Kent laughed and then, with a speed powered by 20,000 flame veins, he closed in on the Damned Bone Fish, and a battle between terrors began.

BOOM
A flame exploded in Kent’s face, sending him flying 1,000km away.

"Damn, these bastards are shameless," Kent cursed as he used the Soul Map to teleport 30,000km away, only to deal with an abyssal cannon shark, a rather unusual breed of sharks that are known for firing long-range ballistic flame missiles.
Of course, if it were merely firing it, then Kent wouldn’t have been struck.
However, these Damned Hell beasts have a special ability that teleports their missiles to their target.
So, despite having the Soul Map, Kent was still struck.

Naturally, he has both, showing the kind of monster he is.

chapters.title: Chapter 1026: A Terror Met Its Terror [Bonus]
paragraphs: CLANG
The sound of metal striking another metal spread out as Kent struck the rincage of the Damned Bone Fish...
"This bastard is tough," Kent said as he moved back and unleashed a ’Rapid Slash’, sending 450 sword arcs at the bone fish...

[Bone fishes are naturally hard. So one that has been in the Damned Hell Sea and tempered its body by the hell flames for millions of years, as you can see, is rather tough. I have no doubt its true realm is already at the immortal stage.]
"Just great"
Kent didn’t seem to care, but distanced himself from the Damned Bone Fish, only for three bone spears to arrive before him.
However, he used his sword to block two and dodge the third before teleporting away, allowing the two he blocked to move away.
However, just when he appeared 300 meters away, he saw the Bone Fish restructure its body, shifting from a True Bone Fish to a demi-bone fish.
It grew legs, and what is even more disturbing is the fact that the six arms, now made of bone, were holding spears.
[Oh, one thing I forgot to tell you is that this Bone Fish can change its body structure and take any form it wants. In a way, they can shapeshift.]
"More context next time, Gaap."
Kent didn’t have time to breathe as the bone-headed fish appeared before him with all six spears raised.
It slashed with two hands and stabbed with four, giving Kent a rather complicated combination of attacks. However, he teleported away only for the Damned Bone fish to close in again.
[They can also teleport...just so you know]
"Annoying"
The void opened behind the Damned Bone Fish, and hundreds of sword arcs flashed out, causing it to abandon its attack to block them.
"Oh, you don’t." Kent moved back and brandished his sword. He channeled Blood Sword aura, causing it to glow red.
Then, with a powerful swing, a 30-meter-long sword arc flashed out.

The sea was cut open, and the Damned Bone Fish, whose attention was on the sword arcs, felt a much more dangerous attack come from the annoying human whom it thought it could use as an afternoon snack, maybe an evening dessert.
Now, as it looks, it was rather going to be the snack...
And as a beast with more killing intent than intelligence, it was torn between which attack to defend.
Ignoring the hundreds of tiny ones would be trouble, just as ignoring the bigger sword arcs could also prove deadly.
"Oh, but who said you only have two problems to worry about?" Time seemed to slow down as Kent moved with his 20,000 flame veins powering his speed.
SLASH SLASH SLASH
Three more red sword arcs, not weaker than the second sword arc, flashed out, and the space around them trembled.
[Damn... That is overkill.]
The Damned Bone Fish may be fast, but with 20,000 flame veins and the flame wheel, it couldn’t match the speed of the sword arcs.
BOOM

In the end, all four sword arcs landed, with the smaller arcs getting destroyed by the shockwave. When the dust settled, Kent saw the Damned Bone Fish had lost four arms, probably from using them to shield itself from the four deadly attacks.
But that wasn’t all, its ribcage was caved in, a large chunk of its head was missing, and one leg was broken.
It would probably need a minute to restore itself. However, that was just too long a time for Kent to handle it.

"Annihilation sword strike." He raised his sword up and, with a mighty slash, the sea was parted again, and this time, as the 5th red sword arc appeared, the pitiful terror of the outer layer of the Damned Hell Sea was severed in half.
[Even a Terror has its terror.] Gaap couldn’t help praising Kent for how he efficiently handled the Damned Bone Fish.
True, the bastard was more powerful than any opponent Kent had faced so far. However, that didn’t change the fact that he had also become much stronger.
However, what was even more shocking was the fact that without even using all his flame veins or even a sliver of his bloodline, Kent was able to take down such a powerful foe.
[Your sword aura is strange, much more powerful than a regular sword aura.]
"That is because it is not an ordinary sword aura. Mine is a mutation of Blood Aura and Sword Aura. It is several times stronger than a sword aura."
[I see. In any case, you are much more abnormal compared to the many monsters I met back in the day. However, you will need more than this to handle the dangers waiting for us deep down there.]
Kent looked deep into the Damned Hell Sea and smiled, "That is the plan. For now, we should find a place to absorb our gains.
The only reason I needed less of my flame veins was because of the Blood Essence I absorbed before we began this journey.
If we want to have a smoother ride, then we must become much stronger."
[True. In that case, we should be on our way.]
Kent waved his hand, and the six bone spears flew toward him. After a quick examination, he put them away in his space ring.

The Blood Essence had already been taken by the sword and stored inside his soul universe, where the other thousands of Blood Essences from the massacre he and Gaap had committed these past two months were stored.
They soon left the scene and started heading deeper.
To many, after reaching the Core Formation stage or the Heavenly Ascension stage, their growth stagnates, compelling them to ascend to a much higher world to continue their growth.
However, to Kent, he still had many ways to keep growing without having to ascend.
Of course, if he were to ascend and break through to the Spirit Ascension stage, then it is safe to say his strength would explode, taking him to a completely different level.
Kent’s plan now was to cement his foundation so that when he started advancing rapidly through the next Phase, he wouldn’t have anything to worry about.
After a week, they came to a stop before a mountain with a large cave.
[Looks like this is where that Damned Bone Fish came from,] Gaap said, and Kent couldn’t agree more.
There were tracks of bones scratching the ground, showing that something bony lived there.
Of course, knowing his Soul Map wasn’t capturing the threats as quickly as before, Kent had to move much closer to determine if it was indeed empty. After checking, he let Gaap inside.
Kent suspected that the Soul Map works based on the power of his soul universe. And since his soul universe was only Tier 16, he started to see the limitations.
This could only mean he must ascend quickly, since to break past the Tier 16 soul cultivation stage, he must become a Spirit King first.
Gaap, transformed into his human form, sat in lotus posture and started absorbing the Resentful Blood Essence he had collected.
Kent also moved back, and with a wave of his hand, 407,900 Blood Essences appeared, surrounding him and illuminating his surroundings in a golden hue.
"This should be enough to take me to somewhere between 80–90%," Kent said, watching the golden Blood Essence surrounding him.
He hadn’t yet touched his Blood Core Gate, but he could tell he would need at least this much to successfully form that.
However, before he attempted that, he first wanted to undergo his first blood cleansing, and to do that, he had to fully cultivate the first form of the Primal Body Tempering Art.
"One thing at a time, I guess," he closed his eyes and formed a hand seal, causing the Blood Essences to start moving into his forehead.
His aura started to surge...
