chapters.title: Chapter 1027: Red Sea
paragraphs: [One Year later - Gorathis, the City of Chains]
When Kent arrived in Hell using the Hell Road Gate, 14 pillars lit up in Nex Morbus, painting the sky red.
These 14 pillars are from the 14 cities that Kent must move through to get to the Bone Fortress, where the final boss will be waiting for him.
One of these cities, named Gorathis, the city of chains, will be the first that Kent will have to pass through when he leaves the Damned Hell Sea.
Gorathis is a fortress-like citadel made of black iron. It is intimidating to look at from a distance and even more sinister-looking up close.
Seen from afar, it appears to be hanging by a large chain that extends into the red clouds.
Nobody knew what that huge chain was latched onto.
Some say it is being held by millions of damned souls whose punishment is to forever hold the city in place.

The main city itself is filled with hanging cages, each housing an unfortunate soul. Their screams are like entertainment to the Chainfiends. They are unique and sinister-looking hell demons with hooks for arms.

Currently, inside a black castle that seems haunted, a towering demon with four arms smirked, his skin a pale gray, and his body wrapped in broken shackles, sitting on a metallic, jagged throne, holding a metal cup in one of his four hands.
The cup is filled with Hell Wine, a rather potent wine said to contain the soul of the resentful demons.
Before him, a Chainfiend with three hooked arms knelt, its face down.
"What do you have to report, Kay?" Zorvak, the ruler of the city of chains, asked.

"My lord, some fishermen who went fishing in the Damned Hell Sea came with a report that the Damned Hell Sea has turned red. They claim many dead Damned Hell Beasts floated to the surface, with many more coming out.
They reported that these Damned Hell Beasts, the majority of them, are drained of their blood," Kay reported, and Zorvak nodded.
"So it seems the challenger has entered the Damned Hell Sea."
"Yes, Hell Lord."
"Do we know which side he entered from?"
"No, Hell Lord. However, the eastern part of this sea is where most of the Damned Hell Beasts surfaced."
"Good. This means he will surface there." A smile that didn’t reach his eyes appeared on Zorvak’s face. He drank a sip of the Hell Wine and then looked toward the vast city filled with Chainfiends.
"Issue the order for all hunters to head to the eastern Damned Hell Sea."
"Okay, Hell Lord."
Kay stood up and left.
Zorvak drank a sip of his Hell Wine again and grinned.

"Aside from independent hunters who can move between cities, the rules stated that no hell city can hunt in a different city except its own. This means I have the highest chance of ending this bastard who dares challenge Hell King Bliz."

He drank his Hell Wine again and chuckled, "Thinking you can get to the bottom of the Damned Hell Sea is already suicide, but if you somehow come back alive, then I will be sure to kill you and finally become a direct subordinate to Hell King Bliz."
The allure of finally getting his hands on Kent is already making this bastard lick his lips. He is the 14th Hell Ruler in Nex Morbus (6th level of hell).
This means his influence and strength are already unquestionable. But killing the Hell Road challenger is something he had dreamt of for many years, and finally, he has the chance.
Within a week, thousands of hunters had heard of this new development, causing them all to head toward the Damned Hell Sea.
External hunters who aren’t affiliated with any of the 14 cities also moved toward the Damned Hell Sea. These types of hunters earned their status solely based on their track records.
Of course, some are still feeling too big to come, but when Kent comes out of the Damned Hell Sea, he will have a warm welcome in the form of thousands of hell demons vying for his head.
[9th Level of hell - Layer Between Levels - Nyx’s POV]
After hearing someone had challenged the six levels of Hell, Nyx and her friend Bilad decided to go down to Hell to have a look.
After all, every time there is a challenge, the news spreads to the Underworld and even the Undead World. Those who wish to observe can come to any level of Hell.
The rules will allow them to see what is happening in the level that has been challenged.
They decided to come to the 9th level, which is closest to the 9th level of the Underworld.
Currently, seated atop a bone mountain, one said to have formed from the remains of a great Hell demon, Nyx looked at the thousands of people moving toward the Damned Hell Sea with a calm expression.
Bilad rested his back against a bone, also watching the same thing as Nyx.
"Looks like the challenger entered the Damned Hell Sea," Bilad said. "But why haven’t they surfaced yet? After all, it has already been a year."
Because the 14 pillars are still lit, everybody knows the challenger is still alive. So why haven’t they surfaced yet?
"Do you really think it is that easy to chase after something nobody, aside from Hell King Bliz, was able to reach?" Nyx smirked.
"Are you talking about the Supreme Primordial Flame?" Bilad asked.

"What else? I don’t know who this crazy challenger is, but even Hell King Bliz only lasted five hours there before he had to run. This person clearly has a death wish." Nyx smirked, feeling like she had wasted her time coming to watch this.

"Well, I believe for someone who wanted to challenge an Underworld King, this should be a lesson for you. Who knows, you might learn a thing or two, and hopefully, I won’t die for nothing helping you achieve your dreams."

Nyx turned and looked at her long-term best friend, Bilad, who, despite knowing her lofty aspirations, still stood by her side, making sure that one day, she would become an Underworld Queen like she had dreamt of.
Seeing the smile on his face, Nyx smiled—a rather beautiful smile that only Bilad got to witness.
"Fine. I will wait and watch. But this person must better make sure my trip is worth it."
"What if they fail to meet your expectations?" Bilad asked.
"Then, even though I can’t use my whip here, breaking a few rules and probably getting banned from here will become the outcome for me."
Bilad looked at his friend and laughed.
"Maybe you might just have a chance to become an Underworld Queen one day."
The two laughed.
The reason the Fallen Angel Bliz was able to become a Hell King was that he had ventured into the Damned Hell Sea before.
They said he spent 200 years traversing the damned sea only to reach the bottom and soak his spear in the Damned Hell Flames, said to be a Supreme Primordial Flame.
They said he succeeded, but he lasted only five hours before being forced to run.
However, his spear became a weapon so deadly that nobody dared fight against it.
It was also through him that many began to speculate that perhaps the famous Purgatory—the domain rumored to have once ruled the strongest universe in existence—is located there.

sentences.text: [One Year later - Gorathis, the City of Chains]
When Kent arrived in Hell using the Hell Road Gate, 14 pillars lit up in Nex Morbus, painting the sky red.
These 14 pillars are from the 14 cities that Kent must move through to get to the Bone Fortress, where the final boss will be waiting for him.
One of these cities, named Gorathis, the city of chains, will be the first that Kent will have to pass through when he leaves the Damned Hell Sea.
Gorathis is a fortress-like citadel made of black iron.
It is intimidating to look at from a distance and even more sinister-looking up close.
Seen from afar, it appears to be hanging by a large chain that extends into the red clouds.
Nobody knew what that huge chain was latched onto.
Some say it is being held by millions of damned souls whose punishment is to forever hold the city in place.
The main city itself is filled with hanging cages, each housing an unfortunate soul.
Their screams are like entertainment to the Chainfiends.
They are unique and sinister-looking hell demons with hooks for arms.

Currently, inside a black castle that seems haunted, a towering demon with four arms smirked, his skin a pale gray, and his body wrapped in broken shackles, sitting on a metallic, jagged throne, holding a metal cup in one of his four hands.
The cup is filled with Hell Wine, a rather potent wine said to contain the soul of the resentful demons.
Before him, a Chainfiend with three hooked arms knelt, its face down.
"What do you have to report, Kay?" Zorvak, the ruler of the city of chains, asked.
"My lord, some fishermen who went fishing in the Damned Hell Sea came with a report that the Damned Hell Sea has turned red.
They claim many dead Damned Hell Beasts floated to the surface, with many more coming out.
They reported that these Damned Hell Beasts, the majority of them, are drained of their blood," Kay reported, and Zorvak nodded.
"So it seems the challenger has entered the Damned Hell Sea."
"Yes, Hell Lord."
"Do we know which side he entered from?"
"No, Hell Lord.
However, the eastern part of this sea is where most of the Damned Hell Beasts surfaced."
"Good.
This means he will surface there." A smile that didn’t reach his eyes appeared on Zorvak’s face.
He drank a sip of the Hell Wine and then looked toward the vast city filled with Chainfiends.
"Issue the order for all hunters to head to the eastern Damned Hell Sea."
"Okay, Hell Lord."
Kay stood up and left.
Zorvak drank a sip of his Hell Wine again and grinned.
"Aside from independent hunters who can move between cities, the rules stated that no hell city can hunt in a different city except its own.
This means I have the highest chance of ending this bastard who dares challenge Hell King Bliz."

He drank his Hell Wine again and chuckled, "Thinking you can get to the bottom of the Damned Hell Sea is already suicide, but if you somehow come back alive, then I will be sure to kill you and finally become a direct subordinate to Hell King Bliz."
The allure of finally getting his hands on Kent is already making this bastard lick his lips.
He is the 14th Hell Ruler in Nex Morbus (6th level of hell).
This means his influence and strength are already unquestionable.
But killing the Hell Road challenger is something he had dreamt of for many years, and finally, he has the chance.
Within a week, thousands of hunters had heard of this new development, causing them all to head toward the Damned Hell Sea.
External hunters who aren’t affiliated with any of the 14 cities also moved toward the Damned Hell Sea.
These types of hunters earned their status solely based on their track records.
Of course, some are still feeling too big to come, but when Kent comes out of the Damned Hell Sea, he will have a warm welcome in the form of thousands of hell demons vying for his head.
[9th Level of hell - Layer Between Levels - Nyx’s POV]
After hearing someone had challenged the six levels of Hell, Nyx and her friend Bilad decided to go down to Hell to have a look.
After all, every time there is a challenge, the news spreads to the Underworld and even the Undead World.
Those who wish to observe can come to any level of Hell.
The rules will allow them to see what is happening in the level that has been challenged.
They decided to come to the 9th level, which is closest to the 9th level of the Underworld.
Currently, seated atop a bone mountain, one said to have formed from the remains of a great Hell demon, Nyx looked at the thousands of people moving toward the Damned Hell Sea with a calm expression.
Bilad rested his back against a bone, also watching the same thing as Nyx.
"Looks like the challenger entered the Damned Hell Sea," Bilad said.
"But why haven’t they surfaced yet?
After all, it has already been a year."
Because the 14 pillars are still lit, everybody knows the challenger is still alive.
So why haven’t they surfaced yet?
"Do you really think it is that easy to chase after something nobody, aside from Hell King Bliz, was able to reach?" Nyx smirked.
"Are you talking about the Supreme Primordial Flame?" Bilad asked.
"What else?
I don’t know who this crazy challenger is, but even Hell King Bliz only lasted five hours there before he had to run.
This person clearly has a death wish." Nyx smirked, feeling like she had wasted her time coming to watch this.
"Well, I believe for someone who wanted to challenge an Underworld King, this should be a lesson for you.
Who knows, you might learn a thing or two, and hopefully, I won’t die for nothing helping you achieve your dreams."

Nyx turned and looked at her long-term best friend, Bilad, who, despite knowing her lofty aspirations, still stood by her side, making sure that one day, she would become an Underworld Queen like she had dreamt of.
Seeing the smile on his face, Nyx smiled—a rather beautiful smile that only Bilad got to witness.
"Fine.
I will wait and watch.
But this person must better make sure my trip is worth it."
"What if they fail to meet your expectations?" Bilad asked.
"Then, even though I can’t use my whip here, breaking a few rules and probably getting banned from here will become the outcome for me."
Bilad looked at his friend and laughed.
"Maybe you might just have a chance to become an Underworld Queen one day."
The two laughed.
The reason the Fallen Angel Bliz was able to become a Hell King was that he had ventured into the Damned Hell Sea before.

chapters.title: Chapter 1028: Chaotic Blood Fury
paragraphs: [Two years later - Bone Mountain - Boundary between Outer and Inner Layer - Damned Hell Sea]
It has already been two years since Kent arrived in hell and challenged the sixth level of hell.

Currently, he is seated inside a cave 95,000km deep in the Damned Hell Sea. Around him, faint red runes, thousands of them, emitting the power of blood, hovered, shaking the very mountain he had occupied.
Gaap, the Bloodforge Sovereign, stood 100 meters away, looking at his master with awe in his eyes.
[Blood Fury awakening]
He said, almost salivating.
The runes were indeed Blood Runes meant to awaken Kent’s Blood Fury. This Blood Fury was the second Blood Aspect ability Kent would awaken after he started walking the blood path.

He had already awakened Blood Aura, which had made both his claw aura and sword aura several times stronger. In fact, because of that, he was able to cut through the Damned Bone Fish like it was mere paper.
So it was safe to assume Blood Aspect Abilities were extremely powerful and very dangerous.
Now, Kent was awakening Blood Fury, which suggested he had made significant progress in cultivating the Primal Bone Tempering Art.
However, looking at the thousands of runes surrounding Kent, Gaap couldn’t help feeling like his body was about to explode from sheer excitement.
[The last time I checked, nobody who had ever walked the blood path, including me, had awakened Blood Fury with more than a thousand blood runes.
However, this little Blood Reaper is actually awakening his with 10,026 blood runes. Where is the logic in this?]
Gaap could only smile, watching as the blood runes circled around Kent for a few minutes before they started to move and enter his forehead.
[Run Gaap]
Gaap said to himself, transformed into a sword, and shot out of the cave right before the mountain exploded.

Chaotic blood energy suddenly burst out of Kent’s body, spreading several kilometers in under a second. Gaap, who ran out, teleported 100km away, but he was even forced to keep moving back as more blood runes kept entering Kent’s body.
[This is too much for someone like him. Just too much]
Gaap, who stood 3,000km away now, said, his expression beaming with pride as he stared at his master far in the distance.
[I made the right decision by becoming his sword]
As the seconds passed, and more blood runes continued to enter Kent’s forehead, the chaotic blood aura kept rising to the point that Gaap became vigilant.
At the moment, Kent was both a danger and a calling beacon, telling the beasts around, if there were any, to come to him. Naturally, that would be very bad for Kent.
However, Gaap was prepared for this, and thanks to refining the Resentful Blood Essences he collected, he had become much stronger.
Thankfully, even after a week, no beast came. By then, he was forced to move 10,000km away.
However, after another week, Kent opened his eyes.
His purple eyes were nowhere to be seen. Instead, in their place, a red furious gaze opened, tiny runes moving across them.
Kent clenched his fist, feeling the power gathered in it.
"So much power," he muttered before he threw a casual punch in a certain direction.
BOOM
A sonic boom erupted where he punched, creating a 1,000km-long crater.
"Damn... This is just too much," Kent smiled.
Even without the tower message, he could tell his strength had reached a whole different level. However, he decided to check out the message just to confirm.
⟪You have unlocked a new Blood Aspect Ability: Chaotic Blood Fury⟫
⟪Name: Chaotic Blood Fury⟫
⟪Aspect Rank: EX⟫
⟪Description: A special blood ability that supercharges your blood runes and grants you double their power. Each blood rune increases your strength by 120%⟫
⟪Note: You can only use 1,200 blood runes at the moment. To add more, you must continue cultivating the Primal Bone Tempering Art⟫
"Well, that just took a dark turn." Kent grinned and looked at the current blood runes he was using.
He had automatically activated the Chaotic Blood Fury, so he wanted to check the number of Blood Runes currently active.
"Just 300 and already this is terrifying." Kent didn’t even have to think about it to know this power was beyond him. The current him had no business awakening such terrifying power.
However, it didn’t end there.
"The fact that I still have more blood runes to awaken is already too much for me to even think about. This is just too much."
Kent stood up and flexed his muscles.

"So I now have the Blood Life Seal for health, the Blood Death Seal for Killing Intent, the Flame Veins for speed and flame resistance, and now, Blood Runes for strength." The grin on his face widened as his dragon horns appeared.
In an instant, the air around him started to warp.
Kent knew his strength was suppressed in his human form. However, in his demi-dragon form, he was on a completely different level in terms of strength.
And now that he had awakened Blood Fury, allowing him to harness the power of blood runes, he couldn’t help but wonder just what had become of him.
"At this point, who can stop me in a High World? In terms of speed, with my 35,000 Flame Veins, dragon wings, and Flame Wheel combined, even the fastest Roc will look slow in my eyes.
Then with my strength..." Kent laughed...
[Oh mine] Gaap teleported to Kent’s side, examining him from head to toe.
[Oh mine. This is just too enticing.] Gaap’s body trembled, feeling the chaotic yet bloodthirsty feeling coming from Kent.
"What do you think?" Kent asked, and Gaap smiled.
[If before I had doubts that we can’t make it to the bottom, then this time, I think the Damned Hell Sea is not ready for us.]
Gaap trembled excitedly as he transformed into his sword form.
[Although nowhere near Blood Runes, I am close to forming a Resentful Seal. But even without it, thanks to the many Resentful Blood Essences I have refined, my strength has skyrocketed.
Combining my strength with yours, I believe we are now the overlords of this damned sea.]
Kent only smiled, knowing Gaap had made this assumption just from feeling 300 Blood Runes at work.
If he were to find out he still had 900 Blood Runes dormant and over 8,000 still inaccessible, he would probably unseal himself and allow Kent to use him at his True Immortal Stage.

However, that would have been chaotic, as their opponents would also have had their cultivation bases released, or at least, the law that made them face the Heavenly Ascension Stage Hell Demons would have stopped working.
’Just as I predicted, the Primal Bone Tempering Art has reached 80% completion, but I can now use 17% of my bloodline, so that is to say I have indeed become the Overlord of the Damned Sea.’
"Gaap, let’s go. I want to see who dares block our path."
[I like the sound of that]
Kent jumped on the sword, and then, with a speed several times faster than before, they shot toward the Inner Layer.
Kent knew his next move was to form the Flame Core, so he unleashed 5% of his bloodline and 300 Blood Runes while maintaining his demi-dragon form as they moved.
This way, he was announcing that unless you had a death wish, come close to him.
In no time, they entered the Inner Layer and headed to the Core Layer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1029: Blood Reaper [Bonus]
paragraphs: [2.3 years after Kent entered Hell and dived into the Damned Hell Sea]
The rule of the jungle that says, ’the strong take all,’ is perhaps an undisputed rule.
This rule is not merely words spoken to instill fear in the weak and lower class.
It is a rule that governs the kingdoms of beasts, demons, and even humans.
In fact, if one takes the universe into perspective, no world would want its leader to be extremely weak. They would want their leader to be able to stand firm and face danger head-on without fear.
They would want their leader to lead them to victory and back.
They would want their leader to be a symbol that many would look up to. The authority that cannot be disobeyed. The pillar that cannot be broken easily.
Of course, low-level worlds with no cultivation can have weaker leaders. But even in such weaker worlds, a pack of wolves has the Alpha.
In a way, this rule is universal, and even deep in the unforgiving trenches of Hell, this rule is taken to heart.
This is why, for three months, a threat none of the Damned Hell beasts saw coming arrived, and none was able to resist him.
Kent spent two years reaching the borders of the Inner Layer simply because he was training to bolster his strength. He took it slowly and steadily... ever cautious.
However, not anymore...

The past three months have been him speeding toward the depths of the Damned Hell Sea. Initially, when he had just entered the Inner Layer, none of the Damned Hell beasts tried to challenge his authority.
They may be strong and deadly, but not stupid enough to throw their lives away. In fact, the feeling of helplessness was what they all felt when Kent was passing through.
However, as he moved deeper, some started blocking him.
Kent, of course, welcomed them. After all, he was after both blood and reaching the depths of the Damned Hell Sea.
So when they attacked, he retaliated in kind.
The least he used was a swing of his sword, and that would be all.
Whenever a beast dies, its blood is drained, leaving only its bony skeleton behind.
As he headed deeper, more beasts started coming at him. However, as more continued to die, their blood sucked dry, the legend of the Blood Reaper was born and started to spread.
Kent discovered that while in the Outer Layer, he was mindlessly attacked. As he headed deeper into the Inner Layer, the Damned Hell beasts weren’t as crazy and hungry to throw their lives away.
In fact, the Damned Hell Beasts he was encountering now were much more intelligent.

But even so, some continued to come at him, allowing him to spread his name as the Blood Reaper. In a span of three months, his name had reached far and wide, allowing him to move like a Tyrant through the Inner Layer.
[Three more months later (2.6 years after he entered hell)]
[We are nearing the Core Layer,] Gaap said.
Kent, who was standing on it, nodded. "So far, I am convinced the danger level would be less, considering I have already carved my name through the Inner Layer."
Kent smiled.
[That is only to be expected. After all, after 120,000 battles, we emerged victorious, earning you a tyrannical name that I am sure will spread to the outside once we come out.]
"Indeed. This time, I think we have earned more than we bargained for."

[More than we could, hehe... The quality of the resentful blood essence is better than in the Outer Layer. I think I will be able to form the Resentful Blood Seal this time around and even have more to use on other things.]
"Same here. This time around, I will fully cultivate the first form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art."
During the time they spent making a name for themselves through the Inner Layer, Kent and Gaap bonded over their shared love for blood.
It was through this blood bond that Gaap learned Kent was a True Primordial and the reincarnation of the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
Learning these two things about him raised Kent’s image in his heart by several degrees.
[I still can’t believe you are the Primordial Chaos Dragon,] Gaap said, knowing it would take some time to get used to this discovery.
Kent smiled and then turned to his left.
"We have a visitor," Kent said, coming to a halt.
Right then, a green shark appeared before him, its large mouth lined with razor-sharp teeth, opened wide in an attempt to swallow the tiny demi-dragon whole.
However, before it could salivate, Kent swung his clawed hand, manifesting four large claw arcs. They moved with so much primal blood energy, cleaving through its body.
It was severed into four different halves.
Without even wasting much time, Gaap drained the blood, and they were on their way.
That is how easy it had become for Kent to kill the Damned Hell beasts now.
A week later, they entered the Core Layer, where, from the moment they entered, Kent could feel his soul flame start to react excitedly with the flame around him.
Though the Nirvana Flames cannot be used, he still has his Chaos Soul Flame to rely on. Additionally, he began to feel that his flame resistance would soon break through to the Transcendent Stage.
Naturally, he welcomed these changes.
However, something started to bug him.
Despite the Damned Hell Sea being a Primordial flame, his perfect flame immunity allowed him to resist the heat through to the Core Layer.
That wasn’t something he saw happening. However, now that he is in the Core Layer and could still move freely, he saw that perhaps his flame resistance is much stronger than others.
’Maybe it’s because of the flame veins and my body cultivation.’
[Several guests are headed our way,] Gaap said, looking at the dozens of beasts coming through the Soul Map. Kent had shared it with him so he could see everything.
’I was able to see them only when I reached 20,000 km. It seems that the deeper I went, the more flawed the Soul Map became.’
Kent sighed as he came to a halt and this time took the sword...
’Thankfully, it is still powerful enough to sense them at least.’
Twenty-four beasts lunged at Kent, who smiled and raised the sword...
"Endless Sword Arcs Domain."
HUMMMMMM
The sword hummed, and thousands of sword arcs formed from Blood Sword Arc and powered by the Blood Death Seal surged out, sounding like bees...
The beasts that were closer to Kent were shredded, and those far away were reduced to a near-death state. Naturally, with a wave of his hand, swords surged out, killing them in an instant.
[You’ve never used this sword technique before,] Gaap said, absorbing the blood from their kill.
"That’s because I want to make a statement, and using a sword technique from Lord Genesis is perfect for that."
[So we are being watched.]

"Indeed. I believe we will face more of these guys before meeting the true mastermind," Kent smirked. Although he couldn’t see the being watching them through his Soul Map, his Heavenly Jade Eyes could tell he was being watched.
However, he didn’t care because he knew no matter what, the being would never be stronger than him.
[I guess, as you say, it is time for us to farm more blood.]
"I guess so. But since I earned the name Blood Reaper, we can change the phrase to ’Time to reap more blood.’"
[That works fine with me.]
Kent arrived in the Core Layer, and with him, blood followed.

"So far, I am convinced the danger level would be less, considering I have already carved my name through the Inner Layer."
Kent smiled.
[That is only to be expected.
After all, after 120,000 battles, we emerged victorious, earning you a tyrannical name that I am sure will spread to the outside once we come out.]
"Indeed.
This time, I think we have earned more than we bargained for."
[More than we could, hehe...
The quality of the resentful blood essence is better than in the Outer Layer.
I think I will be able to form the Resentful Blood Seal this time around and even have more to use on other things.]
"Same here.
This time around, I will fully cultivate the first form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art."
During the time they spent making a name for themselves through the Inner Layer, Kent and Gaap bonded over their shared love for blood.
It was through this blood bond that Gaap learned Kent was a True Primordial and the reincarnation of the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
Learning these two things about him raised Kent’s image in his heart by several degrees.
[I still can’t believe you are the Primordial Chaos Dragon,] Gaap said, knowing it would take some time to get used to this discovery.
Kent smiled and then turned to his left.
"We have a visitor," Kent said, coming to a halt.
Right then, a green shark appeared before him, its large mouth lined with razor-sharp teeth, opened wide in an attempt to swallow the tiny demi-dragon whole.
However, before it could salivate, Kent swung his clawed hand, manifesting four large claw arcs.
They moved with so much primal blood energy, cleaving through its body.
It was severed into four different halves.
Without even wasting much time, Gaap drained the blood, and they were on their way.
That is how easy it had become for Kent to kill the Damned Hell beasts now.
A week later, they entered the Core Layer, where, from the moment they entered, Kent could feel his soul flame start to react excitedly with the flame around him.
Though the Nirvana Flames cannot be used, he still has his Chaos Soul Flame to rely on.
Additionally, he began to feel that his flame resistance would soon break through to the Transcendent Stage.
Naturally, he welcomed these changes.
However, something started to bug him.
Despite the Damned Hell Sea being a Primordial flame, his perfect flame immunity allowed him to resist the heat through to the Core Layer.
That wasn’t something he saw happening.
However, now that he is in the Core Layer and could still move freely, he saw that perhaps his flame resistance is much stronger than others.
’Maybe it’s because of the flame veins and my body cultivation.’
[Several guests are headed our way,] Gaap said, looking at the dozens of beasts coming through the Soul Map.
Kent had shared it with him so he could see everything.
’I was able to see them only when I reached 20,000 km.
It seems that the deeper I went, the more flawed the Soul Map became.’
Kent sighed as he came to a halt and this time took the sword...
’Thankfully, it is still powerful enough to sense them at least.’
Twenty-four beasts lunged at Kent, who smiled and raised the sword...
"Endless Sword Arcs Domain."
HUMMMMMM
The sword hummed, and thousands of sword arcs formed from Blood Sword Arc and powered by the Blood Death Seal surged out, sounding like bees...
The beasts that were closer to Kent were shredded, and those far away were reduced to a near-death state.
Naturally, with a wave of his hand, swords surged out, killing them in an instant.
[You’ve never used this sword technique before,] Gaap said, absorbing the blood from their kill.
"That’s because I want to make a statement, and using a sword technique from Lord Genesis is perfect for that."
[So we are being watched.]
"Indeed.
I believe we will face more of these guys before meeting the true mastermind," Kent smirked.
Although he couldn’t see the being watching them through his Soul Map, his Heavenly Jade Eyes could tell he was being watched.
However, he didn’t care because he knew no matter what, the being would never be stronger than him.
[I guess, as you say, it is time for us to farm more blood.]
"I guess so.
But since I earned the name Blood Reaper, we can change the phrase to ’Time to reap more blood.’"
[That works fine with me.]
Kent arrived in the Core Layer, and with him, blood followed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1030: Abyss Dragon [Bonus]
paragraphs: SLASH SLASH SLASH
[Maybe we should run much deeper into the sea]

Gaap said as he sliced through the centipede damned sea beast. It wasn’t that he was afraid, causing him to make that statement; it was more a matter of preserving their strength for a more formidable foe.
At the moment, if one were standing several kilometers away, they would see a swarm of damned sea beasts converging on a small human who wielded a red sword, his body surrounded by a red aura.
That person is Kent, who is being ganged upon by thousands of beasts.
"Are you concerned about my energy running low?" Kent asked as he sliced through another beast, his left hand moving at great speed, as a dagger he held sliced through another beast.
He is dual-wielding, using a sword and a dagger.
The ten flying swords also moved, and hundreds of beasts fell.
Through the thousands of beasts he had killed using the ten flying soul swords, he managed to learn how to coat the swords with the ’Blood Sword Aura.’
For now, he is using them at their maximum strength. Thankfully, they deal both physical and soul damage, so they are killing much more efficiently than ever.
However, the swarm of sea monsters is just too much.
[Since we are being watched but we cannot detect them, then naturally, it means they are much more powerful. So it is better to run and face them at full strength than to waste it on their lackeys.]
"Oh, Gaap, you still don’t understand, do you?" Kent smiled and said, "This isn’t my full strength, Gaap. This isn’t even 25% of my strength."

As if to prove that, Kent activated 25,000 flame veins, and with them, he unleashed his movement technique, ’Flame Wheels.’ But he didn’t stop there; he increased his bloodline usage to 10% and Blood Runes to 700.
BOOM
His strength and speed exploded, and with it, the swarm of beasts was suppressed, some devoid of the will to move while the stronger ones became sluggish.
This effect covered over 5 km, causing everything to come to a standstill.
[Damn...]

"Time to reap some blood." Kent smiled, and then the void cracked in more than 30 places. From within, thousands of sword arcs, each a deadly strike, poured out like bees, and the already red sea became even more crimson.
[How much are you still holding back?]
Gaap became curious.
"Maybe about 30%... still not sure."
[Well, I say whatever you want at the bottom of this damn sea, once you get it, then nobody—and I say this with confidence—but nobody in a High World will be able to challenge you.]
Kent laughed, feeling his ego swell as Gaap praised him.
"Then you have to know that if I manage to get at least 1 million blood essence now, not only would I become undisputed, but the entire High Worlds won’t be able to contain me."
[Why don’t we make that a reality?]
"Do you have a plan?" Kent wasn’t teleporting this time.
He was merely moving, but the speed at which he was going was several times faster than any of the beasts trapped under his bloodline suppression could move.
[I can set up a 50,000 km-wide formation that will trap any beast that dares to enter. But I will need five minutes. However, I promise it will be worth it.]
"Go ahead. I am all about the blood essence, and this seems like a good serving."
The sword shot away from Kent’s grip and started zipping through the air, drawing runes for the formation.

Meanwhile, Kent’s claws dripped red as he started gutting the damned beasts. He is good in close combat, and as someone who is a dragon that specializes in brute combat, his claws are digging through the beasts as if there were no tomorrow.

’With the Primal Bone Tempering Art, my strength is now much more monstrous. But to think that I can only use 1,200 blood runes; otherwise, I risk my body disintegrating. I believe I am still not ready for the Claw Art.’
Right now, aside from using his claws to actively kill or unleash claw arcs using Blood Claw Aura, he doesn’t have any other technique.
However, if he were to learn the Claw Art, then perhaps, by the time he can fully activate all Blood Runes, immortals and gods will beg him not to kill them.

Five minutes later, a formation materialized, preventing any of the beasts trapped from escaping. Of course, the feisty ones are thriving, but being under Kent’s suppression, they could only use less than 30% of their strength.
Six days later, the number of Damned Hell Beasts dropped considerably.
It became clear to most Damned Hell Beasts three days ago that entering the 50,000 km radius was a death sentence, so they backed away.
Those who didn’t listen perished, and now, as Kent was left with fewer than 500 Damned Hell Beasts to kill, one could only wonder whether his skin was white or red.
He is bathed in blood from head to toe, and looking at the bloodthirsty aura emitting from his body, it is clear he is now more dangerous than before...
"Got you."
Suddenly, Kent’s red eyes turned toward the depths of the Damned Hell Sea, and a crazy smile appeared.
"Let’s go."
His dragon wings appeared, and all 35,000 flame veins activated, causing his speed to explode...
BOOM
At once, he vanished, a sonic boom echoing in his trail. He had abandoned the rest of the beasts and chased after the big fish.
[Damn. This speed. I could only move this fast if I were to raise my strength to the Empyrean stage.]
In no time, Kent traveled thousands of miles deep and closed in on the target.

As he drew near, a large flame ball came from the depths of the Damned Hell Sea. However, instead of dodging, Kent spun and then, using his wings as blades, cleaved through it and appeared on the other side in an instant.
BOOM
The flame ball exploded behind him, sending out shockwaves. Naturally, Kent took advantage of the shockwave, propelling himself forward with even more speed.
BOOM
However, just when his speed multiplied thanks to the shockwave, a dragon tail appeared and slammed into Kent, who was moving at great speed.

The entire surrounding exploded, creating a mushroom cloud that covered everything. In fact, the shockwave from the impact went as far as to hit the shores of the outer layer, meaning it went through the inner layer of the Damned Hell Sea.
One could only wonder how much strength was put into the attack and whether anyone could survive it.
However, the answer came when the dust settled.
Kent, a tiny demi-dragon, hovered in the air, his shirt blasted off his body. His skin, covered in golden red dragon scales, shone under the dim light.
His expression was calm, and using one hand, he blocked the tail of a dragon. One would expect the dragon to move its tail away after its attack failed to kill Kent.
Instead, it remained stuck, and upon examining the aura surrounding Kent, it was clear that he had raised his bloodline to the maximum (17%) and Blood Runes to the maximum (1200).
"So this is the depth of the Damned Hell Sea," Kent said, a smug expression plastered on his face as he looked at a dragon temple 30 km away.
He turned and looked at the dragon that had attacked.
He had completely suppressed it with his bloodline.
"Abyss Dragon," he smiled sinisterly, "Perfect for another Blood Death Seal."

chapters.title: Chapter 1031: Depth Of The Damned Hell Sea
paragraphs: The Abyss Dragon, one of the Overlords of the Damned Hell Sea, was brought to its knees with a mere flick of Kent’s hand.
Kent, who is now using 17% of his 20% awakened bloodline, has completely suppressed the terrifying dragon, giving it not even a chance to move.
⟪Your flame resistance has improved tremendously⟫
⟪Your comprehension of the flame has improved tremendously⟫
⟪Your Soul Flame grows stronger⟫
Three messages appeared before Kent’s vision, making him super happy.
He looked at the dragon, whose entire body was radiating death energy, and the smile on his face grew...
[I have underestimated you. You are not a monster... You are the Overlord of Monsters.]
Gaap, the ever-ready hypeman, hyped Kent, causing the Primordial Chaos Dragon to raise his shoulders. The feeling of pride, strength, and ruthlessness overwhelmed his senses.
"What is your name?" Kent asked, looking down at the pitiful Abyss Dragon, a race of dragons said to originate from the Origin Law of Death.
The Abyss Dragon lineage can be traced back to the Primordial Era. They are said to be creatures with the power to manipulate the energy of death.
They are not undead, but they also cannot be classified as living beasts.
Kent had heard of them. After all, the Divine Angelic Titan Race, the same race Kaizo came from, were once allies in their bid to end the reign of the Abyssal Leviathans.
Back when Chaos met that Abyssal Leviathan, he learned something about the Abyss Dragons, so meeting one in person is not just an honor but a chance to grow even stronger.
The Abyss Dragon looked at Kent for a few minutes, deciding whether or not to talk. After all, in actuality, he was an Immortal King, someone one stage stronger than even Gaap.
If this were normal times, he would have obliterated Kent with that tail attack. However, because there were Hell Laws binding him, the small bug now looking down on him had suppressed him.
In the end, he had to give in to Kent’s bloodline power.
"I am Avotha Draconok Siliconik."
[You wouldn’t happen to be from the Siliconik Abyss Family, would you?] Gaap transformed into his demon form and asked.
Seeing Avotha look at him strangely, Gaap smiled and looked at Kent...
[We can’t kill him,] Gaap said.
"Why?" Kent asked. With a few Blood Essences, he could refine the bastard into another Blood Death Seal, which would raise his killing intent up by several levels.
So he planned on killing him. However, hearing Gaap’s words, Kent became puzzled.

[He is from the Siliconik Abyss Dragon Family, a rather powerful Dragon Family in the Universe. They have a whole galaxy to their name. If I have to guess, this bastard is a direct descendant of the main family.]
Gaap pointed at the neck of the Abyss Dragon, whose body was already 700 meters long.
[Do you see that golden reverse scale? It is a sign that he has already undergone three dragon tribulations and has shed three scales already.]
Kent looked at Gaap with a lost expression. "Bruh, I am a dragon, but I don’t know the first thing about dragons. Better enlighten me."
Gaap burst out into resounding laughter, causing Kent to bend his head and blush in embarrassment.

He had yet to really get into learning more about himself from Chaos’s POV. So for now, aside from summoning his wings for flight, claws to kill, and scales for protection, he was next to clueless about dragons.
[I don’t blame you. After all, you are still not even 30 years old and have only been a dragon for what... three years.]
"Give or take."
[I understand. It is not your fault.]
Avotha, who heard this, looked more closely at Kent, and for a moment, he felt like exploding his core. However, he couldn’t. Kent’s suppression also prevented him from harming himself.
However, learning that the person who suppressed him isn’t even 30 years old, he felt both angry and humiliated.
He had been around for over 120,000 years already, yet a mere bug who isn’t even considered an infant simply because he is too young had brought him to his knees.
Gaap read Avotha’s expression and smirked. [Don’t sweat it, buddy. Some people are just built differently.]
Gaap turned back to Kent to explain things to him.
[The reason why the Beast Race is considered the strongest race in the Universe is because of their dangerous yet rewarding evolution path.
When a beast reaches the Immortal level, they undergoes something called Beast Tribulation. The dragons call it Dragon Tribulation.

It is a procedure where, if one emerges victorious, their scales will be tempered and strengthened. Some say every dragon tribulation strengthens the body, soul, and bloodline, giving not less than a 4,000% boost to the dragon.
The next tribulation multiplies the previous by three.
Whenever they undergo this tribulation, their reverse scales change color. The first tribulation gives Bronze, the second gives Silver, and the third gives Gold.
This bastard has a gold reverse scale, meaning he has undergone three tribulations and survived.]
Gaap sighed and smiled before continuing.
[To be honest with you, if you had entered the Hell Road Gate from an Immortal World, you would have died from that one’s attack.
The reason you survived is that the laws prevent the use of his strength after the three tribulations.
However, that isn’t why you shouldn’t kill him.
The main reason is who his father might be.

I don’t know what he is doing here in Hell, but I know even the Hell Monarch—and yes, aside from the 14 Hell Kings, there is a boss called the Hell Monarch—even he wouldn’t dare kill an offspring of the Silconik Abyss Dragon Family.]
"Sounds serious," Kent said, a smile on his face.
[Very serious. However, we also cannot let him off so easily.]
"I know."
Kent thought for a moment.
’If I refine him, I will become much stronger; however, that will make me an enemy of whoever might be backing him.
However, if I let him go, he will also become my enemy in the future. I cannot allow that to happen, not when I have many people linked to me.’
He gazed at the dragon, which was also looking at him as if daring him to kill it and see what happens.
However, Kent smiled as a wicked idea came to mind...
"I would have loved to refine you into a precious Death Seal. However, now knowing about your background, I can’t kill you.
However, I need you as my ride as I dominate the Hell Road. And second, I also want you to become my ally in the future.
I wouldn’t force you, but know that if you accept my offer, I will give you a Supreme Technique precious to all those who cultivate death energy," Kent smiled.
"I believe you’ve heard of the technique called Genesis of Death."

Avotha’s expression changed when Kent said that. The name rang a bell louder than anyone would expect. After all, he came to Hell, traversed the dangerous depths of the Damned Hell Sea, chasing after clues for that technique.
So this half-dragon couldn’t possibly have it... right?
"You are lying," Avotha said, narrowing his eyes at Kent.
"Bitch, please... The Abyssal Leviathans were my friends... the creators of the Genesis of Death technique."

However, now knowing about your background, I can’t kill you.
However, I need you as my ride as I dominate the Hell Road.
And second, I also want you to become my ally in the future.
I wouldn’t force you, but know that if you accept my offer, I will give you a Supreme Technique precious to all those who cultivate death energy," Kent smiled.
"I believe you’ve heard of the technique called Genesis of Death."
Avotha’s expression changed when Kent said that.
The name rang a bell louder than anyone would expect.
After all, he came to Hell, traversed the dangerous depths of the Damned Hell Sea, chasing after clues for that technique.
So this half-dragon couldn’t possibly have it... right?
"You are lying," Avotha said, narrowing his eyes at Kent.
"Bitch, please...
The Abyssal Leviathans were my friends... the creators of the Genesis of Death technique."

chapters.title: Chapter 1032: Flame Core Formation (1)
paragraphs: "I will not fall for your schemes, so if you want me dead, go ahead and kill me, and let’s see whether you and those close to you can survive the aftermath," Avotha said, unsure if Kent was indeed lying to him or not.
"Okay, I have decided," Kent said, "I will be killing you."
Avotha’s body shuddered when he heard these words. However, before he could say anything, Gaap stepped in.
[Let’s not go that far just yet.] Gaap knew Kent was serious about wanting to kill Avotha. However, doing so would indeed be detrimental to Kent.
He may be strong, but even he, alone or with the connections he has now, cannot gather enough to go against the Siliconik Abyss Dragon Family.
He will lose, and Gaap, who knew how dangerous they are, wanted to prevent that.
Gaap looked at Avotha, who he knew didn’t want to die... or at least wasn’t ready to die. If he were ready, he would have already done more than enough to anger Kent so he could kill him easily.
[Have you ever heard of the Bloodforge Sovereign?] Gaap asked, and Avotha nodded.
[Then would you believe me if I were to tell you I am the Bloodforge Sovereign?]
Avotha looked at Gaap for a good minute, but maybe because he was in denial, he couldn’t bring himself to think the demon before him was actually the infamous Blood Sword that once shook hell.
Gaap laughed...

[I am the Bloodforge Sovereign, and since you’ve heard of me, then you might already know I fought with a general of your race before. You would also know it ended him, losing an ear, while my name spread like wildfire.
So tell me, if someone who has cut off the ear of a god while only at the True Immortal stage could bow to a mere mortal, what makes you think he doesn’t have what he says he has?
Maybe he is lying, or maybe he is not. However, know this: killing you will be the easiest thing for him.
So maybe take a leap of faith and you might be surprised.]
Gaap left the rest to Avotha, who, after so many thoughts, decided to take the offer and become Kent’s ride.
Kent formed a hand seal and created a contract.
Although he was reluctant, Avotha accepted the contract. However, when it was formed and he sensed the content, his expression changed...
"What?" Kent smirked, "You thought I was going to enslave you?"

Of course, Avotha thought that. However, to his surprise, it was a contract of Mutual Respect. This means Kent cannot force him or command him against his will, and in return, he cannot go against Kent.
In a way, they are now equals, something that, if Avotha comes to learn of Kent’s true identity, he will be shocked by.
After signing the contract, Kent deactivated his dragon form, returning to his human form.
"Tell me about this place."
Avotha, now free, also transformed into his draconic form, taking the look of a handsome dragon with long dark hair and black dragon horns.
He had the mark of death on his forehead, showing the Origin Law of Death had recognized him.
"I have only been here for 1,200 years... a very short time to know much." Avotha started to speak, but he was forced to stop when Kent gave him the ’bruh’ look.
"You called 1,200 years a very short time... Bro, do you know how many would kill to live 1,200 years where I am from?"
Kent was referring to Earth, where the oldest dies before 100. However, this bastard had the audacity to call 1,200 years a very short time.
[He is less than 30, so he thinks 1,200 is a long time.]
Avotha gave Gaap the ’I know bruh... kids’ look before continuing with what he was saying.
"So, within those 1,200 years, I know the core layer of the Damned Hell Sea is ruled by seven overlords. I killed the overlord here and took his place.
All seven of us are merely either looking for treasures, since there are a lot of treasures here, or cultivating the Supreme Grade Hell Flame, whose core can be found inside that building."
Avotha pointed at the Dragon Mansion not far from where they were.
"I see. I am here for the flame... so I will work on that first." Kent turned to Gaap. "But you can explore this place if you want."
[Naa. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity... I will never have a chance to be this close to a Supreme Grade Primordial Flame ever again, so I will cultivate beside it.]
"Okay." Kent then turned to Avotha. "What about you?"
"I don’t have much use for it since I have already completed my cultivation. Now, I am looking for treasures, so I will focus on that."
Kent nodded. He walked toward him and pressed his finger against Avotha’s forehead and transmitted the first form of the Genesis of Death to him, causing the bastard to widen his eyes in shock.

"I will give you the first form now, and the second form when I am done with my time here." Kent smiled weakly. "Of course, the 3rd to 7th I don’t have, but in the future, I will have them ready for when we meet."
With Avotha frozen in sheer shock, Kent started moving toward the Dragon Mansion.
"Oh, you cannot share it with anyone unless I give you my permission."
Kent laughed, and then he teleported, leaving Avotha to stare at his back as he entered the building...
He then turned toward Gaap. "So he was telling the truth."

[Big time. I have only known him for less than three years, but he has proven to me how capable he is. I would have been disappointed if the son of the Death Priestess Angelica turned down such an offer.]
"You know my mother?" Avotha was shocked again when Gaap mentioned his mom’s name. Gaap laughed...
[Of course, I know her. After all, she was my master several millions of years ago... long before your bastard father cast her to hell to forever be locked in this damned place.]
Avotha’s body shuddered.
"So you knew?"
[I do. You are no heir of the Siliconiks... You are an outcast they didn’t know existed.]
"If you know this... why did you prevent him from killing me? From the way he sounded, my death would have benefited him more than keeping me alive." Avotha’s shock seemed to be multiplying.
[I know. However, I couldn’t bring myself to see a son of my former master die just like that. You deserve better, just as your mother should have.
So I saved you, and I hope in the future, you will pay back this kindness severalfold.]
Avotha went down on his knees and made a pledge... "I promise on my lifeblood that this kindness, I, Avotha De Angelica, will pay back in full, even if it will cost me my life."
Kent, who had just arrived at the core of the Supreme Grade Primordial Flame, smirked. ’So that was the reason, huh... No wonder my Heavenly Jade Eyes couldn’t see this.’

Another question then appeared in his mind, which quickly turned into a theory... ’If I entered a realm from the Divine Era, the 3rd Era, then how come I am in the present Era, and even more importantly, who would be crazy enough to pull a sword from the future to the past just so we could meet?’
A certain white-haired paragon’s image appeared in his mind, causing Kent to chuckle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1033: Flame Core Formation (2) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So pure"

Kent appeared in a large room filled with an overwhelming amount of pure flame energy. There was something akin to a water pool at the center; however, as he looked at it, he could see it was actually a pool of fire.
"So pure," Kent said again as he walked toward the pool.
However, after just three steps, a message appeared in his vision.
⟪Your Flame Resistance has reached the next stage: Perfect ↠ Transcendent⟫
⟪Your Flame Comprehension has reached the next stage: Perfect ↠ Transcendent⟫
⟪Your Chaos Soul Flame has upgraded: Tier 12 ↠ Tier 13⟫
Kent’s happiness was so much that he wished he could stay here forever.
The feeling he was getting from this place was unlike anything he had ever felt before. It was like there was an infinite amount of flame essence here for him to absorb.

"This is wonderful. I will form my core and form more flame veins here before I go back up." Kent started walking forward again. "With the strength I have amassed, I need less than a year to kill that fallen angel."
He had indeed become very powerful.
After walking forward for a few minutes, he arrived in front of the pool but didn’t step in. Instead, he dipped his hand in, and thankfully, he wasn’t burned.
However, he also felt like he could step in, so he stepped in, and right at that moment, he felt so much flame essence wash through his flame veins, activating all 35,000.
"Oh, it is happening." Kent walked forward and sat down. Then he retrieved a Soul Flame Fruit and swallowed it.
Then he waved his hand, and over 400,000 flame cores appeared, hovering in the air. He formed a hand seal and started absorbing the cores.
Kent wasn’t absorbing these cores for the flame essence. No, he was merely absorbing the flame aspects imbued in each of these cores.

With the amount of energy surrounding him, he could form his flame core using the primordial flame essence alone. However, Kent wanted versatility. He wanted to gain the ability to wield many flame aspects, so he gathered the cores for that.
The Soul Flame Fruit was merely to purify his core and give it some spiritual qualities.
So the process began, and it promised to be a long and rewarding one.
An hour later, Gaap also arrived, and when he saw Kent sitting at the center of the pool, he froze, but then a smile appeared on his face.
[What a monster]
He walked toward the pool and stepped in. However, unlike Kent, he was only able to move four steps before he was unable to move any further.
So he sat down and started cultivating too.
Meanwhile, on the outside, Avotha sat, his eyes closed as he worked on understanding the concept behind cultivating the Genesis of Death.
This technique was something Chaos wanted to choose at first, but the Abyssal Leviathan slapped his hand away and gave him the Primal Bone Tempering Art instead.
However, the two techniques were, in a way, similar.
The first form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art involves tempering the bones and body. Once that is done, the second step will be refining the bones using blood runes.

In the aspect of the Genesis of Death, Avotha will first have to temper his body using the energy of death. Once he manages to do that, he will start forming the seals of death, which are in the form of tattoos.
The more tattoos, the more dangerous they are.
Abyssal Leviathan even told Chaos that if he were to meet someone with more than ten death tattoos, he should run—unless, of course, he too managed to form more than ten blood tattoos.
Naturally, what he had given Avotha was going to change his life in ways that, if he didn’t die, would make his legend eternal.
[Four years after Kent entered Hell - Shore of the Damned Hell Sea]
It had been close to four years since Kent challenged the sixth level of Hell. However, over the past four years, nobody had seen him or had any idea what he looked like.
However, because the 14 pillars were still active, they knew he was alive and still inside the Damned Hell Sea.
As to what he was doing there, nobody had the heart or will to go check it out. After all, they valued their lives even if they were in Hell.
However, being made to wait four damn years was already frustrating the hell out of them.

"I will first burn his eyes out of their sockets, then break his fingers using needles. I will cut his arms off, then his legs. Afterwards, I will open him up and carefully remove his organs while keeping him alive.
When all that is done, I will hang him while still open and roast him over insectoid flame," a chainfiend with three hooked arms said, his expression ugly.
Well, in his defense, he was already ugly, so his expression was just bringing out his looks. However, his expression and everyone’s presence were quite unappealing.
They had come to hunt, but their prey was hiding from them. This alone was too much to make them plan all the forms of torture they would inflict on him.
"His death will be slow and painful."
"I will be sure to cut off his penis and shove it into his mouth."
"I will ensure he regrets being born."
"I will stomp on his head until it turns to powder."
As more people joined in, the entire space soon turned chaotic. Everyone was letting out their frustration.
Suddenly, the Damned Hell Sea trembled, and an overwhelming feeling of dread washed over everyone. They all shuddered, and soon they moved back as the sea began to shake.
The entire Damned Hell Sea was shaking like a solid object, causing the surroundings to start caving in. Those closer were swallowed as vortexes began to form.
"Run back, everyone — two overlords are fighting," somebody shouted, causing everyone to run several miles back.
They were afraid, and it was evident from the expressions on their faces. However, as they continued to move back, another thing started to happen to the sea.
"It is boiling... The Damned Hell Sea is boiling."

They all turned pale, feeling an overwhelming sense of helplessness. All they could do was run. The brave and strong ones remained much closer... but if 2,000 miles could be considered closer, then so be it.
Meanwhile, at the core layer of the Damned Hell Sea, Kent sat with his eyes closed, his expression focused, and his hands formed in a seal.
All around him, billions of flame runes moved in the air, pulsing with so much energy. They were moving and entering his forehead, appearing inside his soul sea.
Gaap and Avotha stood 200 miles away, covered by a barrier raised by Avotha.
Inside Kent’s soul sea, a beautiful green core approximately 10,000 km in diameter formed. However, because of how huge Kent’s soul sea was, this large core appeared rather small.
But, as more flame runes merged into it, it started to grow in size, and it was being filled with so much flame essence.
Hours passed, but millions of flame runes still remained.
However, just when the core reached 15,000 km in diameter, the 1,200,098 blood essence that Kent and Gaap had reaped appeared, and, like a hungry lion, Kent started absorbing it.
It turned out that to form the Flame Core, he had to first form his core gate. However, before that, he had to complete cultivating the first form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art.

chapters.title: Chapter 1034: Blood And Fire [Bonus]
paragraphs: Inside a very huge world, where only the color red could be seen, stood a large platform decorated with red lines and runes. At the center of the large golden platform was a massive core pulsating with blood energy.
All around, there seemed to be water; however, this was no ordinary water. Rather, it was a large soul sea, one that contained Kent’s entire soul energy.
The platform had nine nodes.
Currently, atop this large platform, something strange started to happen to one of the nodes.
Hundreds of thousands of Blood Essences were suspended over this node. Slowly, they started to enter the node.
Hours passed, but they continued to enter.

Meanwhile, on the outside, the Damned Hell Sea continued to surge. However, instead of people running back to the City of Chains, more seemed to have been alarmed by this strange phenomenon, so they all started coming over.
In fact, the viewers (those viewing from the other 12 levels of hell are called viewers) who came to watch a bloodbath became intrigued when this strange phenomenon started to happen.
"The Damned Hell Sea is boiling. This can only mean one of two things," a demon dressed in white, two voluminous women in his arms, said, addressing dozens of other demons.
"First, it might be due to a treasure manifesting at the Core Layer of the Damned Hell Sea, and due to that, the Damned Hell Beasts are at war, each trying to get it.
I honestly can see that happening." The demons around nodded.

"Or second, two Overlords are fighting. Naturally, if the person who challenged the sixth level of hell got to the Core Layer, then this battle will be between them and the Overlord whose domain they dare invade."
"If that is the case, then it means the challenger is no simple person."
"Anyone who dares challenge the Hell Road is no simple person. Of course, in my time, I have witnessed three Hell Road challenges, but they all failed.
However, I was told during the Era of the Divine Beast Tamer, a subordinate of his challenged the second level of Hell Road and emerged victorious.
So if this challenge is anything remotely impressive, then I can see him conquering at least five cities, maybe seven maximum."
"You sound confident," another demon said.
"I am confident," the demon with the ladies in his arms responded.
"What makes you think he can’t conquer all 14 cities?"
"Because nobody can." The demon grinned. "I don’t know if you are aware, but when it comes to the 14 cities, their strength is determined by the location.
These cities are the domains of the various Hell Demons. If one were to challenge them in their territory, the only thing that awaited them was death.
Trust me, I know what I am talking about. These 14 cities are not simple cities. They are the heart and soul of the sixth hell level."
"I guess we can only wait and watch what happens."
"I guess we do."
Suddenly, the scene changed, and the boiling sea was calm. However, a bloodthirsty feeling came from the sea, and at once, everybody standing within a 3,000-mile radius felt their bodies tense.
However, the feeling vanished the next second before a heat so powerful erupted from the sea, pushing even those 5,000 miles back.
Inside Kent’s soul sea, the node that was being fed the Blood Essence slowly started to open. As it opened, the feeling of bloodthirst filled his soul and even erupted from his body.
Then, suddenly, a very large gate made of obsidian iron rose from the node and slowly ascended into the sky. After it rose to about 30,000 km in height and 50,000 km in diameter, it stopped.
From within, a red portal formed, and the remaining thousands of Blood Essences were absorbed.
However, just when that was done, the Green Flame Core moved and slowly hovered at the center of the gate.

Flame runes moved slowly, and they started to merge with the Blood Core gate. It took about five hours, but eventually, they merged, and the process of forming and merging the Flame Core and the Blood Core gate came to a close.
However, the next second, a crack appeared in the Green Flame Core, and a rune, very large in fact, came from the crack.
Then another crack came from the large Blood Core at the center of the platform, sending out another rune.
On the outside, Kent’s eyes snapped open, and his body immediately rose into the air, blasting through the dragon mansion.
He appeared outside the mansion, and at once, his clothes were reduced to ash as potent red, green, and golden flames enveloped him.
If one looked closely, they would recognize the green flame as the flames from the Flame Core, the golden flame as the Chaos Soul Flame, and the red flame as the newly awakened Blood Flame.
They cocooned Kent, a process that lasted for a week.
On this day, as the cocoon cracked, a battle-ready Kent appeared. He was covered in red and golden armor made from a blend of metal and leather that appeared to be a unique material.
The design was sharp and elegant, giving off a powerful, fiery presence.
His head is covered in a helmet that is smooth with pointed edges and a glowing slit for the eyes, shaped like burning light.
The chestplate is layered and angular, with a glowing green core at its center that resembles molten fire.
It came with a gauntlet that ended in a razor-sharp claw, one that would drip with blood when used in combat.
The waist area featured several red, flame-like ribbons flowing downward, giving the armor a dynamic appearance.
Suddenly, wings burst from his back, causing the space around him to sizzle.
The helmet melted, revealing Kent’s focused expression. He turned to his left and looked at Gaap. When he extended his hand, Gaap transformed into his sword form and flew toward him.
The moment he landed in his palm, red, golden, and green flames circled around it, causing Gaap to shudder excitedly.
[Let’s gooooooooo...]
Kent had formed his Blood Core Gate, formed his Flame Core, and fully comprehended the first form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art.
Aside from that, 35,000 more flame veins had formed, bringing the total to 70,000. He could now use 5,000 blood runes, and his bloodline power could be utilized at 20% capacity.
Naturally, Kent’s strength had tripled, and that alone was enough to show where Gaap’s enthusiasm was coming from.
[Are we leaving?] Gaap asked.
"Yes," Kent replied. Then he looked at Avotha, who had moved a great deal. "You are still not done learning the Genesis of Death."
"Yes. However, I am closer."

"Then stay here and train." Kent waved his hand, and seven flame seeds appeared. "Guard these seven for me. They want to cultivate inside the Primordial Flame, and since I can’t leave them alone, you must guard them."
Avotha nodded. "Rest assured, I will guard them with my life."
"Great to hear that." Kent lifted his head and looked up at the abyss. "Time for me to go make a name for myself."
"Good luck," Avotha said and stepped back, taking the seven flame seeds.
Kent nodded toward him, and then he fired up 50,000 flame veins. He placed Gaap on his back, and without even a sword sheath, he remained stuck.
"Here I come," Kent shot up at a speed Avotha couldn’t even track.
Fourteen hours later, the sea started to tremble on the surface. Everybody could sense somebody was coming, so they all became alert.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035: Hell Road (1)
paragraphs: "Something is coming," a Chainfiend said, his hooked arms holding a thick chain firmly. He appeared focused and ready to take action.
Around him, thousands of others also sensed the danger and were alert.

Those with some strength in them moved close to the Damned Hell Sea, while the hunters from the other cities who had earned the right to hunt in other cities remained in their own domains, nobody messing with them.
One Chainfiend, a rather ugly hell demon with one eye, stood calmly, holding a scythe. Nobody dares stand close to him. He is one of the best hunters in the City of Chains.
Though not recognized among the main hunters under the City Lord (rulers of the 14 Hell Cities), his influence is great enough to make him a powerhouse among his peers.
"It is not something," he said, "more like a somebody."
"So the challenger is finally coming out, huh?"
"It seems so." The hell demons around all started speculating.

Suddenly, the sea shook, and while many were already accustomed to the sea behaving that way, on this day, as the Damned Hell Sea shook, the sky turned dark, and suddenly someone blasted out of the sea, making a rather peculiar sound.
"Yeeeehuuuu!"
BOOM!
At once, a suffocating pressure descended on everyone, causing them to drop to their knees, some crashing face-first to the ground.
Kent appeared, and with him, a terrifying giant dragon made entirely of green flames appeared behind him, causing everyone to pale.
If one looked at the green dragon and Kent’s crimson armor, they would think he had kidnapped a flame dragon and was using it to intimidate his opponents.
However, this was merely a skill the Core gave him after it was formed.
He can now condense a flame dragon by channeling the essence of his flame core.
Now, looking down at the thousands of hell demons, a grin appeared on Kent’s face.

"It is rather unfortunate, isn’t it? Here you all are, thinking the moment this mysterious person who dares challenge the Hell Road appears, we will swarm him and kill him in the most painful way possible." The grin on his face spread.

"I mean, that is normal, for I would have done the same thing if I were in your place. However, I am not in your place, and while I should applaud you all for delivering precious blood essence to me, I have to say, I am very disappointed."
Kent looked toward the distance, his gaze piercing through the fabric of space as he locked eyes with the ruler of the city, City Lord Zorvak.
"If you want to welcome me into your domain, at least have the decency to send those with powerful blood essence."
After forming the Blood Core Gate, Kent gained the ability to sense the blood essence of his foes and tell which had the highest quality.

Looking at these pitiful hell demons, he could sense only 1,900 quality blood essence. If he wanted to form a Blood Life Seal, he would need exactly 350,000 drops of high-quality blood essence. This meant he was a long way from refining a seal.
"Yeah, well," Kent sighed, wearing an expression that conveyed his disappointment. "I will just kill this bunch and get the rest when I get to the city."
Kent turned to the hell demons who were still struggling under his pressure.
"Time to die."
[How are you going to do that?] Gaap, who was strapped to his back, asked.
"Just watch."
Kent activated 1,200 blood seals, and then, channeling his flame core, the dragon rose up into the air, and then, with a loud roar, green flames burst out of its mouth.
What followed was a purification ritual that left behind golden flames.
Kent didn’t spare even a single hell demon.
Perhaps because he had formed his Blood Core, to him, everything he sees now that is against him is blood essence.
So the hell demons were purified. And when the last of them stopped screaming, Kent waved his hand, and all the blood essence around flew and entered his forehead.
He looked toward the City of Chains, and an evil smile appeared on his face.
"Here I come." With speed that was powered by 20,000 flame veins, Kent shot toward the city, ready to turn off one pillar of light by killing the City Lord.
[The Viewers’ POV]
Unbeknownst to Kent, he had caused the entirety of the remaining 12 levels of hell to become quiet, shocked, and awe-riddling everyone’s faces.
They came to watch a Hell Road challenge.
They had waited for 4 years for him to come.
And when he finally did, everyone’s expectation was shattered. They had never seen what Kent did to the hell demons coming.

In fact, they had anticipated a battle where Kent would be forced into a corner, because, bear in mind, the hell demons he faced were the majority of the hunters from the City of Chains and some of the best in all of Nex Morbus.
However, he left them shocked.
What was even more shocking was that his cultivation base was only at the Core Formation level. They never expected somebody from a high world to challenge the Hell Road.
"I take back my words," the demon with the two voluptuous women in his arms said, "I believe we might just be witnessing the rise of a legend here."
"Does anyone know his name?"
"No. However, looking at his interest in blood essence, I think the name Blood Reaper is more suitable."
"Then, Blood Reaper it is."
[Nyx’s POV]
Just like everyone, Nyx was also expecting a huge battle right after Kent popped out from the Damned Hell Sea.
However, all she saw was a handsome, mischievous, and extremely terrifying brat who, in a strange way, was more attractive than she would love to admit.
"Well, I never saw that coming," Bilad said. "I never expected the Hell Road challenger to be a mere kid from a high world."
"Same here," Nyx couldn’t deny it.
She was taken aback when Kent appeared, and even now, as she watched him speed toward the City of Chains, she couldn’t help but wonder if any of this was actually happening.
"Killing the City Lord in the City of Chains is not going to be easy, though," Bilad said, looking at City Lord Zorvak seated on his throne, his four hooked arms resting on the throne’s armrest.

"If it were easy, I would have long challenged the Hell Road and made you a Hell King," Nyx joked, and Bilad smirked, knowing his friend could be mischievous too if she was around people she was comfortable with.
"Let’s just watch."
[So you have to know this. The moment you step into the Chain City, there is no turning back. You can only move forward and can only move to the next city after the City Lord is dead.]
Gaap said, and Kent nodded...
"Let’s just get this over with. I feel like something very important is waiting for me back home... something I can’t afford to miss."
[I understand.]
Dark runes started to appear on the sword on Kent’s back. With every rune, a very potent, resentful aura surrounded the sword.
[In that case, let us commit a massacre.]
After a few minutes, the City of Chains appeared in Kent’s view...
(A/N: I’ve decided to call the rulers of the 14 hell cities, City Lords, instead of Kings/Queens. The King will be the overall overlord of the entire level of hell.)
