chapters.title: Chapter 1036: Hell Road (2)
paragraphs: They all saw death coming from a mile away. However, instead of running, they pulled out their weapons, thinking they could make a difference.
So he arrived, and with him, death...
"Idiots... You think your petty tricks will work on me?" Kent smirked, feeling his strength drop by 30% when he entered the City of Chains.
"KILL HIM!"
Shouts came from hundreds of thousands of hell demons waiting to end him as he entered the city.
[What a bunch of idiots. Haven’t you heard the phrase... ’In front of absolute strength, all schemes are useless...’]
Gaap said as Kent increased the number of Blood runes to 2,000, and, as if the 30% debuff were nothing, Kent channeled his flame qi through the sword, causing Gaap to feel energized.
Kent moved at a speed so fast that before anyone could register his movements, hundreds had died.
"Formation!"
A chainfiend commanded, and thousands of chainfiends formed a hand sea...
Wait a minute... Let’s pause for a moment to analyze this before we continue.
Chainfiends are hell demons with no hands but rather hooks for arms. The weak ones have two hooked arms. The strong ones have three hooked arms, and the terrifying ones have four hooked arms.
The city lord has four hooked arms, showing his stance in the city.
So if these beings have hooks for arms, then naturally, they can form hand seals. Or what do you think?
Of course, since the hook is their arm, they technically have hands; so, well, back to the battle.
They formed hand seals, and a formation appeared in the air.
From the center of this formation, a thick chain shot out with terrifying force. However, Kent merely swung his sword, and the chain shattered.
But it didn’t stop there. He pointed forward, and a beam of fire blasted out, killing dozens of chainfiends.
Kent was then forced to move back, as another chain burst out from the ground. The moment he moved back, a chainfiend burst out from the ground, and another stepped out of thin air.
"Too slow."
Kent first moved toward the one who came from the ground and cut off his head, before turning to the one who materialized from thin air.
Kent’s speed was just too great.
However, he wasn’t yet moving at his top speed. If he did, thousands would die in seconds. However, something keeps making him hold back...
And so, just like every army, they first sent the weak ones to the slaughterhouse. Naturally, that worked to Kent’s advantage.
He needed a lot of blood essence to strengthen his Blood Core gate, so he could further strengthen himself.
As more chainfiends approached him, the formation began to solidify. This caught Kent’s attention, so he began killing those who were powering the formation.
However, after killing a few thousand, the formation only seemed to grow much stronger with each kill.
’This is odd. It seems the formation is growing stronger.’
[Indeed. Does this mean the more we kill them, the stronger the formation grows? If that is the case, then this is a dangerous formation, even for you.]
’I know. However, I cannot help but want to see how strong this formation can get,’ Kent smiled weakly, knowing it wouldn’t end well.
[This is a bad idea.]
As expected, Gaap saw through his plan and decided to stop the bastard before he got himself killed.
[But then again, learning how this formation works and perhaps how to create it will allow me to hijack it and make it yours.]
Of course, a sane person can never walk with another sane person. At the end of the day, only two crazy people can walk together.
’Then we have a deal. Until the last minute, we will never stop.’
[Deal]
Kent resumes killing, further strengthening the formation.
Meanwhile, inside the Chained Palace, the City Lord Zorvak smirked, watching this display... "Keep going. The more you kill, the better for me."
He smirked before taking a sip of Hell wine.
The ’Dominion of Chains’ is the trump card of the City of Chains. Once deployed, as more people die, the formation strengthens.
Ultimately, the attacker can only surrender, as the formation grows stronger to the point where they find it increasingly difficult to counter.
So watching hundreds of thousands of chainfiends being killed by Kent was like a movie to him.

Throughout the other twelve levels of hell, viewers could see through this formation and recognize it as a dangerous one. However, watching Kent kill more chainfiends left them wondering why he wasn’t stopping.
"Maybe he is not aware of the nature of this formation."
"I think he knows, but he just doesn’t care. Naturally, he is telling everyone his strength is more than enough to handle the formation."
"Just look at the chains popping out. Naturally, he will soon be surrounded by them on all sides."
Kent was indeed being surrounded, but he wasn’t panicking as one would expect. He was merely increasing his speed by activating more flame veins.
No matter how many chains there were, with his speed, nothing could stop him.
Three hours later, there were thousands of chains dangling, shooting, and swatting at Kent from all sides.
’How are we doing, Gaap? I am 40,000 flame veins deep here,’ Kent asked, and his sword responded.
[Just give me one more hour.]
Kent nodded and fired up 10,000 additional flame veins, and like a blur, he continued to kill again.
Thirty minutes later, Kent had to add 10,000 more, bringing the total to 60,000 flame veins. The entire City of Chains had become its name.
There were hundreds of thousands of chains on the battlefield. However, more chainfiends kept going to Kent. It got to a point where they were merely throwing themselves at him to be slaughtered.
Of course, Kent welcomed it.
However, when the time for Gaap to come through was nearing, Kent felt a chain slam into his back, sending him flying backward.
’Formations are the worst.’

Kent smiled and then, using the soul map, he teleported from the path of another chain. He then moved back, and before the chains dangling toward him from his left could close in, a voice came from his sword.
[Now, now... Play along.]
The chains came to a stop, and Kent, who was in the process of cleaving through a chain, paused, and then his grin widened.
He placed the sword on his back and waved his hand, causing the chains to move in the motion of his hand.
"Would you look at that?"
"NO!"
From within the Chain Palace, City Lord Zorvak stood up, his expression dark. He just felt it; his hold on the chains had been broken. In short, he no longer had control over the formation.
Kent looked in his direction and smiled... "Thank you very much for allowing me to borrow this formation to kill you and your hunters."
Kent spread his arms and, like an angel, he slowly rose into the air, smiling at every last chainfiend.
"Ladies and gentlemen, call me the Lord of Chains."
Kent clapped his hands together and activated a skill that instantly turned the entire City of Chains into a land of screamers.
"Chains on Fire." Green flames surrounded the hundreds of thousands of chains.
Yet again, every last viewer was left stunned, unsure of what to even say...

sentences.text: They all saw death coming from a mile away.
However, instead of running, they pulled out their weapons, thinking they could make a difference.
So he arrived, and with him, death...
"Idiots...
You think your petty tricks will work on me?" Kent smirked, feeling his strength drop by 30% when he entered the City of Chains.
"KILL HIM!"
Shouts came from hundreds of thousands of hell demons waiting to end him as he entered the city.
[What a bunch of idiots.
Haven’t you heard the phrase... ’In front of absolute strength, all schemes are useless...’]
Gaap said as Kent increased the number of Blood runes to 2,000, and, as if the 30% debuff were nothing, Kent channeled his flame qi through the sword, causing Gaap to feel energized.
Kent moved at a speed so fast that before anyone could register his movements, hundreds had died.
"Formation!"
A chainfiend commanded, and thousands of chainfiends formed a hand sea...
Wait a minute...
Let’s pause for a moment to analyze this before we continue.
Chainfiends are hell demons with no hands but rather hooks for arms.
The weak ones have two hooked arms.
The strong ones have three hooked arms, and the terrifying ones have four hooked arms.
The city lord has four hooked arms, showing his stance in the city.
So if these beings have hooks for arms, then naturally, they can form hand seals.
Or what do you think?
Of course, since the hook is their arm, they technically have hands; so, well, back to the battle.
They formed hand seals, and a formation appeared in the air.
From the center of this formation, a thick chain shot out with terrifying force.
However, Kent merely swung his sword, and the chain shattered.
But it didn’t stop there.
He pointed forward, and a beam of fire blasted out, killing dozens of chainfiends.
Kent was then forced to move back, as another chain burst out from the ground.
The moment he moved back, a chainfiend burst out from the ground, and another stepped out of thin air.
"Too slow."
Kent first moved toward the one who came from the ground and cut off his head, before turning to the one who materialized from thin air.
Kent’s speed was just too great.
However, he wasn’t yet moving at his top speed.
If he did, thousands would die in seconds.
However, something keeps making him hold back...
And so, just like every army, they first sent the weak ones to the slaughterhouse.
Naturally, that worked to Kent’s advantage.
He needed a lot of blood essence to strengthen his Blood Core gate, so he could further strengthen himself.
As more chainfiends approached him, the formation began to solidify.
This caught Kent’s attention, so he began killing those who were powering the formation.
However, after killing a few thousand, the formation only seemed to grow much stronger with each kill.
’This is odd.
It seems the formation is growing stronger.’
[Indeed.
Does this mean the more we kill them, the stronger the formation grows?
If that is the case, then this is a dangerous formation, even for you.]
’I know.
However, I cannot help but want to see how strong this formation can get,’ Kent smiled weakly, knowing it wouldn’t end well.
[This is a bad idea.]
As expected, Gaap saw through his plan and decided to stop the bastard before he got himself killed.
[But then again, learning how this formation works and perhaps how to create it will allow me to hijack it and make it yours.]
Of course, a sane person can never walk with another sane person.
At the end of the day, only two crazy people can walk together.
’Then we have a deal.
Until the last minute, we will never stop.’
[Deal]
Kent resumes killing, further strengthening the formation.
Meanwhile, inside the Chained Palace, the City Lord Zorvak smirked, watching this display...
"Keep going.
The more you kill, the better for me."
He smirked before taking a sip of Hell wine.
The ’Dominion of Chains’ is the trump card of the City of Chains.
Once deployed, as more people die, the formation strengthens.
Ultimately, the attacker can only surrender, as the formation grows stronger to the point where they find it increasingly difficult to counter.
So watching hundreds of thousands of chainfiends being killed by Kent was like a movie to him.
Throughout the other twelve levels of hell, viewers could see through this formation and recognize it as a dangerous one.
However, watching Kent kill more chainfiends left them wondering why he wasn’t stopping.
"Maybe he is not aware of the nature of this formation."
"I think he knows, but he just doesn’t care.
Naturally, he is telling everyone his strength is more than enough to handle the formation."
"Just look at the chains popping out.
Naturally, he will soon be surrounded by them on all sides."
Kent was indeed being surrounded, but he wasn’t panicking as one would expect.
He was merely increasing his speed by activating more flame veins.
No matter how many chains there were, with his speed, nothing could stop him.
Three hours later, there were thousands of chains dangling, shooting, and swatting at Kent from all sides.
’How are we doing, Gaap?
I am 40,000 flame veins deep here,’ Kent asked, and his sword responded.
[Just give me one more hour.]
Kent nodded and fired up 10,000 additional flame veins, and like a blur, he continued to kill again.
Thirty minutes later, Kent had to add 10,000 more, bringing the total to 60,000 flame veins.
The entire City of Chains had become its name.
There were hundreds of thousands of chains on the battlefield.
However, more chainfiends kept going to Kent.
It got to a point where they were merely throwing themselves at him to be slaughtered.
Of course, Kent welcomed it.
However, when the time for Gaap to come through was nearing, Kent felt a chain slam into his back, sending him flying backward.
’Formations are the worst.’
Kent smiled and then, using the soul map, he teleported from the path of another chain.
He then moved back, and before the chains dangling toward him from his left could close in, a voice came from his sword.
[Now, now...
Play along.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1037: Hell Road (3)
paragraphs: The entire City of Chains turned green as the Primordial Flames of Hell, the ones Kent used to form his core, erupted, setting all chains on fire.
The chains meant to kill him were now being controlled by him.
"Come out and face your death, bastard," Kent said, looking toward the Chained Palace. "Don’t let your subordinates suffer in your stead."
As if to prove what he said, he waved his hand, and the chains claimed over 30,000 Chainfiends’ lives. Their blood essences were the only thing that remained.
City Lord Zorvak gritted his teeth, his anger and fury palpable.

Suddenly, a powerful aura erupted from his body, and he moved, his four hooked arms wielding chains. He wanted Kent dead, but seeing as he had taken over his formation, things seemed to have taken a bitter turn.
The viewers could only sigh in pity as they looked at the pitiful City Lord flying toward Kent.
"He is going to die at the hands of his own creation," they all thought.
However, contrary to what everyone thought, when the City Lord got close to the chains, they parted, allowing him to move unrestricted toward Kent.
To many, that was a foolish move, but to Kent, allowing the bastard City Lord to approach him was the best move.
"DIE!"
City Lord Zorvak shouted, his chains lit in flames as all four hooked arms struck forward, the chains whipping through the air, each aimed at Kent’s body.
The power contained in them caused the space to twist. However, just when they came close to landing on Kent’s body, he vanished and appeared behind City Lord Zorvak and whispered into his ear...
"Are you mad I borrowed your formation?"
He didn’t touch him. Kent merely whispered to him and then moved back. With 60,000 flame veins working to boost his speed, not even ten of City Lord Zorvak could do anything to him.
City Lord Zorvak gritted his teeth and swung his chains, creating a field of chains to prevent Kent from drawing near.
Then he retrieved a talisman and placed it on his chest. In an instant, his strength rose by 300%. He moved forward, aiming to unleash his strongest attack.
However, before he could get close to Kent, he moved again, and this time, instead of speaking, he tapped City Lord Zorvak on the shoulder after Kent appeared overhead, his body turned upside down.
Then, using his index finger, he pressed gently on his head and said, "Down."
City Lord Zorvak’s body was frozen, then, like a nail being struck with a hammer, his body shot toward the ground, his body entering the stony ground, burying him to the neck level.
"Wow, I aimed for only his legs," Kent grinned, seeing that his controlled strength was much stronger than he anticipated.
He landed beside the City Lord and placed his foot on his head before he could get out of the ground.
Kent then waved his hand, and the chains cleared, allowing the Chainfiends to see the situation their City Lord had found himself in.
"Well, I guess this is where we end things." Kent smiled and then, like kicking a ball, City Lord Zorvak’s head flew through the air, landing on a cage several miles away.
The red pillar lit in the City of Chains turned off, announcing that the City lord of Gorathis, the City of Chains, has fallen, and the challenger is now 13 pillars left to reach the Hell king.

"Until next time, everyone," Kent said before taking to the sky. Now that the city lord is dead, he has no reason to kill anymore. After all, they aren’t attacking him, so he also wasn’t about to be shameless and attack them for nothing.
The moment a city lord dies during a hell road, the hunters working under him will stop attacking the challenger. Those are the rules set by the Hell Monarch.
[Mordrath, the City of Ash - Ashira, the Ash Queen’s POV]
The moment the pillars lit 4 years ago, Ashira, the Ash Queen, became prepared to battle against the challenger.

She is the ruler of the 13th city. Naturally, she is stronger and has better warriors than City lord Zorvak. However, after 4 years had passed and the challenger hadn’t reached her city, she started to think maybe the challenger wouldn’t come, that he would die in the Damned Hell Sea.
However, she was mistaken.
Just now, the 14th hell Pillar has been defeated, showing City Lord Zorvak has fallen, and now, the challenger is coming to her.
Naturally, she had to get ahead of things.
The distance between the 14th and 13th cities will take the fastest among them, 5 hours to traverse. So she still has time..
She started deploying countermeasures, aiming to stop the challenger at all costs.
However, 15 minutes later, she sensed a powerful presence approaching the city.
"RAISE THE FORMATION." Her crackling voice spread throughout the city.
"Cremation Sigil." Thousands of Ash wraiths, skeletal demons cloaked in drifting soot, form hand seals, and a brown color formation appeared in the air.
Kent, who saw this formation from a distance, felt his hair stand on end.
"Another formation, huh.
He moved at a speed several times faster, and like he intended to destroy the ash city, he landed hard on the ground, shaking the entire city.
"KILL HIM"

Yet again, thousands of Ash wraiths lunged at him. Kent was soon surrounded on all sides. However, he made no move. Instead, he stomped on the ground and spikes blasted out, impaling over a hundred Ash wraiths.
The bodies landed on the ground, but before he could retrieve their blood Essence, the bodies dissolved into ash, and a feeling of dread spread through the city.
[Damn, that is one powerful formation.]
’Do you know how it works?’ Kent asked.
[Yes. It converts all remains into ash that feeds the city’s eternal furnaces. The ash acts as both weapon and shield, forming clouds that burn intruders alive.
You have Transcendent flame resistance, but even so, that wouldn’t be enough soon. The best move now is to locate the queen and kill her fast.
That is the only way to deactivate the formation.]
’I see.’ Kent looks in a certain direction, spotting the City Lord seated on her throne, looking at him. Kent smiles and mouths the word, ’You will die soon,’ before turning away.
’The soul map is not within range, so teleportation is out of the question. And since I can’t take their blood essence, killing them is pointless.’
The doom shards keep coming out of the ground, killing hundreds every second.
’This means I can only kill the queen fast like Gaap said.’ Kent swung his sword, sending out a powerful flame arc that cleaved through thousands of as wraiths.
The heat in the city rose by a degree, indicating that the formation is growing.
Suddenly, an Idea pops into Kent’s head.
A dagger appeared in his hand, and then 3000 blood runes activated.
At once, Kent turned toward the City load and threw the dagger at a speed so fast that not even the City lord saw how her head was impaled on his throne.
Before her guards could see what had happened, the city lord was long dead, her bone head cracked open by the dagger Kent threw.
The formation is deactivated, and the 13th Hell pillar dimmed, announcing the death of the city lord.
Kent moves and retrieves his dagger, with a wink at the guards, he flew away and headed toward Xyphor — City of Blades

chapters.title: Chapter 1038: Hell Road (4)
paragraphs: [Xyphor, City of Blades]
"Looks like they are waiting for me," Kent said, hovering 20 miles away from Xyphor City, his next destination.
Even from afar, Kent could feel the pressure from the thousands of swords encircling the city.
"They have activated their formation," he added.
[It seems so. Though I have to say, they are much more efficient than the other ones.]
"That is only normal considering two cities fell in a span of four hours. If I were them, I would have even sent men to delay me." Kent smiled and then prepared himself.
[The formation is strange, so be very careful.]
"I will."
Kent moved again, and this time, his body was enveloped in green flames. In no time, he was meters away from the city.
However, before he could enter the city, a large pointed sword shot from the city at great speed. Kent was forced to fly up, but the sword followed.
Kent spun around and swung hard, meeting the sword in a powerful boom. Kent was pushed back, but before he could move again, a second sword arrived.
Then a third appeared, each pointed and aimed at him.
"Damn, I need this formation."
Kent muttered, already planning to kidnap the City Lord and interrogate him for the formation first before killing him.
"Flaming Rings!"
Three thick flaming rings exploded out of Kent’s body, creating a barrier against the swords. Though not an absolute defense, it is good enough to stop the swords for a few seconds at least.
Perhaps because his movement was very explosive, Kent entered the city the next second under immense pressure from the thousands of swords closing in on him.
"Annihilation Strike," Kent said as his sword swung with deadly force, sending a crescent-shaped arc of green flames.
BOOM!
Kent was moved back several steps when his flame sword arc collided with hundreds of swords.

"So there is another secret hidden within the formation, huh?" Kent smirked, feeling like the more force he used, the more powerful the backlash. Also, if he were to limit himself, then the danger level would be several times higher.
But who is Kent if not somebody who thrives in danger?
He smiled and started unleashing powerful attacks, the kind that started to explode back at him.
Seeing him moving closer to them, the Bladeborn demons attacked, and the next thing that happened was a bloodbath between Kent and the steel-bodied demons.
"They are thick-skinned, aren’t they?" Kent sent his sword scraping across the body of a Bladeborn demon.
[There are thousands of demons in hell... so meeting one made of half-human skin and half-metal is only normal.]
A sword came for Kent’s heart; however, he dodged by jumping back. Then, with a powerful stab, his sword met another sword that came from the formation.
Kent jumped back again, then he kicked, his foot landing on another sword, forcing it out of the formation. It moved like a bolt of lightning, impaling a Bladeborn to a wall.
Kent moved, his body a blur as he zipped through thousands of other swords, his mind searching for the City Lord.
If only he knew his nightmare had just begun.
"City Lord, are you sure you want to use this?" a Bladeborn demon asked a hulking demon with crimson skin and a body carved with blade scars. On his back were two great cleavers.
They were staring at a dark liquid in a rather small bottle.
"But this can be fatal to you too," the Bladeborn demon said, reluctant to let his City Lord use the mind-corroding poison.
It is a rather lethal poison... the kind that, if it gets into one’s system, even poison immunity wouldn’t be enough to stop it.
It was more of a mind-attacking poison than an actual poison. If used, all he had to do was cut Kent with his sword, and he would die for sure.

"There is no other way, Kyat. You saw what he did with the other two cities. And you can see him now handling the formation as if it were nothing. I can only use this method; otherwise, I am afraid even I cannot stop him."
Kyat thought for a moment; however, even within that moment spent thinking, Kent reaped 120 blood essences by using the formation to his advantage.
By knocking the swords out of the formation, he could direct them to the thousands of Bladeborn demons around.
Though slow, Kent had found a way to last a few more hours and hopefully defeat this formation too.
"Okay. But just when he is cut, retreat and let me treat you. Just being exposed to the poison is already fatal."
City Lord Karvex nodded. "On the bright side, even if I fall, he will be poisoned without even knowing it. Hopefully, the next City Lord can finish him off."
City Lord Karvex smiled and pulled out his two cleavers, allowing Kyat to administer the poison to them. After a few minutes, the weapons were ready, and he made his way toward the battlefield.
He gazed at Kent, who was fighting against the Bladeborn demons and the formation, and decided to plan for a sneak attack.
He moved closer to the battlefield and remained hidden, waiting for the right time to strike.
"These damn swords," Kent muttered, deflecting a sword with a kick and then, with a powerful strike from his sword, a Bladeborn warrior died.
Kent jumped forward, evading another sword. His left hand grabbed a Bladeborn and slammed him to the ground, smashing his steel head open.
However, before he could move to the next target, a cleaver stabbed him from behind, causing his body to freeze in an instant.
"Damn..."
Kent muttered as his body began to grow numb. He felt cold, and the light in his eyes started to dim.
"DIE!"
A second cleaver was swung with great force. However, despite feeling his body grow numb, Kent raised his sword and blocked the second attack that was aimed at his neck.
However, he didn’t have a chance to move his body before the second cleaver stabbed through him again. Then he felt his body lifted off the ground.
Naturally, the City Lord, who had both swords in Kent’s body, lifted him high to show everyone he had done it. Cheers erupted everywhere. Kent hung weak and drained. Eventually, he died.
This made the cheering sound even louder.
However, when a minute passed and the Hell Pillar was still lit, everyone realized something was not right.
Naturally, they all knew what wasn’t right...
And when a certain purple-haired brat dressed in red armor spoke from atop a tall building, they all felt a chill run down their bodies.
"I look cute even as a dead body."
Kent smiled and waved his hand, causing 10,000 swords to point at City Lord Karvex, whose legs gave out as he fell on his butt.
Kent’s dead body fell on his lap and dissolved into sparks of light, showing it was merely a clone body.
"Too bad there is no surrender. I would have spared your life to enjoy watching you slowly lose your mind for attempting to use such a powerful poison on me."
Kent grinned, and with another flick, the City Lord’s body was impaled by hundreds of swords.
"Too bad I saw through your scheme long before I entered the city."
The Hell Pillar dimmed, and that announced the twelfth city had failed to stop the Hell Road challenger. Kent didn’t waste time there.
After killing the City Lord, he left and headed to the next city...

Then, with a powerful stab, his sword met another sword that came from the formation.
Kent jumped back again, then he kicked, his foot landing on another sword, forcing it out of the formation.
It moved like a bolt of lightning, impaling a Bladeborn to a wall.
Kent moved, his body a blur as he zipped through thousands of other swords, his mind searching for the City Lord.
If only he knew his nightmare had just begun.
"City Lord, are you sure you want to use this?" a Bladeborn demon asked a hulking demon with crimson skin and a body carved with blade scars.
On his back were two great cleavers.
They were staring at a dark liquid in a rather small bottle.
"But this can be fatal to you too," the Bladeborn demon said, reluctant to let his City Lord use the mind-corroding poison.
It is a rather lethal poison... the kind that, if it gets into one’s system, even poison immunity wouldn’t be enough to stop it.
It was more of a mind-attacking poison than an actual poison.
If used, all he had to do was cut Kent with his sword, and he would die for sure.
"There is no other way, Kyat.
You saw what he did with the other two cities.
And you can see him now handling the formation as if it were nothing.
I can only use this method; otherwise, I am afraid even I cannot stop him."
Kyat thought for a moment; however, even within that moment spent thinking, Kent reaped 120 blood essences by using the formation to his advantage.
By knocking the swords out of the formation, he could direct them to the thousands of Bladeborn demons around.
Though slow, Kent had found a way to last a few more hours and hopefully defeat this formation too.
"Okay.
But just when he is cut, retreat and let me treat you.
Just being exposed to the poison is already fatal."
City Lord Karvex nodded.
"On the bright side, even if I fall, he will be poisoned without even knowing it.
Hopefully, the next City Lord can finish him off."
City Lord Karvex smiled and pulled out his two cleavers, allowing Kyat to administer the poison to them.
After a few minutes, the weapons were ready, and he made his way toward the battlefield.
He gazed at Kent, who was fighting against the Bladeborn demons and the formation, and decided to plan for a sneak attack.
He moved closer to the battlefield and remained hidden, waiting for the right time to strike.
"These damn swords," Kent muttered, deflecting a sword with a kick and then, with a powerful strike from his sword, a Bladeborn warrior died.
Kent jumped forward, evading another sword.
His left hand grabbed a Bladeborn and slammed him to the ground, smashing his steel head open.
However, before he could move to the next target, a cleaver stabbed him from behind, causing his body to freeze in an instant.
"Damn..."
Kent muttered as his body began to grow numb.
He felt cold, and the light in his eyes started to dim.
"DIE!"
A second cleaver was swung with great force.
However, despite feeling his body grow numb, Kent raised his sword and blocked the second attack that was aimed at his neck.
However, he didn’t have a chance to move his body before the second cleaver stabbed through him again.
Then he felt his body lifted off the ground.
Naturally, the City Lord, who had both swords in Kent’s body, lifted him high to show everyone he had done it.
Cheers erupted everywhere.
Kent hung weak and drained.
Eventually, he died.
This made the cheering sound even louder.
However, when a minute passed and the Hell Pillar was still lit, everyone realized something was not right.
Naturally, they all knew what wasn’t right...
And when a certain purple-haired brat dressed in red armor spoke from atop a tall building, they all felt a chill run down their bodies.
"I look cute even as a dead body."
Kent smiled and waved his hand, causing 10,000 swords to point at City Lord Karvex, whose legs gave out as he fell on his butt.
Kent’s dead body fell on his lap and dissolved into sparks of light, showing it was merely a clone body.
"Too bad there is no surrender.
I would have spared your life to enjoy watching you slowly lose your mind for attempting to use such a powerful poison on me."
Kent grinned, and with another flick, the City Lord’s body was impaled by hundreds of swords.
"Too bad I saw through your scheme long before I entered the city."
The Hell Pillar dimmed, and that announced the twelfth city had failed to stop the Hell Road challenger.
Kent didn’t waste time there.
After killing the City Lord, he left and headed to the next city...

chapters.title: Chapter 1039: Hell Road (5)
paragraphs: When Kent spotted the formation in the City of Blades, he sensed some familiarity with it. Of course, this familiarity wasn’t the kind that suggested he was the one who created it.
The feeling leans more towards the connection he felt from his soul universe.
They could feel the origin of the formation came from the same origin as his soul universe. So Kent decided to investigate.
First, he created a clone body inside his soul universe and then, using the abundant soul essence at his disposal, he tempered it, imbuing a soul mark into it.
In a way, he made the clone body a living entity for a limited period.
One hour to be precise.
Within that one hour, he could act as a human through his clone body. This was because he wanted the formation to register him in his clone body, which it did.
Then, while his clone body fended off the attacks of the formation, his main body sneaked in and started observing the formation.
To the viewers, they saw two bodies move into the city. However, to the Bladeborns, they only saw one person, and that person was killed by their city...
However, in reality, Kent discovered that the formation was created by a sword refined with the soul spirits of one million hell demons.
This made it very powerful, and upon examining the formation inscribed into it, Kent knew he had to obtain that sword.
Thankfully, when it comes to the amount of soul essence, he is swimming in it. So he used his advantage to make the sword his own, and when he succeeded, the sword became his forever.
Now, he can command the ’Crimson Guillotine Array’.
Kent examined the jagged sword in his hand as he stood on Gaap, who was flying him toward the 11th city.
"This is some powerful sword right here," Kent said, and Gaap, who was clearly jealous, had to agree with Kent.
[It is indeed a good sword... however, nowhere near what I am capable of.]
Kent smiled. "I know, Gaap. However, with time, if more soul spirits are fed to it, it will become a great killing array, the kind that will cause armies to flee in terror."
[Whatever...]
As a sword, hearing his master praise another sword made him jealous.
Gaap may appear as this old demon with ancient knowledge, but at heart, he is still a sword. So whatever level of jealousy swords feel, he was clearly feeling one now.
"Of course, I will be leaving Little Demon in your capable hands. If you can train and nurture him, maybe one day you will have a little brother."
[Really...]
Kent smiled, hearing Gaap’s enthusiastic exclamation.
He knew the demon sword he had obtained had the potential to one day cause even gods to run. Kent is a swordsman—somebody who was heralded as the father of swordsmen.
His legacy established the foundation of the sword. So when it comes to swords, his senses are rather sharp on them.
He can discern the best from the chaff.
Little Demon is a good sword, and he knew that. Now, he would be giving it to Gaap to nurture it.
The reason behind this decision was to ensure Gaap wasn’t jealous if he started giving Little Demon some attention.
The second is, he can sense Little Demon’s sword spirit will soon be awakening, and so he wants Little Demon to feel some form of brotherly respect for Gaap when he is born.
This way, he will forever be Gaap’s little brother.
[I will be sure to make Little Demon as great as me back in the day.]
"I know you will"
[20 hours later]
Kent came to a stop exactly 200 meters away from Vorath, the City of Flies.
"This is not what I expected to be my 4th challenge," Kent said, staring at a sight that sent both chill and disgust down his spine...
[This should be a lesson to you. In the future, when you hear of the insect demons, picture them as ugly, disgusting, and extremely venomous.]
Kent sighed, the disgust on his face deepening. What he was staring at could only be described as disgusting.
There were thousands of bloated, insectoid demons with rotting wings and pus-oozing boils. They were as large as a horse, and every last one of them was just...
Fighting them would be very disturbing.
"Little Demon will have to handle them for us," Kent said, and Gaap nodded to that.
He would have loved to be the one to handle this battle, but he knew Kent had no plans to kill these disgusting demons by himself, so Little Demon would do that.
Kent started moving toward the city, and as he drew closer, he could sense the pungent smell of the insects assaulting his nostrils. Kent came to a stop at once.
Even in the 12 levels of hell, the viewers were disgusted.
"I have never seen disgusting insect demons like these ones before. Makes me wonder if they are worth keeping alive."
A certain demon who was drinking a red juice spat out the drink, his expression dark. "Today is the last time I will ever drink Hell Wine."
"I wonder how the Blood Reaper is going to handle this disgust. Just look at his expression; he is clearly disgusted by the appearance of his next opponents."
"Maybe this is the battle he will fall in. After all, I wouldn’t fight these things."
Suddenly, everyone saw a rotting and smelly insect demon move toward Kent. After closing the distance between them, Kent saw a sneer form on its rotten face.
"What is wrong, Mr. Challenger?" the insect demon asked, his sneer widening. "Are you too disgusted to enter the city?"
Kent’s mouth twitched, but he couldn’t deny the truth in the question he was asked. He was indeed disgusted at the prospect of entering the city.
Seeing his expression, the insect demon smiled. "My Queen has a message for you."
Kent glared at the bastard, whose smile widened. "If you were to become my Queen’s plaything, she would consider keeping you alive for a few years."
"No, thank you."
The demon lost its head, and then with a wave of his hand, Little Demon teleported and appeared in the city.
"Crimson Guillotine Array... activate." Kent forms a hand seal...
In an instant, an array of thousands of swords appeared, and the City of Flies became the first city to taste total defeat.
After all, Kent was planning on doing the sixth level of hell a favor and rid it of this abomination of a race for good.
Three hours later, the 11th pillar dimmed after every last insect demon was killed. 1.6 million blood essences were absorbed into his soul, which were used to further strengthen the blood core gate.
Kent moved and left the city behind.

In all 12 levels of hell, everyone held smiles on their faces. The insects were massacred, and with them, the City of Flies would be dissolved for a while before a new race of demons took their place.
Kharzun, the City of Shadows, was the next destination. Kent had already handled four cities, leaving him with ten more to go.
Naturally, all viewers adjusted their sitting posture, for they all knew the real battle had begun here.
If only they knew Kent had also made plans to unleash his full strength... In the end, the one who remains standing is the strongest.

chapters.title: Chapter 1040: Hell Road (6)
paragraphs: A shadow with elongated claws lunged at Kent, who was just 1,000 meters away from Kharzun, the City of Shadows, his next destination. It is the 10th Hell City and also where the danger level starts to rise.
This city is filled with the Shadowborn demons. They are special kinds of demons with a great affinity for the shadows.
Naturally, that makes them very well hidden and hard to track. They are natural assassins.
However, just as the shadow was 20 meters from Kent, its body slammed hard to the ground, and it splattered, leaving behind only a golden blood essence.
Kent didn’t even turn to look at the bastard. He stood in place, his eyes closed as he examined the changes happening inside his body.
’Looks like the more of my bloodline I use, the stronger the blood runes become.’ Kent had activated 20% of his bloodline and began slowly checking his blood runes.

He now realized that after fully cultivating the first form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art, each blood rune gives a 500% boost to his strength. Also, he can now use 5,000 blood runes and 70,000 flame veins.
Kent knew that with this buff, it would give him the power to handle even thousands of Heavenly Ascension stage warriors at the same time.
However, he had just noticed that if he is using 20% of his bloodline, then every blood rune, aside from the 500% boost to his strength, his bloodline gives each blood rune a threefold boost.
This means instead of a 500% boost per blood rune, it becomes a 1,500% boost per blood rune.

At the moment, he decided to activate just 100 blood runes and 20% of his bloodline. This means, despite having the strength of a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior, even without the bloodline and blood runes, his current strength is 150,000%.
There is no way anybody can get close to him.
Another Shadowborn demon lunged at him; however, he was crushed before he could get close to him. Kent merely felt invincible, and to some extent, he was indeed invincible.
’Let me just get this over with and head down to the Core Layer of the Damned Hell Sea to form more flame veins before my time runs out.’
Kent opened his eyes, and he moved, this time not caring about any formation.
His movement was quick, and his strength was just so overpowering.
When he entered the city, he sensed the danger emanating from the formation; however, he paid it no attention.
He was crashing into everyone, moving so fast they couldn’t track him.
Inside the Shadow Palace, Velith the Veiled sensed Kent drawing near, so she decided to clash with him.
She had no weapon in hand, but thanks to her elongated claws, she had a good weapon.
She moved at a speed several times faster than the other Shadowborns.
However, just when she was 20 meters from Kent, her body stopped as if she had suddenly decided to stop. Not even her claws could move.
Naturally, that was Kent using his bloodline to suppress her completely.
"So long."

With a swing of his sword, a red sword arc flashed out and cut her in half. However, it didn’t stop there; the arc sliced through more buildings and Shadowborns in its path until the Shadow Palace was even cut in half.
’Damn, that is dangerous,’ Kent smiled, and then, using the soul map, he teleported away.
[The Viewers]
The viewers who saw this sight became stunned.

There is one thing to suppress a city lord, and another to kill her subordinates with mere bloodline power. However, when it comes to cutting an entire city in half with a casual swing, that is where the problem starts.

"Wait a minute. I have been around for a very long time and have seen a lot, but damn, this is my first time seeing somebody who made swordsmanship look dope," a certain demon lady said, her loins tingling.
"You don’t say. Just look at how he swung the sword. It was like he and the sword understood each other."
"This kid is what you call a prodigy."
"I am sure Bliz will have a hard time facing him."
"I would be disappointed if he had it easy. After all, I am rooting for this kid to kill him and become the next Hell King."
"Same here."
"Me too."
Meanwhile, Bilad and Nyx were equally stunned when they saw how Kent killed the city lord.
"What is on your mind, Nyx..." Bilad asked. This was the first time he had seen Nyx take a close interest in someone other than herself.
This mysterious, purple-haired boy, whom everyone keeps calling the Blood Reaper, had managed to pique her interest.
So she had been paying close attention to him for the past few hours.
"I don’t have anything on my mind. Though I would be lying if I said this kid hasn’t piqued my interest. If I were to recruit him, my chances of becoming an Underworld Queen would be extremely high.
Too bad he is after the role of a Hell King."
"Too bad indeed." Bilad smiled.
"Maybe you can tell him to make me the next Hell King, then he will take my place and help you become an Underworld Queen."
Nyx smacked Bilad’s head for making fun of her. However, she wouldn’t mind swapping her best friend for Kent if that meant she got to become an Underworld Queen.
"Stop daydreaming, Nyx. He is not somebody we can poach just like that. But even if we could, there is no telling if he can help you just yet.
After all, he is from a high world with cultivation only at the Core Formation stage."
"I know, Bilad. And I don’t think he is from a high world. I think he is from a medium world, considering even after this many kills, he hasn’t broken through to the Spirit Ascension stage.
I think he just entered the Hell Road from a high world..."
"Damn. To think a person from a medium world would be soloing beings that, had it not been for the laws, would only be found in immortal worlds... Just what kind of monster is he?"

Bilad was even impressed. Between the two of them, he was the strongest. He had saved Nyx, and since then, they had been friends. Although Nyx liked to play bossy every day, he was, in fact, very powerful.
But even he knew if he were in Kent’s place, he wouldn’t be able to do the things Kent was doing. Nobody could —or at least nobody he was aware of could do that.
"He is stopping," Nyx said, staring at Kent, who had come to a stop atop a cliff.
He stood calmly, gazing over the horizon.
"Why did he stop?" Bilad asked, but Nyx didn’t mind him. She also wanted an answer to that question, so why ask her?
Naturally, every last viewer was also wondering the same thing. They all wanted to know why Kent stopped.
Since he came out of the Damned Hell Sea, he hadn’t even taken a breather. The past hours had been him moving nonstop. However, for the first time, he actually stopped.
Many were intrigued. However, before they could get answers to their queries, the transmission was cut, causing everyone to grit their teeth.

The past hours had been him moving nonstop.
However, for the first time, he actually stopped.
Many were intrigued.
However, before they could get answers to their queries, the transmission was cut, causing everyone to grit their teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1041: Hell Road (7)
paragraphs: [A few moments before the transmission went down - Kent’s POV]
After defeating the City of Shadows, Kent made his way toward Dravok, the City of Bones, to handle the 9th Hell Pillar.
However, along the way, he suddenly came to a halt, prompting everyone to see this as unusual for someone like Kent.
They never thought he would stop... yet he did.
Kent stopped atop a tall mountain, one that offered him a view far and wide. He observed the vast land stretching before him.
"Haa," Kent sighed, and then turned to his left.
"From where I’m from, we call stalkers ’creeps.’ You wouldn’t want to be known as the god of creeps, would you?" Kent said, a small smirk on his lips.

For a moment, nothing happened, then out of thin air, a man stepped out, a smile painting his face. He was a normal human like Kent. However, he wasn’t fooling Kent with his good looks... after all, that was just a skin he chose to appear before Kent in.
"How did you sense me?" the man asked.
Kent stared at him for a few seconds before responding. "If you’ve lived for as long as I did, not even gods can sneak up on you."
"Tch..." The man chuckled, finding Kent’s reply somewhat funny. After all, Kent was only 21. In the grand scheme of things, he wasn’t even an infant.
"So how can I help the Monarch of Hell? I doubt you came here to watch me decimate your people. Though I have to say, they are much weaker than I expected."
The Hell Monarch, the true overlord of Hell and all thirteen levels, smiled, hearing Kent’s words. He is a god, but in front of this brat, he felt like he was beneath him.
That was just ridiculous to him, considering he can easily slap Kent to death.
However, as he stood there, staring at Kent, the feeling of inferiority was the one he felt toward him...
"You are very far from home, Kent... when do you plan on leaving?"
"Right when I am done spending three hundred years here. Of course, first, I will kill a couple of your city lords and hell demons. Then, when done, I will be on my way."
The smile on the Hell Monarch’s face faltered at hearing what Kent had planned for his people.
He was the one who created the hell roads. He made sure to set the rules: whoever challenges a hell road will face fourteen city lords and thousands of hunters.
These rules had held for as long as he could remember.
However, today, these rules have become a recipe for his ruin. Hell was his domain... The beings in it fueled his strength. So if Kent kept killing them, he would be weakened.
Kent had already gone too far in the Damned Hell Sea and the City of Flies. However, from the look of things, he wasn’t planning on making things easy for himself at all.
In the end, the rules he created were now going against him...
"I am afraid I cannot allow you to kill any more of my people. You have done enough," the Hell Monarch said, a smile trying to come to his face.

Kent looked at the nine pillars still lit and smiled. "I am afraid the nine Pillars said a different thing, Your Highness. So perhaps you should stick to your own rules and let me handle my business."
"More blood to reap." Kent winked at him. He then turned and looked into the distance, where the City of Bones was waiting for him to come and conquer it.
"What if we come to some form of arrangement?" the Hell Monarch said, and Kent turned back toward him.
"I need blood, and this is a nice hunting field. I believe that should tell you the kind of mission I am on."
"I know, and I plan to make it up to you somehow. So why don’t you listen to my offer first, then we can continue from there."
"Go ahead."
"Since you are here to challenge the 6th Hell Throne, I won’t prevent you from doing that. However, I will be setting new rules for you alone.
The rule will only allow you to challenge the City Lords, and if you stop them, you will have the chance to challenge the current Hell King. However, there will be no city-to-city bloodbath.

In exchange for allowing me to implement this rule, I will allow you to enter Hell Beasts Paradise once from anywhere you are. I will also grant you a chance to leave after you become a Hell King, but you still get to keep your status as a Hell King.
That is, if you manage to defeat the current Hell King."
"Wait a minute. So if I were to become a Hell King and then leave this place, will the status be taken off me?" Kent asked after hearing what the Hell Monarch said.
"Yes. However, I plan to let you select someone to rule in your absence. I will even help you look for a suitable candidate. However, it cannot be the Death Dragon you made your beast companion."
"I see." Kent was clearly enlightened, hearing something that would have cost him something very precious. Becoming a Hell King sounded dope and powerful.
He didn’t know just how much power he would be getting, but he knew becoming a Hell King was something he needed.
He had already seen what could happen if he didn’t have countermeasures to protect those he cared about in the illusion that Zaila’s past life consciousness showed him.
Kent knew that in the future, he would have to take trips too far for his women to come with him. Shit, he would be embarking on one soon.
So, while he was gone, he wanted those he cared about protected at all costs. He wouldn’t want to come back to the ruins of what he failed to protect.

So to Kent, becoming a Hell King was a step in the right direction... one that he would build upon and ensure that, in years to come, the power he could command would rival any force that came against him.
But if he were to lose his status while away, he couldn’t accept that.
So, hearing there was a fix for that, he began considering the offer he was presented with.
"I have three requests aside from your generous offer. If you can fulfill them, I will stop and follow your arrangement."
Hearing Kent’s words made the Hell Monarch smile. "I am listening."
"First, allow Avotha to come and go as he pleases. Since he can’t become my replacement, then allow him to come and go like he owns the place."
"I can allow that."
"Second, protect the seven Primordial Flame Seeds at the core layer of the Damned Hell Sea. I will come back for them 3.7 million years from today."
"I can do that."
"And lastly, I want the remaining battles to be a ten against one. This means I want the nine remaining City Lords and the Hell King to face me together in a big arena."
The Hell Monarch was stunned by the third request. However, knowing the kind of monster he was dealing with, he nodded.
"I can arrange that."
"Then great. I accept your offer, and please tell me who will be my replacement."
The Hell Monarch smiled and snapped his fingers, dragging two people through the void.
"Kent, meet two of the most ambitious people I have ever met... Bilad and Nyx."
Kent’s brow raised upon hearing the name Nyx...

chapters.title: Chapter 1042: Hell Road (8)
paragraphs: [First Meeting]

"This is Nyx. She is an overly ambitious young lady who seems to think that one day, she will become an Underworld Queen. A rather ridiculous idea, considering she wasnt` even selected when she tried to join the Ninth Underworld Army."
The Hell Monarch said, his expression filled with ridicule. He then turned to Bilad, who was still in shock at standing between two people he never knew he would meet in person in this life.

"And this is her best friend Bilad, who, even if he is going to die, and he knew it, he would still stand by his friend’s side. He is a good person for sure, and she is lucky to have someone like him in her twisted life."

After introducing them, he turned to Kent and chuckled, "They are the only two who can stand in as Hell King or Hell Queen while away. Use this time to get to know them and take your pick. I will go plan your death match."
"Looking forward to it."
Kent smirked when the Hell King vanished from sight.
He turned to face Nyx, who was staring at him with widened eyes.
"Very ambitious indeed. For a mere Immortal King to think about usurping the throne and becoming an underworld Queen, I am impressed," Kent laughed, his heavenly jade eye revealing everything.
Nyx flinched when she heard what Kent said.

However, before she could say anything, Bilad stepped in. "Pleasure meeting you, Blood Reaper. I have to say, you are much more impressive in person. However, to think you are just a core formation stage warrior... are you really from a High world?"
Kent smiled. "No... I am actually from a medium world, yet to ascend."
"Damn... Nyx was right... you really are a monster."
Kent laughed and turned to Nyx, who was still staring at him like she wanted to devour him. "You look hungry, Nyx. Do you wanna devour me?"
Kent asked, and Bilad exploded in laughter.
"Just so you know, I am very delicious."
Despite being in the presence of two immortals, Kent wasn’t even remotely intimidated. Of course, they can easily kill him... that much is true...
However, he wasn’t afraid, not because he knew the Hell Monarch wouldn’t allow it, but because he was that confident he would be fine even if they attacked him.
Perhaps it may be due to his bloodline, but he wasn’t afraid, and that spoke volumes...
"Nyx is just flustered after meeting her hero... trust me, she was rooting for you to win the Hell Road challenge. Maybe you should sign your autograph on her weapon. Trust me, she will be very—"
Bilad was sent flying several miles away when Nyx couldn’t handle enough of his shamelessness.
Kent could only laugh and watch Nyx blush. "Sorry about him. He has a few screws loose..."
"I don’t mind. And between the two of us, I don’t mind signing my autograph anywhere you want me to... Anywhere." Kent winked at her with a gaze pointing at places he shouldn’t dare look at.
Nyx turned away to hide her blush.
Bilad arrived and saw everything, allowing him to see the blush on Nyx’s face.
Bilad and Kent started teasing her. After an hour, when she couldn’t stand it anymore, she blurted out her inner demons.
"Can you help me become an Underworld Queen? I mean, when you become strong enough."
Kent smiled and shook his head. "I can’t help because you are already an Underworld Queen from where I came from..."
Bilad and Nyx became stunned hearing Kent’s reply.
"What?"
Bilad asked, his expression calm yet questioning.
"True. I am 370,000 years in the past. But since we are in Hell, where time is ten times faster, that will be 3.7 million years. However, in the future, you will indeed become an Underworld Queen.
Of course, I have no idea how it happened, but I am sure I wasn’t the one who helped you.

This means you must believe in yourself and don’t give up your dream—who knows, you might just become a queen soon... not that you aren’t already a queen. In my eyes, you are more than a queen." Kent winked, and Nyx smiled.
She turned to Bilad. "I told you I will become a Queen one day."
"You did, Nyx, and it seems you succeeded. I am happy for you in advance."
Kent smiled and then turned to Bilad. "This means you will help me rule Hell for 3.7 million years.

Maybe even more... after all, I can’t stay here forever. I have to go back, and thanks to the Hell Monarch’s generosity, he will allow me to keep my Hell King status by allowing one of you to rule in my absence.
Of course, he will allow both of you to meet any day..."
"He accepts your offer," Nyx answered before Bilad could reject Kent’s offer.
"You," Bilad was left stunned. "But who would help you become an Underworld Queen... If I become a Hell King, I can’t help you."
"Stupid... do you think becoming a Hell King is something that can be offered so casually? Better grab this offer before it slips away.
As for helping me become an Underworld Queen, don’t worry. Since it is meant to happen, then naturally, it will happen."
Knowing she would become an Underworld Queen in the future gave her the confidence she may have lacked before. Of course, knowing about the future is risky.

If one knew what happened to them, they would be inclined to make changes that would alter the timeline. However, what Kent told her was just a reveal, not anything concrete that would change anything.
She knew she would become an Underworld Queen, but she had no idea how to go about it. This means she would follow the original timeline, allowing things to unfold as they were meant to.
"She is right. You should grab this chance. She will be fine," Kent said, and Bilad entered a complex inner thought—one that lasted for ten minutes before he accepted Kent’s offer.
"Great... All I have left is to kill the remaining nine City Lords and the Hell King in one big duel to the death," Kent laughed, causing Nyx and Bilad to shake their heads.
They learned some interesting things about Kent, giving them a clear image of what kind of monster he was.
They tried to come to terms with his nature, but after a few headaches, they accepted the fact that some monsters just don’t have equals.
A few hours later, an announcement about the change to the Hell Road challenge spread everywhere.
Instead of city-to-city dominance, it would be one big battle in the Damnation Hell Arena. Nobody saw this coming; however, they were all excited for this battle.

In three days, Kent would be facing the City Lords of Dravok, the City of Bones; Sarnok, the City of Silence; Vorgath, the City of Hunger; Tzaryth, the City of Whispers; Phorak, the City of Molten Iron; Zerath, the City of Storms; Obryss, the City of Blood; Nytheris, the City of Frostfire; and Draemora, the City of Nightmares.
On top of that, the Hell King, Fallen Angel Bliz, would also be joining the battle in what promised to be the first of its kind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1043: Hell Road (9)
paragraphs: "This is a one-of-a-kind Hell Road Challenge," a demon said, watching the Damnation Hell Arena display on their viewing screens.
"To think a Hell Road challenger will request to challenge all Nine City Lords and even the Hell King, just what is he trying to prove?"
"I know, right. I think he is just being arrogant at this point."
"I think so too."
"Me too."
"I don’t think he is being arrogant. I think he is trying to prove something, and he plans to use this duel to prove that."

"What is he trying to prove? We have seen what he can do. We know he is strong. However, making it look like the overlords of the various cities and even the Hell King are not a threat is just too much."
"I guess we will find out his true intention after the battle is over... that is, if he manages to win"
Everybody was watching the final battle between Kent and the Nine Hell Demons. Word had even reached the Underworld and the Undeadworld about the change in the usual Hell Road Challenge format.
This brought many people down to Hell to witness this momentous occasion.

Under normal circumstances, the Damnation Hell Arena would only be used for battles between demigods. However, because of how engaging and unexpected this one was, the Hell Monarch saw to it that it was used for this battle.
Now, millions of Hell demons were gathered in this skull-shaped battle arena, ready to watch the first-of-its-kind battle. They want to see the arrogant Kent killed in the most brutal way possible...
Inside a hallway, Kent stood with a smile playing on his face as he looked at three people. Nyx, Bilad, and Gaap stood staring at him.

"I really am sorry. I can’t help you anymore. If I were to appear in such a high-profile battle, those people might be watching, and if they recognize me, they will come after you no matter where you run to."
Kent smiled and assured Gaap he understood. "Don’t worry about it, buddy. You on the battlefield will be overkill."
Gaap smiled, feeling the confidence in Kent’s tone.
At first, he thought he was only going to help Kent walk the Hell Road. However, now that the stakes had been raised, he knew things had to change.
After all, the reason he ran from Hell was because of a blunder he made when he killed the son of a very powerful Underworld King.
He came this close to dying... However, a mysterious figure saved him and sent him to the Pill Ascension Realm, where he spent millions of years until he met Kent.
So, even though he wasn’t sure, he didn’t want to appear in such a high-profile battle where he might put Kent’s life in danger.
Kent turned to Nyx and Bilad. "Be sure to cheer for me..."
They nodded.

Suddenly, all four of them heard powerful shouts as nine figures walked into the arena, each ready to kill the bastard who dared arrogantly use the Hell Monarch to force them into what they were calling an unfair battle.
In their minds, Kent was as good as dead.
They were City Lords, beings who, if not for the laws of the Hell Road, were only a step away from reaching the demigod stage.
So, for a mere Core Formation brat to dare be arrogant before them, they surely wanted to teach him a painful lesson.
A few seconds after they appeared, a red bone throne materialized from thin air, bringing with it a commanding aura announcing the arrival of the Hell King.
"ALL HAIL THE HELL KING!"
"ALL HAIL FALLEN ANGEL BLIZ"
Screams and shouts filled the Arena as the Hell King appeared, seated calmly in his throne, a sword floating beside him.
One had to give it to him; he knew how to make an entrance.
He looked classic — something not even Kent could replicate.
Kent knew that, so he didn’t even attempt to make any flashy entrance. He simply walked out of the hallway and stepped into the Arena, a smile painting his face.

"Oh my, this place is jam-packed," Kent said, noticing 12 different types of Hell demons. Naturally, there would have been 13, but he annihilated the insects, leaving only those he had defeated their city lords and those yet to be defeated.

"I am honor everyone. This is really a great honor to fight and show everyone their new Hell King is no weakling." Kent bowed slightly to the audience, causing all of them to sneer and throw insults at him.
However, Kent didn’t mind and instead turned to his opponents, who were looking at him with hostile gazes.
"Just so we are all on the same page, know that this is not personal. I merely want to add Hell King to my titles. But unfortunately, you guys stand in my way, so I must move you."
They didn’t say anything; instead, they turned to the Hell King, who raised his head and looked at Kent...
When their gaze met, a smirk formed at the corner of his lips. "Bug," he muttered.
Kent merely smiled and fired back, "Hell King on a countdown."
Naturally, this struck Hell King Bliz very painfully. However, before he could say anything, Kent retrieved a black fabric from his space ring...

"I would like to state that I, Kent Madson, your soon-to-be Hell King, am not a bully. I am not a bully, so I wouldn’t be a bully just because the chance presented itself now." He looked at the nine City Lords and Hell King Bliz...
"They are just too weak, so I don’t want to bully them." He raised the black piece of clothing...
"...To make this a fair battle, I will blindfold myself to give them a fair fight. Of course, as to whether they can take advantage of this and win, that will depend on how capable they are."
Kent tied the cloth over his eyes, blinding himself, an act that enraged not only the Hell demons but even the demons from the Underworld and the Undeadworld watching.
"Too arrogant."
"He must die."
"He deserves to die."
"I want him dead."
Their emotions were all over the place. They all wanted Kent dead, and from the look on Hell King Bliz’s face, Kent had enraged him beyond what he could take.
He stood up, and his aura exploded. Then, grabbing his sword, he lunged at Kent with a fierce and powerful attack, one that caused the very space to crack.
"And here we go."
Kent’s bloodline exploded, transforming him into a Demi-Dragon.
BOOM.
His fist collided with the sword, sending both of them back...
However, the next second, Hell King Bliz came at him again, and this time, he poured more strength into his attack.
A smile appeared on Kent’s lips as he saw nine more attacks through his soul map coming from the City Lords. "Oh, this is going to be fun."

Contrary to what everyone was feeling, Kent’s tactic of angering and calling on the eleven hell demons to help him understand the full extent of his power worked, and now he was thrust into a battle where either he walked out alive or the hell demons did.

chapters.title: Chapter 1044: Kent Vs Eleven Angry Hell Demons (1)
paragraphs: "Bone Eruption." The ground split open, shooting jagged spikes that threatened to impale Kent. However, he swiped his claws and shattered them before stomping hard on the ground.

The ground shook violently, causing Maldrak, the Bone Sovereign, to stumble back. Kent moved toward him, trying to take a chunk of his throat with his claw; however, Hell King Bliz arrived before he could have the chance.
Kent was forced to abandon his attack.
However, before he could defend against the sword attack coming from Hell King Bliz, a powerful vibration came from the side, causing him to lose control of his body for a moment...
This allowed Hell King Bliz to land a clean cut on his arm, sending him slamming back. However, the wounds healed in the next second, though the pain couldn’t be healed.
Kent turned to see who attacked him with the vibration pulse...He is blinded, but he can see.
’Eryth the Mute Seer.’
Kent’s eyes revealed what he needed to know to place this hell demon on top of his kill list.
He was a pale, eyeless demon with a stitched mouth. He can’t speak; for all he had to say comes from his staff...
It was a black staff topped with a glass orb that absorbed light and sound. The orb constantly spun, emitting waves that erased spiritual vibrations.
Kent knew attacks that messed with the mind were something he should be wary of. However, he also knew this was what made the thing even more fun...
’He dies first, then the bone-looking man goes next.’
Kent jumped back and then ducked, evading another attack from Hell King Bliz.
Then he smirked and vanished, appearing behind the Mute Seer. However, before he could land an attack, a music note reached his ear, causing him to freeze...
’Damn...’
Kent said to himself, and then his head came off clean. Hell King Bliz chopped his head off, but he didn’t seem that happy.
The next second, he appeared behind Lilithara, the Siren of Despair, and landed a powerful kick on her butt, sending her flying across the battleground.
’So far, I have identified two people who pose a threat to me. This cannot happen if I want to be an absolute being, someone who doesn’t fear anything or anyone.’
Kent sidestepped another attack from Hell King Bliz, whose anger seemed to start to overflow.
’I need to train my mind. It is my only weakness now.’
The vibration struck his mind, and now the musical notes seem to do so too. This made it clear to him that he was still lacking in another department...
His soul is fortified thanks to Elsa, but now he needs to fortify his mind...
"Forgemaster’s Wrath." Ignor the Forge Tyrant unleashed a powerful attack by condensing thousands of weapons, causing them to fly toward Kent.
’40,000 flame veins.’
Kent’s speed surged when he activated the flame veins.
like walking through a field of flowers, he started breezing through the flying weapons.
While Kent was handling the thousands of weapons, Volkris the Thunderer, a blue-skinned demon with horns shaped like lightning forks, was forming a spear made of lightning as he eyed Kent.
The Mute Seer had also started directing ’Null Pulses’ at Kent, who was using his flame essence to protect his body and soul essence to protect his mind.
However, when Lilithara’s music entered his ears again, his mind started to falter.
’She really is someone not to be underestimated. However, she is also helping me train my mind, so how about I keep her around for a bit?’
Kent jumped high into the air and unleashed four claw arcs at the weapons flying toward him. Then he landed, striking with his right leg.
"Heavenbreaker Javelin." Suddenly, Volkris threw a lightning spear at Kent, who grabbed it with his sword and was about to throw it at him when he sensed a smoke-like figure materialize behind him.
CRACK
Kent clenched the spear, causing it to shatter. This created a lightning bubble that blasted Morvath the Dream Eater away.
"Clone Bodies." Ten clone bodies appeared and spread out on the battlefield.
"SWAP."
He swapped with a clone body 30 meters away. Then he jumped into the air, causing the ground to explode.
"Claw Arc."
He unleashed red claw arcs, causing the expression on Morvath the Dream Eater’s face to change.
He was someone who, if he got close and touched you, then that would be the end for you. His abilities allowed him to enter your mind and place a nightmare in there.
Kent wouldn’t be able to evade that. His mind may be strong, but not as strong as his body. So from the start of the battle, he had been eyeing that bastard, waiting for him to attack.
He was at the back, waiting for a chance to strike, not knowing Kent was also waiting for him to get close.
And now that he was midair, there was nowhere to run. So the terrifying claw arcs slammed into his body, sending him crashing to the ground.
Unluckily for him, he landed beside a clone body that Hell King Bliz hadn’t killed yet.
"SWAP."
Kent swapped with that clone body and then, with one quick grab, his claws sank into Morvath the Dream Eater’s throat.

He yanked it out, dragging out his throat, causing the poor hell demon who thought he could sneak up on someone who had a Soup Map for an eye to choke on his own blood. He died a second later when Kent decided to end his suffering.
He may have been the strongest among the city lords, the ruler of the City of Nightmares. However, when it came to Kent, he was inadequate.
"DIE."
Kent swapped with his last clone bodies, which were much closer to Syrak the Crimson Tyrant. The hell demon was also standing back like Morvath the Dream Eater did.
However, instead of planning to sneak up on him, he was powering an attack that Kent sensed some form of danger from.

It was blood-related, and since he was the third strongest city lord, the ruler of the City of Blood, Kent chose to target him next. Something told him to kill the bastard fast before it was too late.
’50,000 flame veins.’ Kent moved and appeared before him...
"BOOM." Kent mouthed the sound before activating 3000 blood runes, and then, with a quick punch, Syrak’s head was blasted off its body.

The other hell demons became even more aggressive now that two of them had died. However, no matter what they did or the terrifying powers they used, Kent remained unfazed, his speed and strength overpowering them.
"Damn... I make this look dope."

Kent bent his body backward, evading a powerful swing from Hell King Bliz. Using his left leg, he kicked a spear flying at him, then, using the momentum, he somersaulted, landing gently on the ground.
Then he moved at a speed so great that the hell demons only saw a blur.
Volkris the Thunderer lost his head, making him the third to die.
When he fell, there was a pause, allowing the hell demons to finally take in the danger they had stepped into.
"KILL HIM!"
Hell King Bliz seemed to be in denial. However, he soon realized he was being toyed with by Kent.
"Gentlemen, it seems I have become overly strong for my own good. So why don’t we end this?"
The next second, Kent fired up all flame veins, 20% bloodline, 5000 blood runes, and his killing intent.
In an instant, the entire arena became quiet...
(A/N: I am very tired, so only two Chapters today)
