chapters.title: Chapter 1045: Kent Vs Eleven Angry Hell Demons (2)
paragraphs: Perhaps, there is indeed a limit to how strong a person should be in a high world.
To maintain fairness, everyone must be limited to a specific strength level.

However, someone who is a True Primordial, who also has a bloodline even stronger than Celestial grade, and has a way to keep growing even if he doesn’t ascend to a high world to break his limits... then the concepts of limitations don’t apply to him.
Kent had proven time and time again that when it comes to limitations, he has no issue with them.
Now, he has proven to everyone that he is not someone to be underestimated.
All six City Lords were on their knees, and the Hell King was kneeling on one leg, his sword driven into the ground for support.
Meanwhile, Kent stood back, his expression showing he wasn’t satisfied.

’So it seems my bloodline power is much more powerful than I expected. Just 20%, and it is already this amazing. Then I wonder what will become of me when I reach 25% and can turn into my full dragon form.’
Kent smiled.
Just thinking about what kind of monster he would become after he turned into a full dragon made him want to face Empyreans, life and death stage warriors, next.
He is strong, and now it has become clear as day that he has to think about the realm beyond the High Worlds. He wanted to brave the immortal worlds.

’However, I am still weak. I need to become a Spirit King first before thinking about that. If what I saw in Jest’s memories was any indication of how strong Immortals are, then I still need to become stronger.’
Kent nodded to himself, already planning his next move after this adventure in hell.
"This is really a bummer. For a group of Immortal Lords and a Demigod to struggle against me, who is just a mere Core Formation kid... what a disappointment."
Kent sighed, his disdainful expression taking over.

Of course, it had to be noted that the people he fought with were much more powerful than they actually were now. They had the means to kill him ten thousand times over. However, because of the laws, he was now looking down on them.

All those who heard what he said started calling him shameless for thinking he was superior. Kent didn’t mind them, for he knew if these seven people currently suppressed under his bloodline were even to be allowed to use the strength of Empyreans, he would die for sure...
But then again, he had already proven that seven levels were not impossible for him.

"I wanted this to be fun, so I limited myself, held back my punches, and even decided to slow myself down to make up for your lack of strength and speed. However, now that we are here, I might as well end things.
We can have a good battle if we meet again. But today, you seven are as good as dead."
Kent snapped his fingers, and ten thin swords appeared and flashed through the air, leaving holes in their heads. Not even a single one of them had the chance to dodge.
Kent had already proven to them that under his bloodline, not even a Demigod could move.

"You know, when I was alive in the outside world, I had heard of some people who hail from the Great and Legacies Supreme High World families. They said their combat power rivals even Death Stage warriors.
If that is true, then I want to watch a battle between them and this monster," a demon said, his expression calm, though the shock in his eyes said it all.
"I actually want to watch a battle between him and an Immortal... Can he contend with an Immortal?"
"Don’t be ridiculous. As strong as he is, he is still not even close to defeating an Empyrean. We both know what happens to cultivators when they break past the Heavenly Ascension stage.
He is strong, but not on that level yet."
"Sorry, I guess I was just too happy and excited to see a more amazing battle."

"No need to apologize. This kid has proven to everyone that he is at the peak of a High World while only at the Core Formation stage. I wonder what will become of him once he reaches the Heavenly Ascension stage."
Just like that, everyone started wondering many things, some even willing to pay anything to see Kent fight an Immortal.
Naturally, they have now recognized the kind of monster he turned out to be, and now that they have seen him in action, they want more.
However, the ending to everything came much faster.
Five minutes after the battle, the Hell Monarch personally appeared in the arena...
"Looks like we have a new Hell King, everyone." They hated Kent’s arrogance, but they respected his strength, so they cheered.
"From today onwards, the Blood Reaper will be our new Hell King. He has demonstrated his strength and battle experience, so we both can attest that he will make a fine Hell King."
"However, because he has to leave, I will be allowing him to pick someone to rule in his place. One day, when he is done adventuring, he will come back to take his rightful throne."
Hearing this, everyone became shocked.
Killing a Hell King means becoming a Hell King. You stay and rule, for that is the rule.
Never in billions of years had anyone ever become a Hell King and let someone rule for them. This was their first time, so they couldn’t handle it.
But none dared question the Hell Monarch.
"Know that in my bid to limit the bloodshed that would have happened if he were allowed to challenge the cities, I had to compromise somehow. Of course, I know what you all are wondering...
Know that, because of how delicate this situation is, for the next 5.7 million years, no one is allowed to challenge the Sixth Level Hell King.
After the 5.7-million-year limit is up, you will all have a chance to have a go at him. But for today, let us celebrate our new Hell King and his substitute."

Kent smiled, hearing what the Hell Monarch said. If he goes back to the future, that is 3.7 million years gone. However, now he has 2 million years — roughly 23 years in the real world and 553 years inside the tower — to reach a level that even Demigods will fear before considering challenging him.
The Hell Monarch even chose not to use Kent’s real name in order not to put eyes on him.
"I will let the Blood Reaper reveal his substitute Hell King."
Kent smiled and thanked the Hell Monarch. "This is really a bummer, but I have to leave. That said, I will be picking a capable substitute to rule in my absence.
Everyone, welcome Bilad Juim Calosh II..."
Bilad walked onto the stage, causing the demons from the underworld who knew him to widen their eyes.
"Isn’t this the troublemaker who always follows that bitch Nyx around like a dog..."
"Shhhhhhhh... I was told he killed an Immortal Lord 34,000 years ago to save someone. He is not simple, so don’t lose your head because you couldn’t keep your big mouth shut."
Another demon added...
"Think about it, if he is weak, why would this person choose him as his substitute to rule Hell for him? I am no brain lord, but I can think of a few reasons..."

Meanwhile, Kent stood back, his expression showing he wasn’t satisfied.
’So it seems my bloodline power is much more powerful than I expected.
Just 20%, and it is already this amazing.
Then I wonder what will become of me when I reach 25% and can turn into my full dragon form.’
Kent smiled.
Just thinking about what kind of monster he would become after he turned into a full dragon made him want to face Empyreans, life and death stage warriors, next.
He is strong, and now it has become clear as day that he has to think about the realm beyond the High Worlds.
He wanted to brave the immortal worlds.
’However, I am still weak.
I need to become a Spirit King first before thinking about that.
If what I saw in Jest’s memories was any indication of how strong Immortals are, then I still need to become stronger.’
Kent nodded to himself, already planning his next move after this adventure in hell.
"This is really a bummer.
For a group of Immortal Lords and a Demigod to struggle against me, who is just a mere Core Formation kid... what a disappointment."
Kent sighed, his disdainful expression taking over.
Of course, it had to be noted that the people he fought with were much more powerful than they actually were now.
They had the means to kill him ten thousand times over.
However, because of the laws, he was now looking down on them.
All those who heard what he said started calling him shameless for thinking he was superior.
Kent didn’t mind them, for he knew if these seven people currently suppressed under his bloodline were even to be allowed to use the strength of Empyreans, he would die for sure...
But then again, he had already proven that seven levels were not impossible for him.
"I wanted this to be fun, so I limited myself, held back my punches, and even decided to slow myself down to make up for your lack of strength and speed.
However, now that we are here, I might as well end things.
We can have a good battle if we meet again.
But today, you seven are as good as dead."
Kent snapped his fingers, and ten thin swords appeared and flashed through the air, leaving holes in their heads.
Not even a single one of them had the chance to dodge.
Kent had already proven to them that under his bloodline, not even a Demigod could move.
"You know, when I was alive in the outside world, I had heard of some people who hail from the Great and Legacies Supreme High World families.
They said their combat power rivals even Death Stage warriors.
If that is true, then I want to watch a battle between them and this monster," a demon said, his expression calm, though the shock in his eyes said it all.
"I actually want to watch a battle between him and an Immortal...
Can he contend with an Immortal?"
"Don’t be ridiculous.
As strong as he is, he is still not even close to defeating an Empyrean.
We both know what happens to cultivators when they break past the Heavenly Ascension stage.
He is strong, but not on that level yet."
"Sorry, I guess I was just too happy and excited to see a more amazing battle."
"No need to apologize.
This kid has proven to everyone that he is at the peak of a High World while only at the Core Formation stage.
I wonder what will become of him once he reaches the Heavenly Ascension stage."
Just like that, everyone started wondering many things, some even willing to pay anything to see Kent fight an Immortal.
Naturally, they have now recognized the kind of monster he turned out to be, and now that they have seen him in action, they want more.
However, the ending to everything came much faster.
Five minutes after the battle, the Hell Monarch personally appeared in the arena...
"Looks like we have a new Hell King, everyone." They hated Kent’s arrogance, but they respected his strength, so they cheered.
"From today onwards, the Blood Reaper will be our new Hell King.
He has demonstrated his strength and battle experience, so we both can attest that he will make a fine Hell King."
"However, because he has to leave, I will be allowing him to pick someone to rule in his place.
One day, when he is done adventuring, he will come back to take his rightful throne."
Hearing this, everyone became shocked.
Killing a Hell King means becoming a Hell King.
You stay and rule, for that is the rule.
Never in billions of years had anyone ever become a Hell King and let someone rule for them.
This was their first time, so they couldn’t handle it.
But none dared question the Hell Monarch.
"Know that in my bid to limit the bloodshed that would have happened if he were allowed to challenge the cities, I had to compromise somehow.
Of course, I know what you all are wondering...
Know that, because of how delicate this situation is, for the next 5.7 million years, no one is allowed to challenge the Sixth Level Hell King.
After the 5.7-million-year limit is up, you will all have a chance to have a go at him.
But for today, let us celebrate our new Hell King and his substitute."
Kent smiled, hearing what the Hell Monarch said.
If he goes back to the future, that is 3.7 million years gone.
However, now he has 2 million years — roughly 23 years in the real world and 553 years inside the tower — to reach a level that even Demigods will fear before considering challenging him.
The Hell Monarch even chose not to use Kent’s real name in order not to put eyes on him.
"I will let the Blood Reaper reveal his substitute Hell King."
Kent smiled and thanked the Hell Monarch.
"This is really a bummer, but I have to leave.
That said, I will be picking a capable substitute to rule in my absence.
Everyone, welcome Bilad Juim Calosh II..."
Bilad walked onto the stage, causing the demons from the underworld who knew him to widen their eyes.
"Isn’t this the troublemaker who always follows that bitch Nyx around like a dog..."
"Shhhhhhhh...
I was told he killed an Immortal Lord 34,000 years ago to save someone.
He is not simple, so don’t lose your head because you couldn’t keep your big mouth shut."
Another demon added...
"Think about it, if he is weak, why would this person choose him as his substitute to rule Hell for him?
I am no brain lord, but I can think of a few reasons..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1046 - 300 Years Later
paragraphs: Many had objections, but after Hell Monarch personally branded Bilad as the new interim Hell King of Nex Morbus (sixth level of Hell) for the next millions of years, everyone had to accept him.
Truth be told, many are happy.
The demigods who wished to become Hell Kings were all happy.
To them, 5.7 million years is just a sleep away. It will soon reach, and when that day comes, they will all challenge the Hell Throne regardless of who is sitting on it.
Becoming a Hell King has many benefits, so everyone wants it.
However, due to the 5.7 million-year challenge ban, despite being the weakest Hell level so far, no one can challenge it.
Kent even teased them, causing many to put it at the back of their minds to pay the brat back a thousandfold.

"I know most of you want to become Hell Kings and Queens. However, since that place is occupied now, I wouldn’t mind opening slots for you to become the next City Lords... I mean, a few demigods as City Lords isn’t too bad, is it?"
They want him dead, and in 5.7 million years’ time, they will have their revenge.
Kent just scoffs and promises them he will be sure to prepare.
After that, Bilad said goodbye to Nyx, who was happy for him. They will have a chance to meet and talk later, but for now, he has a job to do, and so he must focus on that.
Kent took Nyx to the first city he defeated by disguising them both to appear like natives of the city of chains.
"So you are going back down there for how long?" Nyx asked, already aware that Kent wished to return to the core layer of the Damned Hell Sea to train.
His soul flame, flame resistance, and comprehension are still there, alongside 65,000 more flame veins to form. So he will be gone for a while.
"About 295 years, give or take."
"Okay. Then I will wait for you here... I would have gone with you, but I use the Ice element, and being there for long will affect me badly."
"I understand. Just stay here... I will be back soon."
Kent left, and soon, he was back to the core layer, at the bottom of the Damned Hell Sea, where he resumed his training inside the pool of the Supreme Grade Primordial Hell Flame.
He had already spent four years in Hell, but because he couldn’t leave until the 300 years were over, he decided to train instead of roaming the various cities in Hell.
[294 years later - Bottom of the Damned Hell Sea]
⟪You have attained the first stage of Flame Immunity; Ember Immunity⟫
⟪You have attained the first stage of Flame Harmony; Resonant Harmony⟫
⟪Your Chaos Soul Flame has upgraded: Tier 14 ↠ Tier 15⟫
Kent opened his eyes, the feeling of power and comprehension oozing from his body. He had been seated in the same place for 294 good years.
Naturally, that was tiring. However, Kent is a cultivator and had already been in an extended seclusion before, so this was no new thing to him.
However, this time, despite spending close to three centuries in seclusion, he will walk out with many benefits.
He had already reached Flame Immunity and Flame Harmony.
The only thing left for him to do now is to comprehend the Flame Laws, which will take him through the five stages of immunity and harmony before attaining True Flame Immunity and True Flame Harmony.

For that, he needs to fight beings who have begun to comprehend the Laws of Flame. Of course, for that to happen, he must go to the Immortal Worlds. That is the only place he can comprehend the flame laws.
This means for a while, he will be stuck at the first stage.
"But I have formed 65,000 more flame veins, making 135,000 flame veins, and my Soul flame is now Tier 15." Kent smiled, remembering something Agni said.
"Agni said I needed pills to help form flame veins and cores. He also said I need to form seven flame cores and at least 108,000 flame veins before I can learn the Finger of Destruction technique.
Aside from that, he also said I need to have weak flame resistance before I can learn it. However, despite reaching Flame Harmony, I can feel the ’Finger of Destruction’ calling to me."
Kent chuckled... "I have only formed one flame core, but I know it is already big enough to fuel the Finger of Destruction, meaning I can learn it now."
He examined his body and could tell he could indeed learn the technique.
He closed his eyes again and entered the Sword Mind to learn. When he appeared, he saw the runes for the Claw Art, but he didn’t attempt it, for he knew he was still too weak for that technique.
He moved straight to the runes for the Finger of Destruction and began learning.
[9 months later]
A long, colossal, and flaming finger descended, shaking the entire space. As it moved, stars, moons, and planets started exploding. The chunks from the explosion melted in one hellish blaze.
"Damn."
Kent muttered, staring at the finger move with a smile on his face. It had been daunting, but he managed to learn a small part of the first form of the Finger of Destruction.
What he was staring at was the true first form. But, compared to his understanding, he was still years behind.

However, when Kent raised his hand and pointed his finger forward, a 30-meter-long flaming finger appeared. It was a weaker version of the true Finger of Destruction; however, it was strong enough to kill those below the Immortal stage.
"I now understand why Agni said one needs seven flame cores. Just using it once has taken 20% of my flame essence. This means I can use it only five times."
Kent sighed, and then he opened his eyes to the outside.
"Agni is wrong about one thing, though. The amount of flame veins that can be formed is not 500,000 but rather 1.5 million.
This means I have a long way to go. Hopefully, one day, I can form that many flame veins and finally stand at a stage not even the God of Speed can rival me."
Kent stood up and walked back outside, where Avotha and Gaap were waiting for him.
"Let’s go."
They started flying back to the outside world. Kent had only a few weeks left, so he planned to see what had become of his kingdom before he left.
Three hours later, they were back in the City of Chains, where Nyx was waiting for him.
She would return to the Underworld to pursue her own dreams. But before leaving, Kent wanted to make sure she wouldn’t be sending herself to an early grave.
Kent was thrilled to see that new City Lords had been chosen, and the cities were now thriving more than ever.
He also discovered that a new rule had been made by the Hell King, allowing anyone to challenge the City Lords every 100,000 years.
This way, instead of the City Lords thinking they were undisputed, this challenge would put them straight and help them grow in both experience and strength.
Lastly, the City of Flies was now the City of Bulls. A new race of Hell demons had occupied it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1047: Back to the Land of the Living
paragraphs: "So you really don’t know how I became an Underworld Queen?" Nyx asked one last time as Kent prepared to leave.
Kent shook his head. "I have no idea how you became a Queen, but I know you are an Underworld Queen because you helped a subordinate of mine."
"I see. Too bad you had no idea how I managed to kill that bastard," she sighed and turned toward Bilad, who had come to send Kent off.
"Hell King suits you well?" Nyx smiled and straightened his collar before turning back to Kent.
"Don’t worry. Bilad is a capable person; he will take care of your kingdom while you are away."
"I know he will. After all, he is the most qualified." Kent pressed his finger against his forehead and transmitted a technique to him.
"This is..." Bilad froze, unsure of what to say.
"It is something small to keep you going. Though be sure to pay attention to the Blood Essence you devour, we wouldn’t want you turning into a chimera all of a sudden," Kent smiled.
He had just given Bilad a Bloodline technique that would allow him to not only strengthen his bloodline but also upgrade it to the Celestial grade.
"Once you manage to reach the level required to fully awaken the bloodline, stop cultivating the technique and focus on exploring how best to use the various Bloodline Aspects."
Bilad nodded.
Kent turned to Nyx next. "Treat this meeting as one arranged by fate. I don’t really know how or when you became an Underworld Queen, but I can ensure you don’t die trying."
He pressed his hand against her forehead and transferred one of the techniques he saw in Abyssal Leviathan’s vault.
It was as if he knew this day would come, and he learned the right techniques.

"The Nine-Fold Calamity Whip Art is a technique created by a true primordial... well, that was what Leviathan told me. However, I know that it has killed many immortals and gods, so treat it with care, and please, master the first four forms before we meet again."
"What happens if I don’t master the first four forms?"
"Then prepare for some spanking. I don’t like lazy women."
Nyx blushed, causing Bilad to start teasing her.
Kent ignored them and turned to Avotha. "I know you would want to seek revenge on those who banished your mother down here. I know I would if I were in your place.
However, until we meet again, don’t go after them. You alone are not enough, so wait for me to bring the cavalry.
Of course, you don’t have to stay in hell if you don’t want to. You can go to the Underworld and help Nyx conquer and create her own kingdom.
You can also go to the land of the living and spend some time exploring. Just don’t go to the Galaxy of the Abyss Dragons.
One last thing: you should form at least 20 Death Tattoos before we meet again. If we are going to take down a galaxy, you need to be able to embody death in all aspects."

Kent transmitted the second form of the Genesis of Death to Avotha before stepping back. He had done all he could to secure their future. The rest would depend on whether or not they had what it took to keep their lives.
"Take care, everyone... we will meet sooner than you think."
"You too, Kent... and when I meet your subordinate in the future, I will be sure to help him to the best of my abilities."
"I am sure you will," Kent smiled.
"I will keep your kingdom safe for you, so relax and come back when you are ready," Bilad also said, and Kent gave him a nod.
Avotha just bowed slightly.
Kent nodded at him and then, with a wave, his body vanished, appearing in front of the gate that led to the Pill Ascension Realm.
Just as it was closing, a bracelet flashed out and entered Kent’s left hand.
A voice then entered his head.
"Till next time, Sage."
"Kent," Pill Monarch Nefeli called out, causing Kent to turn and look in her direction. He saw her and Yuna walking toward him.
He also saw the 24 alchemists who entered the Pill Ascension Realm walk a few meters behind them.
However, before he could move, he felt five powerful presences lock on him, and at once, five figures clad in battle armor surrounded him.
Pill Monarch Nefeli froze in her steps. Instinctively, she spread her palm, summoning her sword. However, Kent’s soothing tone entered her head, causing her to close her palm.
’Don’t worry, big sister... they are as good as dead.’
Kent stood calm as five weapons stabbed toward him. All five were swordsmen; however, feeling their sword intent and aura, he knew they were mere greenhouse flowers.
’Even my level 4 Profound Sword Aura before it mutated is stronger than their level 5 Heavenly Sword Aura...’

Kent unleashed his killing intent just when they were a meter from him. This caused all five to fall to their knees and pass out. Then, with a wave of his hand, green flames that immediately caught everyone’s attention surrounded them.
"That is a Primordial Flame."
"So powerful. What grade is it?"
"Damn, Pyris Pill Alliance now has someone with a Primordial Flame."
"We can’t allow him to live."

The greedy ones looked at Kent with killing intent. However, before they could even think about attacking, Kent waved his hand, and the five Heavenly Ascension Stage cultivators on the ground were reduced to ash, leaving only their Blood Essence behind.

"Let me make one thing clear. From today onwards, the number one Pill Alliance is my Pyris Pill Alliance. All those who oppose this decision will be reduced to ash, just like those idiots I just took care of.
So please, come against me. I am begging you to point your weapon at me, and let’s see who remains standing."
BOOM
Kent unleashed his bloodline, transforming into his demi-dragon form. Everybody except Pyris and Aerithyne Pill Alliances remained standing.
The rest, including the Pill Legends, were on their knees; some even passed out on the ground.
"One thing I hate is people thinking they are on top of the world simply because they have some status. I mean, you bunch think just because you are Pill Worlds, you can do as you please.

Perhaps when I am dead... maybe then you can do that. But as long as I remain standing, forget about ever making a fuss. Trust me, if not for your importance to the other worlds, I would have wiped you out right now.
There won’t be a next time..."
Kent put away his bloodline, but everyone was so exhausted that they couldn’t stand.
Kent walked toward Pill Monarch Nefeli, still in his demi-dragon form.
"So you are a dragon..." she said, a small smile playing on her lips.
Kent walked toward her and whispered into her ear, "Not just any dragon, big sister, the Primordial Chaos Dragon."
Her body froze, but Kent just smiled and looked at Yuna. He extended his hand, and a Primordial Flame Seed appeared.
"Big brother, is this mine?"
"Yes. It is a high-grade Primordial Flame Seed. It complements your Purity Soul Flame, so once we return, absorb it."
"You are the best, big brother."
"I know." Kent flipped his hair back.
Still frozen, Pill Monarch Nefeli was struck dumb again, looking at the high-grade Primordial Flame in Yuna’s hand.

"Why did you give the High-Grade Primordial Flame to Yuna? It will be wasted on her."
"I don’t think so. Yuna is an extraordinary talent. Trust me, her knowledge in alchemy is something you shouldn’t underestimate." Kent didn’t know if he should tell her Yuna’s true identity.
Of course, she knew this wasn’t something he could easily disclose. However, he also knew this wasn’t something he could hide from a powerful warrior of her caliber.
If he were to tell her who Yuna really was, the chances of her going above and beyond to ensure she lived a good life would be high.
But one couldn’t really tell what was in others’ hearts, so he decided to hold back for now.
"But still, even if she is an extraordinary talent, a low-grade Primordial Flame would have sufficed."

"Don’t tell me you have more from where that came from."
"Let’s just return first."

chapters.title: Chapter 1050: Revenge is a Bitch
paragraphs: "I can’t believe those fuckers actually have a Soul Extinguishing pill," Nefeli said, her expression dark...

"I only found out when I spied on their leader. It turned out they wanted to steal the soul spirit that was auctioned at the Brown Maple Auction House from the vice sect leader of the Heavens Eye sect.
I wanted to kill him then, but I wasn’t strong enough. Now, I can kill him before he knows how it happened."
"To think they actually have such a thing... This is just too shocking. I can’t believe they are actually colluding with the Evil Sect.
I will make sure they are discredited and branded as traitors, forever shunned from the Pill Worlds."

Kent laughed, watching her expression. "Then be ready to disband the other Pill Alliance, because I know for sure the Zephyros Pill Alliance also has the Soul Extinguishing pill, and I wouldn’t put it past the other Pill Worlds."
"This is just too unbelievable."
Kent shook his head, looking at the angry expression that appeared on Nefeli’s face.
She may have cultivated the persona of an Alchemist simply to stay hidden from her enemies.
However, over the years, the love for alchemy has taken root in her heart, and, without even knowing it, she has become an alchemist and a swordsman.
So, hearing that a place she assumed to be safe was actually being influenced by outside and vile forces made her extremely mad.
"Don’t worry about them, dear. Even if I can’t get rid of them before leaving, I will leave a few capable friends behind to help you handle them."
Nefeli nodded...
Kent kissed her, and then he left the room. Right when he walked out, he met Yuna, who was pacing back and forth.
"Yuna..." Kent called out, and Yuna ran toward him and took his right hand into hers.
"Big brother, that flame seed you gave me is mean," Yuna said, causing Kent to laugh.
He gave a mission to the seven monarchs before going to hell. Within those 30 days, they chased, fought, and collected as many Primordial flames as they could get their hands on.

In the end, the god inside the Pill Ascension Realm added some more, allowing Kent to not only have over a hundred primordial flame seeds with him, but also the majority of these flame seeds actually gain intelligence, allowing them to speak.
The one he gave to Yuna is the Heart Purity Primordial Flame.
Naturally, she was meant to be a bitch to someone like Yuna, who, despite being of age to know basic stuff like how to dress and talk like a lady, was not.
"She is not mean, Yuna; she is just teaching you how to be a proper lady."
"No, big brother, she is very mean. She called me a cockroach and a bug."
Kent chuckled. "Bring her out."
Yuna did, and when the blue flame seed appeared, Kent smiled and spoke, "Yuna was bullied and enslaved her entire life, so she doesn’t know the basic stuff a refined lady should know.
However, I believe if you bond with her and get to know her, you two can grow and help each other. You would even be surprised how happy you will become if you finally get to know her."
The flame seed didn’t say anything for a minute before she spoke. "Fine. But she must listen to me, and she shouldn’t reject my directions."
Kent turned and looked at Yuna. "You should listen to her and be sure to pick a thing or two from her."
"Okay. But if she calls me a bug again, I will drop her in dirty water."
"You wouldn’t." The Primordial Flame said...
"I would."
"You wouldn’t dare."
"Try me."
Kent could only smile, watching as Yuna and her new best friend bickered and walked away.
"They are going to have so much fun together."
With a smile on his face, Kent teleported away, appearing 80,000 km away. His destination is the Blue Flame Pill Palace.
His aim in going was to kill the main brains behind this foul organization. Of course, the immortal armor was still one of his objectives.
However, he wanted to make an example out of the Blue Flame Pill Palace. They dared to collude with people who used vile ways to make pills.
As an alchemist, Kent isn’t going to allow that.
When he appeared 80,000 km away, he saw a tall building in the distance. His soul map immediately covered it.
On the last floor, he saw some Pill Emperors concocting pills. Kent checked and saw that these people were quite experienced.
However, he wasn’t after them. His main targets were in a building 4 km away from this tall building.
Inside, he saw Vice Leader Vince and the old man.
"Looks like they managed to reverse the effect of the bone-corroding poison," Kent said, a mocking smile painting his face.
He then examined them for a moment before a smirk formed on his lips when he noticed something else.
"Though he paid a terrible price for that. Now he can’t walk again," Kent smiled.
He wanted the old bastard to die painfully; however, he seemed to have underestimated their resourcefulness.
"This doesn’t change anything. Since they are now in the same room, I will be sure to leave them screaming and in pain before finally dying this time around."
Kent decided to hear what they were saying first, then, at the right time, he would crash their party...
"Sect leader, I think we should move to the offensive and attack the Heavens Eye sect," Vince said, his expression dark.
"I am considering that too," the old man said, and Vince nodded, a small, wicked smile creeping at the corner of his mouth.
When he came back and met the Sect Master in this state, his blood boiled with the desire to kill all those involved.
However, aside from the mysterious person named Chaos, whom they were aware of, the other targets could be the Heaven’s Eye sect.

Naturally, they wanted to attack and kill every last member of that sect. As alchemists, killing them would be very simple. All they needed was a large dose of poison, and they would get the job done.
"I even have a Formation Expert ready to help with the formation protecting the sect."
"Oh, exciting. When do we plan on doing that?" Suddenly, another voice reached their ears, causing Vince to lunge at Kent.
"Kneel."
Kent gestured with his left hand, and the poor bastard crashed to his knees.
"Oh, please. I don’t want to be considered vile, so just sit down. I don’t want to force a cripple to kneel when I am about to torture and kill you in the most miserable way."
Kent smiled and walked toward a bowl of jellybean fruit, picked one, and threw it into his mouth.
Both the old man and Vince were left frozen, their bodies locked in place. Not even their eyelids were moving. It was like they had lost control over their bodies.
"Good fruit," Kent said.
He picked a few more, put them in his mouth, and savored the taste. When he had had enough, he turned and looked at the two hostages.
"Pardon my rudeness, you two. You can call me Chaos... and I believe this meeting is long overdue... don’t you think?"
A smile that caused the two to break into a showering sweat appeared on Kent’s face. They, at that moment, knew they had finally met the devil, and he looked handsome and very mischievous.
